Participants include raw avocado fruit suppliers, cold-press and refining manufacturers, bulk distributors, branded consumer product companies, and retail channels globally. The market spans food-grade, cosmetic-grade, and pharmaceutical-grade avocado oil across all geographies with major supply hubs in Mexico, Peru, Kenya, South Africa, and Chile.

# Adams Group is a fifth-generation, family-owned food company that crafts food with integrity from
# seed-to-shelf

SINCE 1920

## For over 100 years we have been led by one principle—doing the right thing

In 1920, a small malted barley venture in Woodland, California sparked a five-generation commitment
to doing right—by farmers, partners, employees, customers, and the families we feed.

Still family-owned and operated, Adams Group has led the organic food movement and grown into a
global, vertically integrated company delivering specialty at scale across grains, seeds, and oils.

For more than 100 years our compass hasn’t changed–because doing the right thing isn’t just our
history; it’s our way forward

OUR PRODUCT FOCUS

## Uncompromising standards across every step

At Adams Group, quality isn’t just about the end product—it’s a mindset that guides everything we
do.

Our facilities, processes, and people all work together to ensure every product meets the highest
standards of safety, consistency, and excellence

## Advanced facilities and capacity

With decades of investment, Adams Group operates modern facilities that set the standard in food
processing. Our facilities ensure efficiency, safety, and scale for our partners worldwide.

Two grain processing and storage facilities in Woodland, California, including Gluten-Free
processing.

A state-of-the-art Oil refinery, quality lab, and bottling line in Arbuckle, California.

Substantial storage capacity ensuring consistent supply.

HANDS-ON APPROACH

## Global sourcing

We take a hands-on approach to global sourcing—building long-term relationships with farmers,
suppliers, and manufacturers across the globe. This ensures resilience, diversity, and integrity.

Hands-on approach to sourcing to ensure resilience and diversity in our supply chain.

TENDING TO THE LAND FOR GENERATIONS

## Committed to sustainability

With origins in agriculture, Adams Group has been caring for the land and environment for over a
century. Our sustainability efforts are rooted in stewardship and innovation—ensuring we leave the
world better than we found it.

# AETH ~ Aceites Especiales TH

Aceites Especiales TH, nace en la ciudad de Morelia, Michoacán en México, gracias a la visión de
nuestro fundador Gregorio Gómez Gutiérrez de ofrecer productos saludables de calidad derivados de
semillas oleaginosas y frutos cultivados en México.

Desde 1905, hemos adoptado la innovación como uno de nuestros pilares más importantes, adaptándonos
a las necesidades de mejores y más sofisticados mercados, acciones que nos han llevado a
posicionarnos como líderes en la producción de aceites vegetales.

## Presencia Geográfica.

En 1986, iniciamos operaciones globales, logrando una amplia cobertura de los mercados
internacionales.

## Somos AETH.

AETH es y siempre ha sido un negocio basado en principios. Aunque estamos orgullosos de nuestro
pasado, mantenemos la mirada firmemente puesta en el futuro.

Todo lo que hacemos, parte de una visión de contribuir positivamente a nuestra comunidad y entorno.
Queremos ser un líder que impulse soluciones respaldadas en diversos pilares y acciones, para ello
contamos con [equipos de procesos industriales][12] altamente diseñados que garanticen un máximo
aprovechamiento de los recursos naturales que requerímos usar para la fabricación de nuestros
productos.

Nuestras certificaciones reflejan nuestro compromiso con la excelencia y la sostenibilidad. Contamos

sin OGM) en [www.nongmoproject.org][19]«

## Reconocimientos.

En AETH tuvimos como principales propósitos este 2024, fortalecer e innovar la responsabilidad
social y sustentabilidad en nuestros procesos, enfocado en colaborar con la agenda 2030 que la ONU
propuso como ODS (Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible) para disminuir impactos que afectan a la
sociedad mundialmente.

Este año priorizamos la concientización y desarrollo de nuestros colaboradores en estos temas, por
medio de proyectos e inversiones en infraestructura, eventos y programas de responsabilidad social
específicamente en cuestiones ambientales y en la equidad de género, desarrollo profesional de las
mujeres e igualdad de oportunidades, así como respeto a los Derechos humanos laborales, entre otras.

Como resultado de estos esfuerzos, AETH fue reconocida con el Premio ELIS (Empresas Líderes en
Innovación Sustentable) en la categoría “AMBIENTAL”, distintivo y reconocimiento que otorga HSBC por
mejor estrategia ambiental a nivel nacional.

En 1986, iniciamos operaciones globales, logrando una amplia cobertura de los mercados
internacionales.

## Somos AETH.

AETH es y siempre ha sido un negocio basado en principios. Aunque estamos orgullosos de nuestro
pasado, mantenemos la mirada firmemente puesta en el futuro.

Todo lo que hacemos, parte de una visión de contribuir positivamente a nuestra comunidad y entorno.
Queremos ser un líder que impulse soluciones respaldadas en diversos pilares y acciones, para ello
contamos con [equipos de procesos industriales][12] altamente diseñados que garanticen un máximo
aprovechamiento de los recursos naturales que requerímos usar para la fabricación de nuestros
productos.

## Reconocimientos.

En AETH tuvimos como principales propósitos este 2024, fortalecer e innovar la responsabilidad
social y sustentabilidad en nuestros procesos, enfocado en colaborar con la agenda 2030 que la ONU
propuso como ODS (Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible) para disminuir impactos que afectan a la
sociedad mundialmente.

Este año priorizamos la concientización y desarrollo de nuestros colaboradores en estos temas, por
medio de proyectos e inversiones en infraestructura, eventos y programas de responsabilidad social
específicamente en cuestiones ambientales y en la equidad de género, desarrollo profesional de las
mujeres e igualdad de oportunidades, así como respeto a los Derechos humanos laborales, entre otras.

Como resultado de estos esfuerzos, AETH fue reconocida con el Premio ELIS (Empresas Líderes en
Innovación Sustentable) en la categoría “AMBIENTAL”, distintivo y reconocimiento que otorga HSBC por

# Final Home

## Extracted from nature, approved by science.

Atomm Botanicals is one of the world’s leading manufacturer and supplier of pure natural plant
derivates for the use in the cosmetic and industries. We redefine the power of plant extracts
through innovative extraction method by offering extracts for both water as well as oil medium.

Based on more than 17 years of intensive research and development in plant cellular science and
botanical extraction, Atomm Botanicals is a distinctively creative brand. Plant Extracts’ journey
started in 2006 and has been developing ever since. Significant scientific developments and
botanical discoveries have accompanied the evolution of botanical extracts. Atomm Botanicals is a
leader in the development of natural active substances and works with partners and growers. Our R&D
team is dedicated to creating technology to unlock and maximise the benefits of botanical species
for the cosmetic and pharmaceutical industries, and they are leading research on some of the most
potent plant-based concentrates in the world.

Using a ground-breaking extraction technique, all extracts and oils are offered in the liquid
carrier matrix of the plant to harness the potent phytoactives without the use of chemicals.
Atomm Botanicals’ products maintain the integrity of native botany responsibly, ethically, and while
maintaining excellent levels of quality, service, and delivery. It bridges the gap between the
complicated needs of the consumer and the actual power of untouched nature.
Atomm botanicals procure the finest selection of top ingredients grown and brewed to deliver
powerful nutrients to your skin. We use the finest ingredients and techniques to create herbal
blends that will hydrate your skin without fail.

Health Benefits

IT’S GOOD FOR YOU

The amazing avocado has many distinctive health benefits and is classed as a superfood by many.
On top of the many health benefits here are a few:
It may reduce cholesterol, improve heart health and lower blood pressure.
It’s high in rich Oleic Acid, a very healthy fat. The essential fats found avocados are essential for digestion and nutrient absorption because they nourish the lining of the gut. It’s an all-round super food!

IT HAS A HIGH SMOKE POINT

Not every oil is created equal. The benefit of avocado oil is that it can be heated to very high temperatures. Why is this good? When oil is heated past its smoke point, the fat starts to break down, releasing free radicals and any health benefit that the oil had is lost.

EXTRA VIRGIN COLD PRESSED

Extra Virgin is the highest grade of avocado oil, produced from the pressing of good quality avocados.

Produced at low temperatures, without chemicals the oil is 100% pure and natural.
Cold pressing from the first press of the avocado fruit means retains the same high
level of nutrients, natural flavour, aroma and colour found in fresh avocado.

16 AVOCADOS IN EVERY BOTTLE

Every one of our 250ml bottles contains 16 cold pressed avocados.
Quality Avocado Oil should have a taste and colour characteristics of the fresh avocado fruit and be a dark vibrant green. We house our oil in dark glass bottles, which keeps out light
and oxygen retaining the quality of the oil

# Our Story

## Our Story

## We wanted to share the health giving properties of Avocado Oil with others

Our story came to fruition 20 years ago, in Tauranga. The Bay of Plenty is situated on the east
coast of New Zealand’s north island. It’s renowned for having nutrient rich volcanic soil and a warm
climate, which plays a pivotal role in growing the finest Haas avocados.

We had a vision to deliver the highest quality avocado oil and for food lovers to reap the
health-giving benefits. We set our goal and with a dose of Kiwi ingenuity, innovation and hard work
we began to press and extract the oily goodness from this superfood into its concentrated form.

We’re proud to be named the first producers of 100% natural, virgin cold-pressed avocado oil. Our
world-class production process ensures that the oil extracted reaches your table at its purest. The
delicate aroma, colour and distinct flavour cocoons the abundance of well-being benefits found in
this nutrient dense oil – something we’re honoured to produce and share with the world.

[ ][76]

## Watch Our Story

## The Process

The team at Grove sources avocado fruit from fully certified suppliers in compliance with industry
standards, established and monitored by the Avocado Industry Council. Grove have perfected the
extraction of avocado oil by cold pressing in a single extraction to produce their extra virgin
avocado oil.

Only the delicate flesh is used in the process resulting in a vibrant, green, pure oil which is then
bottled into light sensitive glass bottles to preserve the freshness and flavour, and fitted with an
easy pourer.

## Our Quality Guarantee

The Grove Avocado Oil process of sourcing fruit from orchards, ripening, processing and bottling is
managed under a stringent quality management system. Avocado Oil NZ Limited operates under a hazard
analysis critical control point system (HACCP) food safety programme, which is audited annually and
certified by SGS Australia Pty. Ltd. The SQF Certification is the world’s leading inspection,
verification, testing and certification company.

Our oil is tested by an independent laboratory, and a certificate of analysis can be provided with a
shipment on request. Grove Avocado Oil is also a registered member of the American Oil Chemists’
Society (AOCS, Registration No. 000000592862).

The ongoing research, development and investment in technology together with global awareness around
the avocado fruit has resulted in increased demand for avocado oil.

We proudly display the New Zealand FernMark. It directly connects our customers to the stories and
products that make us part of New Zealand’s outstanding clean, green and sustainable global
reputation.

## Por qué Avocado Real

**Avocado Real** elabora** aceite de aguacate 100% puro** con un estándar que no negocia: solo las
**grasas buenas** del aguacate, intactas desde el origen.

Cada botella conserva de forma natural antioxidantes, vitamina E y grasas monoinsaturadas — porque
el proceso importa tanto como el producto.

La mayoría de aceites vegetales se degradan a **altas temperaturas** liberando compuestos oxidados.
**El aceite de aguacate 100% puro** aguanta **hasta 270°C** sin perder estabilidad — sin humo, sin
residuos, sin comprometer tu salud.

**Certificado sin OGM · Sin gluten · Sin azúcares añadidos · Sin aceites de semillas · 100%
vegano.**

Versátil, estable y limpio. Para freír, aliñar, hornear o cuidar tu piel. Úsalo cada día, de mil
maneras.

## Lo que nos diferencia

### Un solo ingrediente

Aceite de aguacate 100% puro. Sin aditivos, sin conservantes, sin ingredientes añadidos. Lo que ves
en la etiqueta es todo lo que hay dentro.

### 100% puro

Sin procesos químicos. Sin aceites de semillas. Sin mezclas. Solo aguacate, desde el origen hasta la
botella.

### Nutrientes intactos

Extraído y embotellado para preservar antioxidantes, vitamina E y grasas monoinsaturadas naturales
del aguacate.

### Hecho en España

Elaborado desde el corazón de Andalucía con aguacates seleccionados. Pensado para tu cocina real.

### Versátil por naturaleza

Para freír, saltear, hornear o aliñar. Para hidratar tu piel o el cabello. Un solo ingrediente que
se adapta a cada momento de tu día, en la cocina y fuera de ella.

### Certificado y transparente

Sin OGM · Sin gluten · Sin azúcares añadidos · Sin aceites de semillas · 100% vegano.

## Lo que nos define

Avocado Real elabora aceite de aguacate 100% puro desde el corazón de Andalucía. Con aguacates
seleccionados. Sin atajos, sin compromisos.

Dos variedades. Un mismo estándar:

## Por qué Avocado Real

**Avocado Real** elabora** aceite de aguacate 100% puro** con un estándar que no negocia: solo las
**grasas buenas** del aguacate, intactas desde el origen.

Cada botella conserva de forma natural antioxidantes, vitamina E y grasas monoinsaturadas — porque
el proceso importa tanto como el producto.

La mayoría de aceites vegetales se degradan a **altas temperaturas** liberando compuestos oxidados.
**El aceite de aguacate 100% puro** aguanta **hasta 270°C** sin perder estabilidad — sin humo, sin
residuos, sin comprometer tu salud.

**Certificado sin OGM · Sin gluten · Sin azúcares añadidos · Sin aceites de semillas · 100%
vegano.**

Versátil, estable y limpio. Para freír, aliñar, hornear o cuidar tu piel. Úsalo cada día, de mil
maneras.

### Un solo ingrediente

Aceite de aguacate 100% puro. Sin aditivos, sin conservantes, sin ingredientes añadidos. Lo que ves
en la etiqueta es todo lo que hay dentro.

Sin procesos químicos. Sin aceites de semillas. Sin mezclas. Solo aguacate, desde el origen hasta la
botella.

Extraído y embotellado para preservar antioxidantes, vitamina E y grasas monoinsaturadas naturales
del aguacate.

### Hecho en España

Elaborado desde el corazón de Andalucía con aguacates seleccionados. Pensado para tu cocina real.

### Versátil por naturaleza

Para freír, saltear, hornear o aliñar. Para hidratar tu piel o el cabello. Un solo ingrediente que
se adapta a cada momento de tu día, en la cocina y fuera de ella.

### Certificado y transparente

Sin OGM · Sin gluten · Sin azúcares añadidos · Sin aceites de semillas · 100% vegano.

Welcome to our state-of-the-art avocado pack house facility, where quality meets efficiency. At
Avodemia, we offer comprehensive packing services to ensure the freshness and premium quality of our
avocados. Our pack house facility is equipped with advanced technology and operated by skilled
professionals dedicated to delivering excellence at every step of the process.

# Our Pack House Services

Expert handling, sorting, and packaging of fresh avocados and avocado oil to meet global standards.

#### [
####
#### Timely Delivery
####
#### ][11]

We are committed to delivering our freshly packed avocados in a timely and efficient manner. Our
logistics team works closely with trusted transportation partners to ensure prompt delivery to
domestic and international markets, minimizing transit times and maximizing shelf life.

#### [Quality Control][12]

Quality is our top priority. Our pack house facility is equipped with quality control measures and
procedures to maintain the highest standards of food safety and hygiene. We adhere to strict
protocols and regulations to ensure that our products meet or exceed industry standards.

#### [Customizations][13]

We understand that every customer has unique needs and preferences. That’s why we offer customizable
packing solutions to accommodate different packaging sizes, labelling requirements, and branding
specifications. Whether you’re a retailer, distributor, or food service provider, we can tailor our
services to meet your individual needs.

#### [Sorting and Grading][14]

We employ meticulous sorting and grading processes to ensure that only the finest avocados meet our
quality standards. Each avocado is carefully inspected for size, ripeness, and blemishes, ensuring
consistency and uniformity in every pack.

#### [Packaging][15]

Our packaging solutions are designed to preserve the freshness and flavor of our avocados during
transportation and storage. We offer a variety of packaging options, including cartons, trays, and
customized branding solutions tailored to meet your specific requirements.

Welcome to our state-of-the-art avocado pack house facility, where quality meets efficiency. At
Avodemia, we offer comprehensive packing services to ensure the freshness and premium quality of our
avocados. Our pack house facility is equipped with advanced technology and operated by skilled
professionals dedicated to delivering excellence at every step of the process.

# Our Pack House Services

Expert handling, sorting, and packaging of fresh avocados and avocado oil to meet global standards.

#### [
####
#### Timely Delivery
####
#### ][11]

We are committed to delivering our freshly packed avocados in a timely and efficient manner. Our
logistics team works closely with trusted transportation partners to ensure prompt delivery to
domestic and international markets, minimizing transit times and maximizing shelf life.

#### [Quality Control][12]

Quality is our top priority. Our pack house facility is equipped with quality control measures and
procedures to maintain the highest standards of food safety and hygiene. We adhere to strict
protocols and regulations to ensure that our products meet or exceed industry standards.

#### [Customizations][13]

We understand that every customer has unique needs and preferences. That’s why we offer customizable
packing solutions to accommodate different packaging sizes, labelling requirements, and branding
specifications. Whether you’re a retailer, distributor, or food service provider, we can tailor our
services to meet your individual needs.

#### [Sorting and Grading][14]

We employ meticulous sorting and grading processes to ensure that only the finest avocados meet our
quality standards. Each avocado is carefully inspected for size, ripeness, and blemishes, ensuring
consistency and uniformity in every pack.

#### [Packaging][15]

Our packaging solutions are designed to preserve the freshness and flavor of our avocados during
transportation and storage. We offer a variety of packaging options, including cartons, trays, and
customized branding solutions tailored to meet your specific requirements.

Avokad Fruits Kenya

Your Trusted Partner for Premium Avocados and Avocado Oil

Why Choose Us?

Nurturing Nature, Delivering Quality

About Us

As the largest avocado exporter in East Africa, we specialize in delivering fresh avocados and cold-pressed avocado oil to Europe and beyond, adhering to the highest standards of quality and sustainability.
Our success stems from a commitment to excellence at every stage of production and processing. We work closely with farmers across Embu, Meru, Kirinyaga, Nyeri, Murang’a Counties, and beyond; constantly empowering them through access to better markets and training in sustainable agricultural practices.

Whether you are looking for the finest fresh avocados or nutrient-rich avocado oil, Avokad Fruits (K) Limited guarantees unmatched quality, a commitment to sustainability, and a passion for connecting the best of Africa’s produce with the world. ### Mission Statement

To sustainably produce bulk crude and organic avocado oil, driving environmental responsibility
while empowering local farmers and supporting global manufacturers.

### Vision Statement

To become the worlds leading supplier of bulk organic and crude avocado oil, setting benchmarks for
sustainability, ethical sourcing, and global impact.

### From Ugandan Farms to Global Manufacturers - 100% Natural, Bulk Avocado Oil

Our cold-pressed avocado oil, sourced directly from Uganda's finest farms, is rich in healthy fats,
vitamins, and antioxidants. Available in bulk, it serves the needs of global food and cosmetic
manufacturers, offering unmatched quality in every tank.

### Core Values

###### Innovation

Constantly advancing bulk oil extraction techniques for optimal quality.

###### Sustainability

Ensuring eco-friendly and organic farming practices to protect the environment.

###### Customer-Centric

Tailoring bulk oil solutions to meet client needs in both culinary and cosmetic industries.

###### Integrity

Upholding ethical practices, transparency, and trust at every stage of production.

### Vision Statement

To become the worlds leading supplier of bulk organic and crude avocado oil, setting benchmarks for
sustainability, ethical sourcing, and global impact.

### From Ugandan Farms to Global Manufacturers - 100% Natural, Bulk Avocado Oil

Our cold-pressed avocado oil, sourced directly from Uganda's finest farms, is rich in healthy fats,
vitamins, and antioxidants. Available in bulk, it serves the needs of global food and cosmetic
manufacturers, offering unmatched quality in every tank.

### Core Values

###### Innovation

Constantly advancing bulk oil extraction techniques for optimal quality.

###### Sustainability

Ensuring eco-friendly and organic farming practices to protect the environment.

###### Customer-Centric

Tailoring bulk oil solutions to meet client needs in both culinary and cosmetic industries.

###### Integrity

Upholding ethical practices, transparency, and trust at every stage of production.

We only engage in socially, environmentally, and economically responsible practices in order to benefit everyone that handles our avocados in any stage of the process—from the farm, to you.

In the Ideal Growing Conditions of Kenya

Avopro EPZ Ltd is located in Sagana, Kirinyaga District, in Central Kenya. This is right in the heart of the highly fertile and productive agricultural zone of the Mt Kenya region.

## At Avopro, we consider ourselves to be more than just avocado oil processors.

We are a partner who is committed to delivering value to the farmer and the buyer through nurturing
relationships that bring about growth to both parties. Through fair wages, ethical labor, and a
robust quality management system, the quest for excellence drives our business and we ensure that it
is ingrained in our culture.

The contractual arrangements we have with our producers enable us to monitor production at farm
level, systematically harvest the avocados at the right maturity, and appropriately transport them
to our purpose–built factory. The producers in return get an assured market for their produce at a
competitive price. Once the hand–picked mature avocados are delivered to the factory, they are
naturally ripened. The avocado oil is mechanically extracted from the ripened avocado fruits using
the cold press method, which ensures we retain all the essential nutrients. We guarantee a
completely chemical and additive free extraction process.

##### We couldn’t do it without them.

Our journey as a company would not have been possible were it not for our great partners, the
avocado farmers. It is always our great joy when we see our partnership bringing significant change
in the quality of lives of our avocado farming community.

#### Inspired by Sagana

relationships that bring about growth to both parties. Through fair wages, ethical labor, and a
robust quality management system, the quest for excellence drives our business and we ensure that it

## Products

#### We offer organically and conventionally farmed oils, which can be shipped to you in a variety
#### of sizes, each of certified quality, to successfully fit your needs.

### Conventional Oil

Conventional oil is rich, smooth, and packed with nutrients from conventionally farmed avocados.
This variety is popular in a wide spectrum of industries including pharmaceutical, food service, and
cosmetics because of its many health-conscious benefits.

### Organic/extra virgin

This organic oil is made by processing organically certified fruit. Abundant with important
nutrients and rich in monounsaturated fats, this variety is in high demand in the food service,
pharmaceutical, and cosmetics industries.

### Crude/bulk order

Bulk order crude oil can be your best option if you are looking for a large quantity of oil. This
variety is produced by pressing, and is good for any industry requiring a substantial amount of oil.

### Flexitanks/Tankers

Flexitanks and tankers are two certified quality styles of trucks used for bulk oil deliveries. They
typically hold 22,000 kg of oil, and pump into on-site holding tanks used exclusively for oil
storage. This variety is oriented toward the culinary industry, as it is a healthy food-grade
packaging option.

Depending on the type of the oil, or it is or where it is coming from, you may receive either type
of truck.

### Caged Plastic Totes

Commonly used in high-volume production and manufacturing, certified quality totes are an
easy-to-use packaging size that saves money on oil and shipping cost. Totes contain 1000 kg of oil,
but if you aren’t sure if this is the right option for you, our team will assist in finding the
right packaging type and size to suit your needs.

### Drums

Certified quality drums are food grade steel barrels that hold up to 200 kg of oil, an average size
used in the manufacturing industry. In a warehouse setting, they are reasonably small which makes
them easy to move around and store while safeguarding the integrity of our products.

## The Kenyan Way
* [][16]
* [][17]

## At Avopro, we consider ourselves to be more than just avocado oil processors.

We are a partner who is committed to delivering value to the farmer and the buyer through nurturing
relationships that bring about growth to both parties. Through fair wages, ethical labor, and a
robust quality management system, the quest for excellence drives our business and we ensure that it
is ingrained in our culture.

The contractual arrangements we have with our producers enable us to monitor production at farm
level, systematically harvest the avocados at the right maturity, and appropriately transport them
to our purpose–built factory. The producers in return get an assured market for their produce at a
competitive price. Once the hand–picked mature avocados are delivered to the factory, they are
naturally ripened. The avocado oil is mechanically extracted from the ripened avocado fruits using
the cold press method, which ensures we retain all the essential nutrients. We guarantee a
completely chemical and additive free extraction process.

##### We couldn’t do it without them.

Our journey as a company would not have been possible were it not for our great partners, the
avocado farmers. It is always our great joy when we see our partnership bringing significant change
in the quality of lives of our avocado farming community.

#### Inspired by Sagana

Avopro is located in **Sagana, Kirinyaga District, in Central Kenya.** This is right in the heart of
the highly fertile and productive agricultural zone of the Mt Kenya region. The volcanic soils in
this expansive zone, coupled with good climate, offer conditions that are very conducive for
agriculture.

Most of our avocados are farmed in this region. The presence of our company here, in the heart of
the avocado growing zone of Sagana, provides a valuable source of employment for the community.

## The best team, made up of the best people.

We have a highly qualified and dedicated team of professionals. Our team’s expertise is firmly
grounded on cumulative experiences of more than 50 years in the avocado oil sector. We are very
passionate about what we do. We are sticklers for integrity, team work, and are relentless in our
pursuit for quality and customer satisfaction. With a team like ours, our esteemed customers can
always count on us to deliver products that meet internationally set standards in terms of sourcing,
processing and marketing.

As a company, we appreciate the critical role our partners play in the existence of our company.
This motivates us to always want to achieve the best for our suppliers and buyers.

## We aim to:

Create long-term shared value by engaging in socially, environmentally, and
economically responsible practices that benefit our stakeholders.

## We strive to be:

A leading producer of safe, high-quality products that are handled by
qualified & motivated staff.

## When you support us, you support our farmers.

Over 80% of our raw material is sourced from hundreds of contracted small–scale farmers, with the
rest coming from large scale farmers and prequalified independent suppliers.

We offer technical advice to the contracted farmers; this helps them meet quality and food standards
required for our markets. Our technical advice also helps the farmers achieve maximum production. We
do not confine the technical advice to the crops of interest, we extend this to all the farm
activities in a way that truly creates value for the farmer.

Our main aim in working with smallholders is to convert them from subsistence farming into a cash
economy as a way of poverty eradication. We encourage youth and gender participation in our farmer
programs.

* [][22]

## High level quality, high level production.

In accordance to the EPZ Act of Kenya, we sell 20% of our avocado oil output locally. We export the
remaining 80% to our clients in the international market. Our engagement with the market, both local
and international, is firmly grounded on our dedication to quality delivery. At Avopro EPZ Ltd., we
are cognizant of the very high–quality standards the market expects of our products.

##### The quest for excellence drives our business and we ensure that this is ingrained in our
##### culture.

To make sure our products live up to these expectations, we use avocado fruit that is of the best
quality possible. In addition to this, we operate a high–end processing line that runs on the latest
technologies in the industry, and with a workforce that’s highly motivated and meticulously trained.
Our total quality management system makes it possible for us to confidently put out our products
into the market. We have an internal quality control system that is benchmarked to FSSC 22000. This
rigorous system enables us to comply with both local and international food safety standards.
The contractual arrangement we have with the farmers enables us to monitor production at farm level,
systematically harvest the avocados at the right maturity and appropriately transport them to our
purpose–built factory.

Bella Vado® Avocado Oil

At Bella Vado, we proudly craft America’s original cold-pressed avocado oil—right here on our family farm in Southern California. Every drop of our golden-green oil begins with hand-selected, California-grown avocados, harvested at peak ripeness and cold-pressed within hours to preserve their full flavor, vibrant color, and powerful nutrients. As the first U.S. producer of unrefined, unfiltered avocado oil, we’ve stayed true to what matters: quality, integrity, and real food. Our oil is never chemically extracted, deodorized, or altered—just 100% pure, extra virgin avocado oil made the traditional way. Bella Vado avocado oil is: USA-made, from California-grown avocados Cold-pressed, unrefined, and unfiltered Naturally Non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, and high in heart-healthy fats A versatile culinary oil perfect for dressings, sautéing, roasting, and more From our grove to your table, we invite you to taste the difference that freshness, family values, and California sunshine make.

The Heart of the Avocado

Looking back, it’s hard to believe how quickly it all flew by. Late-night bottling parties where we called in all our kids and their friends—well bribed with pizza and music. Grueling 72-hour oil pressing marathons with rotating sleep shifts—while half of us still worked full-time jobs. We were all in. We hustled. We stayed heads down. We loved the craft of turning our avocados into oil. We poured ourselves into perfecting our oil, always analyzing, adjusting, and improving our process year after year. To us, It was always more than a product available on store shelves, quietly traveling in your shopping cart and then patiently sitting on your kitchen counter.
Bella Vado is the heart of the avocado!

#### **ABOUT OUR CERTIFIED ORGANIC AVOCADO OIL:**

California avocados, at the peak of perfection, cold-pressed and bottled on our California family
farm.

Bella Vado is proud to be the ORIGINAL USA avocado oil producer of cold-pressed, unrefined,
unfiltered, NON-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Certified Organic, extra virgin avocado oil (say that 10
times fast).

Each bottle is hand filled, sealed, labeled and packaged by the Bella Vado family. We take great
care in the pressing of our avocado oil using old-world artisan techniques combined with new world
technology.

**Please note: **We are **unable to offer a case discount** on Organic avocado oil at this time.

#### **HOW TO USE IT:**

Avocado oil is one of the most versatile oils on the planet, it makes an especially delicious and
healthy culinary oil. It can be used for salads, grilling, drizzling, finishing, bread dips and
stir-frying. Avocado oil can withstand the high heat of at least 450 degrees Fahrenheit.

#### **WHY IT'S HEALTHY:**

Avocado oil is high in mono-unsaturated fats, Vitamin A, B1, B2, D, E and K. It also is a great
source of Omega-3 Fatty Acids, Lutein, and Oleic Acid.

Bella Vado avocado oil is 100% natural with no additives, preservatives or refinement. We never
dilute our oil with cheaper refined oils, you will always receive the highest quality extra-virgin
oil.

For more information on how Avocado oil compares to other oils please reference this chart
by [Information is Beautiful][44].

For details about the standards follow to produce our avocado oil, check out Bella Vado’s pressing
guidelines at [AOCS.org][45]

### **15 of our standard bottles in each gallon plastic jug!**

Large family? Active Chef?

If avocado oil by the case just isn't enough, this is the one for you.

A handful of our loyal customers personally requested the gallon size avocado oil. We responded to
those requests and the gallon jug is now available online to all our customers.

**NOTE:**

This is our conventional avocado oil.

Recommend consuming within 6 months of opening. Additionally, we recommend transferring oil from the
plastic jug to glass or stainless steel containers for storage up to 6 months.

Gallon jugs require additional fulfillment and shipping time. The jugs are filled after the order is
placed to minimize the amount time the oil is in contact with plastic.

Organic Avocado Oil not available in gallon jugs.

**ABOUT OUR AVOCADO OIL:**
Bella Vado is proud to be the ORIGINAL USA avocado oil producer of cold-pressed, unrefined,
unfiltered, NON-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, extra virgin avocado oil (say that 10 times fast).

Each bottle is hand filled, sealed, labeled and packaged by the Bella Vado family. We take great
care in the pressing of our avocado oil using old-world artisan techniques combined with new world
technology.

**HOW TO USE IT:**
Avocado oil is one of the most versatile oils on the planet, it makes an especially delicious and
healthy culinary oil. It can be used for salads, grilling, drizzling, finishing, bread dips and
stir-frying. Avocado oil can withstand the high heat of at least 450 degrees Fahrenheit.

**WHY IT'S HEALTHY:**
Avocado oil is high in mono-unsaturated fats, Vitamin A, B1, B2, D, E and K. It also is a great
source of Omega-3 Fatty Acids, Lutein, and Oleic Acid.

Bella Vado avocado oil is 100% natural with no additives, preservatives or refinement. We never
dilute our oil with cheaper refined oils, you will always receive the highest quality extra-virgin
oil.

For more information on how Avocado oil compares to other oils please reference this chart by
[Information is Beautiful][44].

For details about the standards follow to produce our avocado oil, check out Bella Vado’s pressing
guidelines at [AOCS.org][45]

# Authenticity in Every Drop

Catania Oils is the trusted supplier of plant-based oils for every scale of business. From authentic
olive and vegetable oils to avocado and specialty blends, we pair proven quality with responsive
service, market insight, and packaging that fits your operation.
[Discover Our Legacy][70] [Explore Product Catalog][71]
[olive branch lineart light green cropped]

## Our Oils

Oil isn’t a side category, it’s our entire craft. With over 125 years of expertise, we source
globally, test every batch in-house, and deliver with full documentation. Whether our oils carry
your private label or become a core ingredient in your creation, you can trust us to protect your
brand with quality, consistency, and care.

Olive Oils

Olive oil is where our story began, and it remains at the heart of what we do. From Extra Virgin to
Light Tasting and Pomace, our portfolio delivers dependable flavor, heat performance, and
versatility for retail, foodservice, and private label programs.

[See Olive Oils][72] [Product Catalog][73]
Olive Oil Blends

Our blends balance olive flavor with dependable high-heat performance. We pair EVOO, olive oil, or
pomace with vegetable or sunflower oils to create flexible options for cooking and custom
formulations. Choose from trusted ratios or request a blend tailored to your goals.

[See Blends][74] [Product Catalog][75]
Vegetable Oils

For teams that need consistency at scale, our soybean, canola, corn, and sunflower oils support
frying, baking, and blending with ease. Many options are organic or Non-GMO Project Verified, and
every choice is backed by rigorous quality testing.

[See Vegetable Oils][76] [Product Catalog][77]
Tropical Oils

From baked snacks to plant-based spreads to wellness and skincare products, our coconut oils and
RSPO-certified palm oils deliver the texture, stability, and clean-label attributes makers rely on.

simplicity for theaters and foodservice.

[See Popcorn Oils][84] [Product Catalog][85]
Butter Alternatives

without dairy or common allergens. It stays pourable, saves fridge space, and performs beautifully
for sautéing, grilling, sauces, and high-volume kitchens.

beloved worldwide. Southern California is one of the leading growing regions for Hass and Organic
production is on the rise. In addition to growing our own fruit, we source fruit from local growers

Gem Avocados are pear-shaped with textured skin and flecks of gold color. Our Organic Gems have a
rich, creamy flesh that’s high in oil content and fantastic flavor! We guarantee it will be a
favorite.

In addition to growing our own fruit, we source fruit from local growers who put great care into
their groves and trees. You can taste the difference as we don’t hold fruit for long periods of time
in coolers or gas chambers post harvest. We pick the fruit and pack it to order so you can be
assured of the freshest quality. And we only grow and handle Certified Organic Avocados so rest
assured no pesticides or harmful chemicals have ever come near to the tree or fruit you're
purchasing from us.

Gem Avocados ripen within 5-7 days at room temperature. The fruit is ripe when soft and the skin has
changed to a dark purple/black color.

biodegradable, compostable 6 pack container. This pack is a great way to reduce waste and store your

fruit, we source fruit from local growers who put great care into their groves and trees. You can

harvest. We pick the fruit and pack it to order so you can be assured of the freshest quality. And
we only grow and handle Certified Organic Avocados so rest assured no pesticides or harmful
chemicals have ever come near to the tree or fruit you're purchasing from us.

Hass Avocados ripen within 5-7 days at room temperature. The fruit is ripe when soft and the skin

Organic Passionfruit grows very well in San Diego county. The vigorous vines respond with incredible
growth and fruit production to the long hours of sunlight in our region. Passionfruit vines are
suspended on specially designed trellises to help them set maximum fruit and allow for easy
harvesting.

Passionfruit is sweet and tangy with small edible seeds that provide a nice texture. Simply cut in
half and scoop out the pulp with seeds. It's delicious on yogurt, in smoothies, in preserves, as a
juice, and other ice cream. Passionfruit is high in antioxidants such as Vitamin C and A. It is also
high in fiber and magnesium. It can help promote effective digestion, provide immune system support,
and help build healthy skin.

We love this fruit and are sure you will too!

Made by Southern California Bees, our Wildflower honey is a lighter version of our popular Avocado
Honey. The bees visit all types of flowers to collect nectar when making the Wildflower honey and
the result is a sweet, light amber colored syrup that tastes amazing on fresh baked goods or to
sweeten your tea. The Wildflower honey has unique berry-like notes to go with an intense sweet
flavor. Our honey is strained through a coarse filter to remove large particles of beeswax and bee
parts but not enough to take out beneficial pollen from the mixture. The result is a highly
beneficial elixir to be used in many ways; Honey is an effective medicinal remedy as well as a
nutritionally dense food containing antioxidants, proteins, amino acids, minerals, and organic
acids.

Home

Pure, natural oils. Ethically produced.

Fairoils leads the way in the responsible and ethical production of quality essential and vegetable oils. Our partnerships support local growers and strengthen communities in Africa.

Get in touch

Learn about our impact

We believe that responsible business makes the world a better place.

At the heart of Fairoils is the determination to help farmers and communities in Africa.
From seed through to supply, we manage every step of the production process. This stewardship allows us to embed ethics and quality at every stage.
The result is pure, natural oils, produced to the highest ethical standards.

Fairoils embraces the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals as a clear blueprint for the prosperity of people and our planet. We’re advancing these goals across our operations.​

Find out how

Local cooperatives with real reach.

We know what’s possible when people work together, bonded by a common goal. Fairoils unites the efforts of small-scale growers, commercial farms and local processing facilities to make a difference.

Small scale grower projects

Our growers work as a collective, gaining a secure, additional income.

Learn about our impact

Commercial farms

Commercial farms help secure supply and demonstrate co-commitment.
Learn about how we farm

Processing facilities

Crops are processed in state-of-the-art processing facilities in Kenya & Madagascar.
Learn about processing

Our projects in Africa

Each of our projects is shaped by the local community. Through careful design, we create meaningful impact at every step.

Learn about our impact

Skills and income for farmers.

Our grower projects establish a farming cooperative between small-scale farmers. We foster the skills farmers need to successfully grow crops for essential and vegetable oils. We also make resources more accessible—seed, organic fertiliser, equipment and education.
And we help local farmers find new ways to work together, so they can collectively reach new markets. Fairoils ensures that farmers gain secure, reliable income. Our farmers are paid quickly, receiving a fair and transparent price for their crop.

Our fair trade commitment

OUR PROJECTS

Madagascar

Our grower projects establish a farming cooperative between small-scale farmers. We foster the skills farmers need to successfully grow crops for essential and vegetable oils. We also make resources more accessible—seed, organic fertiliser, equipment and education.
And we help local farmers find new ways to work together, so they can collectively reach new markets. Fairoils ensures that farmers gain secure, reliable income. Our farmers are paid quickly, receiving a fair and transparent price for their crop.

Over 50 pure, natural oils.

We’re proud to supply essential and vegetable oils to world-leading brands that share our commitment to ethical production. We produce oils of the highest quality and purity.
Our innovative business model allows us to supply large volumes of vegetable and essential oils, year round.

Home

Pure, natural oils. Ethically produced.

Fairoils leads the way in the responsible and ethical production of quality essential and vegetable oils. Our partnerships support local growers and strengthen communities in Africa.

Get in touch

Learn about our impact

We believe that responsible business makes the world a better place.

At the heart of Fairoils is the determination to help farmers and communities in Africa.
From seed through to supply, we manage every step of the production process. This stewardship allows us to embed ethics and quality at every stage.
The result is pure, natural oils, produced to the highest ethical standards.

Fairoils embraces the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals as a clear blueprint for the prosperity of people and our planet. We’re advancing these goals across our operations.​

Find out how

Local cooperatives with real reach.

We know what’s possible when people work together, bonded by a common goal. Fairoils unites the efforts of small-scale growers, commercial farms and local processing facilities to make a difference.

Small scale grower projects

Our growers work as a collective, gaining a secure, additional income.

Learn about our impact

Commercial farms

Commercial farms help secure supply and demonstrate co-commitment.
Learn about how we farm

Processing facilities

Crops are processed in state-of-the-art processing facilities in Kenya & Madagascar.
Learn about processing

Our projects in Africa

Each of our projects is shaped by the local community. Through careful design, we create meaningful impact at every step.

Learn about our impact

Skills and income for farmers.

Our grower projects establish a farming cooperative between small-scale farmers. We foster the skills farmers need to successfully grow crops for essential and vegetable oils. We also make resources more accessible—seed, organic fertiliser, equipment and education.
And we help local farmers find new ways to work together, so they can collectively reach new markets. Fairoils ensures that farmers gain secure, reliable income. Our farmers are paid quickly, receiving a fair and transparent price for their crop.

Our fair trade commitment

OUR PROJECTS

We’re proud to supply essential and vegetable oils to world-leading brands that share our commitment to ethical production. We produce oils of the highest quality and purity.
Our innovative business model allows us to supply large volumes of vegetable and essential oils, year round.

## Ylang ylang

Cananga odorata

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Ylang ylang

[DSC03640]
[DSCF8925]
[IMG_0387]
[IMG_0728]
[ylang flower (4)]

With its rich, heady fragrance, ylang ylang is widely considered the ‘flower of flowers’. Its
potential as a fragrance was noted in the nineteenth century by French perfumers.

Ylang ylang oil is distilled from the yellow, star-shaped flowers of the ylang ylang tree. This
plant is endemic to the lush, tropical rainforests of Indonesia and the Philippines.

Ylang ylang trees have been cultivated for centuries on the islands off the east coast of Africa,
namely The Comores, Reunion and Nosy Be (Madagascar).

Fairoils grows ylang ylang across two key projects—one on Nosy Be, an island off the north coast of
Madagascar, and one on the south coast of Kenya. Ylang Ylang is also planted at the Fairoils
Landless project, in the middle of the Lunga Lunga outgrowers group.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

#### Ylang ylang production and extraction

The ylang ylang tree belongs to the Annonaceae family, which is the largest group within the
magnolia species. This fast-growing tree grows up to 35 metres and requires pruning and training to
keep flowers low and harvestable from the ground.

Ylang ylang flowers all year round. Across our farms, the flowers are picked each day, early in the
morning. Harvesting before sunrise helps preserve the blossoming flowers from the heat of the day.

Ylang ylang flowers can only be picked by hand, once the flowers have reached the right maturity.
This skill is traditionally undertaken by the females within our partnering African communities.
Often, you can hear collectors singing together during the early morning harvests.

Ylang ylang flowers are hydro distilled for five hours in purpose-built, stainless steel
distillation units. We produce four oil fractions (ylang ylang extra, ylang ylang grade 1, ylang
ylang grade 2 and ylang ylang grade 3) and a complete oil (containing all fractions) within our
processing facilities.

Ylang ylang extra and first grade are considered the highest quality fractions and are used in
perfume-grade fragrance products. These highest-grade fractions are captured during the early stages
of distillation, while the lower, heavier fractions are extracted later in the distillation process.
We also produce a complete oil which contains all fractions.

###### Fairoils can produce and supply up to 20 metric tonnes of ylang ylang oil per year.

## Fresh ginger

Zingiber officinale

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Fresh ginger

[DSC04627]
[IMG_9179]
[DSC03562]
[Kenya_Ginger-21]
[DSC03569]
[IMG_1753]

Ginger is an ancient and truly versatile spice and was one of the very first spices to be exported
from Asia to Europe through the infamous spice trade.

Fresh ginger oil is extracted from the root or rhizome of the herby perennial and is an attractive
plant often used in landscaping in subtropical gardens with white and pink flower buds and long
reed-like leaves.

Ginger originated in the southern parts of ancient China and then spread to India, greater Asia and
eventually down into Africa where Arab traders brought it to Zanzibar off the coast of Tanzania.

Fairoils has two ginger grower-projects; one located around Mananjary in the south east of
Madagascar and the other one at the foothills of Usambara mountains of northern Tanzania, close to
the Kenyan boarder. We also source fresh ginger root from small-scale farmers in Uganda as needed.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

#### Fresh ginger production and extraction

The ginger plant belongs to the Zingiberaceae family –root-based plants including turmeric, cardamom
and galangal. The seed or rhizome is planted in well-ploughed and well-drained soil mounds for
optimum growing conditions.

Fairoils processes Fresh Ginger throughout most of the year between Tanzania and Madagascar. Our
Tanzanian harvest is from May to October, while in Madagascar it starts in March and can last until
November.

Our ginger projects involve large numbers of small-scale farmers. We have more than 2,500 ginger
farmers between the Tanzanian and Madagascan projects. Both locations have fertile soil with a humid
climate and regular rainfall, which is ideal for ginger farming. Combined they produce around 3.75
million kg of fresh ginger roots.

Extraction of the oil is by hydro-distillation after first crushing the fresh rhizome prior to
loading. The heat source for Fairoils’ distillation is from bio-mass boilers fired by our own bio
waste briquettes. Ginger oil yield is typically low and therefore a large volume of fresh ginger
root is required.

Fairoils supplies all the relevant technical and quality documents on request.
Packaging: 5kg, 25kg & 180kg drums

## Tea tree

Melaleuca alternifolia

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Tea tree

[IMG_5739]
[Photo Jun 24, 08 19 56]
[Photo Jun 24, 07 55 25]
[Weleda Kenya Trip Sept11 127]
[Kenya_TeaTree-73]

Indigenous Australians have been using tea tree for its health benefits for thousands of years.
British colonists and explorers noted Aboriginal people drinking a hot healing drink infused with
melaleuca leaves and named the plant “Tea Tree”. Tea tree oil is now commonly known as a strong
natural antiseptic, with proven anti-microbial, anti-viral and anti-fungal properties.

Tea tree oil is distilled from the green leaves and younger branches of the Melaleuca alternifolia
tree. It is a is a sub-tropical tree endemic to the east coast of Australia.

Tea tree first became a commercial crop in the 1920s in Australia but now grows well in other
similar climates such as Kenya, where Fairoils grows it both commercially and, with small-scale
farmers.

Fairoils has two out-grower projects and two commercial farms producing tea tree oil in Kenya: one
project in the Kenyan Highlands around Mt Kenya and the second project is on the Kenyan coast, near
the Tanzanian border. Fairoils proudly has more than 1,500 growers farming tea tree in Kenya.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

#### Production and extraction

The tea tree belongs to a genus of 300 species of plants in the Myrtaceae family – trees that all
contain essential oils, including eucalyptus. Though they can grow to over 15 tall, tea tree is kept
to a fairly low ‘shrub’ height where it is cut and then re-grows quickly.

It is a very hardy tree which can withstand flooding, fire and drought – so is well suited as an
out-grower crop for small-scale farmers of Southern & Eastern Africa.

Fairoils’ harvests tea tree throughout the year as Kenya, where we primarily grow, sits on the
equator. Fairoils has three tea tree distilleries in Kenya: in the Mara in Laikipia (Mt Kenya) and
on the Kenyan coast at Lunga Lunga. Fairoils distils tea tree with wet steam on large European
stainless-steel stills.

Distillation is best done when the leaves and branches have been freshly cut so Fairoils distils all
tea tree on site. The process takes roughly two and half hours.

Tea Tree oil’s largest component is an active called Terpinene -4-ol which signifies the quality of
the oil. Fairoils supplies all the relevant technical and quality documents on request.
Packaging: 5kg, 25kg & 180kg drums

## Rose geranium

Pelargonium graveolens

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Rose geranium

[IMG_5734]
[IMG_4210]
[IMG_4207]
[Kenya_Geranium-40]
[IMG_4213]

Rose geranium oil is prized for is strong rose-like floral fragrance and is used extensively as an
ingredient in perfumes and body-care.

While Pelorgonium graveolens is endemic to Southern Africa, it was first cultivated for essential
oil in France in the 17th century. The plant was subsequently re-exported to the French ‘colonies’,
namely the islands of the Comores, Reunion (originally called Île de Bourbon) and Madagascar.

Rose geranium oil is distilled from the flowers and oil-laden leaves of the variety Pelorgonium
graveolens. Fairoils’ Kenyan rose geranium genetics were originally sourced from the island of
Reunion, and hence we refer to our oil as a “Bourbon-type” Rose Geranium.

Fairoils has established a small-scale grower project encompassing 1,200 farmers successfully
growing rose geranium in the foothills of Mt Kenya in the Kenyan highlands.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

#### Production and extraction

Rose geranium is a fast-growing perennial shrub with over 300 recorded varieties – yet only a few of
those produce an essential oil.

A heavily aromatic plant, its aroma is released simply by brushing its velvety-soft leaves. The
flowers, which range from white to pink are delicate and are not the key component for harvesting.

Fairoils’ project is located close to the equator, in ideal growing conditions, which means the crop
can be harvested every four months -delivering three harvests per year for our Kenyan farmers. The
crop is harvested on the first sign of flowering, when oil yields are high.

Fairoils processes its rose geranium oil in its own central processing facility on-site within the
Mount Kenyan projects. Fairoils distils the harvested biomass with wet-steam generated by bio-mass
boilers run on bio-waste briquettes.
Rose Geranium oil has a complex composition which varies according to altitude and climatic
conditions. The oil Fairoils produces in Kenyan Highlands is rich in geraniol, citronellyl formate
and citronellol. Fairoils supplies all the relevant technical and quality documents on request.
Packaging: 5kg, 25kg & 180kg drums

## Cinnamon bark

Cinnamomum zeylanicum

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Cinnamon bark

[YlangYlang-19]
[Silhouette of Beautiful Cinnamon leaves growth in herb botanical garden,with natural glare
light.Tropical botanical trees.Close up of multiple foliage.Selective focus.]
[The real cinnamon tree is a type of plant within the laurel family. This is grown in tropical
countries like Zanzibar or Madagascar.]
[IMG_7459]
[IMG_4486]

An instantly recognisable aroma, cinnamon is one of the most commonly-used spices with an extensive
list of uses. Cinnamon bark itself has been traded as a spice for over 4,000 years and is considered
one of the oldest and most valuable of all spices – with a wide variety of use as both flavour and a
fragrance.

Cinnamon is a small tropical tree native to Sri Lanka and Indonesia, but now grows widely in
tropical regions around the world, including East Africa and Madagascar. Cinnamon bark oil is
distilled from the crushed and dried bark which has been carefully stripped from the tree.

Fairoils grows cinnamon bark at two locations: one around Mananjary in the south east of Madagascar,
and the other one in the Usambara mountains of northern Tanzania – both from small-scale farming
groups.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

#### Cinnamon Production and extraction

The cinnamon tree belongs to the Lauraceae family and though it can grow to roughly 10-15 metres in
height, our farmers keep the tree lower in height for easier harvesting. The most superior and
highly-prized cinnamon variety is zeylanicum, which Fairoils’ produces.

Fairoils harvests cinnamon bark every two years. This involves the tree being cut down to ground
level and all woody matter (branches & trunks) collected. The bark is stripped from this material
after the tree has been coppiced and quickly regrows to be harvested again.

Fairoils has two projects; one around Mananjary in the south east of Madagascar, and the other in
the Usambara mountains of northern Tanzania, close to the Kenyan boarder. Our cinnamon bark comes
exclusively from small-scale farmers in these areas. We provide a vital alternative income stream
for farmers other than solely to the fickle spice industry (which is the dominant market for the
bark).

Cinnamon Bark Oil is rich in Cinnamaldehyde, Cinnamyl acetate and Eugenol acetate. Three key oils
are produced from different parts of the cinnamon tree – bark, leaf and root. Each oil has a
different primary constituent: cinnamaldehyde (in the bark oil), eugenol (in the leaf oil), and
camphor (in the root-bark oil). Cinnamon bark is the most commonly used for high-grade cosmetic use
for its aroma and chemical profile.

## Clove bud

Syzgium aromaticum

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Clove bud

[DSC03391]
[DSCF9103]
[IMG_0301]
[DSC03404]

Instantly recognisable and a common staple in spice draws around the world, clove is a key spice
used for its earthy, spicy aroma.

Clove bud oil is distilled from the flowering buds of the clove tree. Clove stem and leaf oil is
also produced by Fairoils, however Clove bud oil is considered the premium oil of the three. The
tree is endemic to the Maluku Islands in Indonesia, but now also grows in other tropical locations,
including Madagascar.

Clove was traded heavily in the Middle Ages through the infamous Indian Ocean Trade. This led to
seed being transported and then grown in other tropical locations including Zanzibar, and eventually
Madagascar, where Fairoils now grows it.

Our clove comes exclusively from small-scale farmers along the lower-east coast of Madagascar. These
farmers live in remote and challenging locations and farm trees which have been passed down through
their families for generations. We work with over 4,000 farmers scattered around the coastal town of
Mananjary.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

#### Production and Extraction

The clove tree belongs to the Myrtaceae family which are woody, oil-containing trees with flowers
that cluster in multiples of four or five. Clove trees grow well in low-elevation coastal regions,
with a tropical, humid climate and regular rainfall. The entire east coast of Madagascar is ideal
for clove growth and Madagascar is the second-largest producer of clove buds, behind Indonesia. The
tree reaches mature flowering at 20 years and these flowers develop into the fruit (bud) which is
picked and dried by our small-scale farming families. The harvest in Madagascar is between October
and January.

The clove bud oil is extracted by steam distillation at Fairoils’ own facility in Mananjary.
Fairoils steam-distils clove buds from raw material purchased during the harvest period. We process
using biomass boilers run on briquettes, which are compressed biowaste of distilled clove buds and
cinnamon bark.

All clove oils – bud, stem and leaf are rich in eugenol, but Clove bud is distinguished by its high
level of eugenol acetate. Fairoils supplies all the relevant technical and quality documents on
request.
Packaging: 25kg & 200kg drums

## Eucalyptus citriodora

Eucalytpus citriodora

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Eucalyptus citriodora

[Kenya_Citriadora -1]
[IMG_8201]
[DSC05088]
[Kenya_Citriadora -3]
[DSC05131]

Eucalyptus citriodora combines the benefits of a eucalyptus with the refreshing aroma after which it
is named – ‘citriodora’ is Latin for ‘lemon-scented’. Endemic to north-eastern Australia,
lemon-scented eucalyptus has been used by Aboriginals as a bush medicine for a variety of uses,
particularly to ward off unwanted insects.

Lemon-scented eucalyptus is distilled from the long, narrow, oil-rich leaves of the tree and has a
very high citronellal content.

Eucalyptus citriodora now grows in other countries outside of Australia including very successfully,
in Kenya – where Fairoils grows it both at Lunga Lunga on the Kenyan Coast (with out-growers), and
in the Mara.

Fairoils first ran a trial crop at Lunga Lunga before establishing a seedling nursery so that our
out-growers had access to hardy stock, prior to planting. The crop has been successful and is
harvested and processed very similarly to tea tree, which many of our farmers also grow – so the
skill-set has been very transferrable.

Fairoils continues to grow lemon-scented eucalyptus at both of these locations and will also soon
start planting out at Taita Taveta (also in Kenya), as another out-grower project – due to the
success and demand of the product.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

#### Eucalyptus citriodora production and extraction

Eucalyptus citriodora belongs to the Myrtaceae family and as a gum tree can grow to a great height
(up to 50 metres). Despite this, our farmers keep the tree relatively low and “shrub-like” to ensure
the trees remain ‘leafy’ and easy to harvest.

A healthy Eucalyptus citriodora will provide multiple harvests a year. Once the tree is cut or
‘coppiced’ it regrows quickly and leaves are best harvested when they are fresh. Much like tea tree
(Melaleuca alternifolia), Eucalytpus citriodora is a very hardy tree that can withstand fire, flood
and drought.

Fairoils processes Eucalyptus citriodora twice a year at its facilities on-site to ensure the leaves
are distilled as close to harvest as possible. This aids logistics for our farmers too.

Being a eucalypt, Eucalyptus citriodora has antibacterial and antifungal properties which make it
useful for specific functional use in the correct quantities. Eucalyptus citriodora’s largest
chemical component is Citronellal, an aldehyde (known for their strong aroma), which contributes to
its potent but very pleasant, sweet lemon aroma.

## Avocado

Persea gratissima

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Avocado

[IMG_1720]
[IMG_1591]
[DSC03041]
[IMG_7983]
[IMG_8068]

Avocado oil is unique because the oil does not come from the seed but rather the ‘fleshy’ part of
the fruit. Now widely recognised for its many health benefits, avocado oil is used both topically in
cosmetics and skin care, and for consumption as a healthy vegetable oil.

Avocado oil is the natural oil cold-pressed from the pulp of avocado fruit. We remove both the outer
skin and the stone of the avocado fruit prior to oil processing, thus ensuring the highest quality
oil.

The Avocado tree is endemic to Southern Mexico (It was first cultivated in Mexico around 500BC )and
has been consumed by humans for over 7,000 years.

Fairoils Avocado project is in Kenyan highlands and we source fruit from around Thika right up to
Embu in the North. Fairoils also has its very own organic out-growers group within the Thika growing
region. The main harvest season in Kenya is from April to July, but there is often a second shorter
season from September to October.

This project is also Fair Trade certified.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

#### Avocado oil production and extraction

The avocado tree belongs to the Lauraceae family and can grow to roughly 20 metres and needs a
warmer climate, with little to no exposure to frost. Botanically, it is actually a large berry with
a single large seed or ‘stone’ in the centre, which is discarded before pressing.

Avocado trees have been a key small-holder crop in Kenya for the last 20 years. A major exporter of
table fruit into Europe and the very selective nature of the export industry means a large portion
of fruit is rejected at the farm level. Fairoils provides these farmers a second income stream by
offering them a market for their rejected fruit.

Fairoils has recently upgraded its avocado processing facility at Athi River in Kenya. We now have a
state-of-the-art food-grade processing line, equipped with the latest German Tri-canter. This
separates the oil from the avocado solids and removes all traces of water in the
one-continual-process. The oil is further filtered and then winterised before being stored in
stainless steel tanks under a blanket of Nitrogen gas to preclude oxidation.

Avocado oil consists of almost 70% of heart-healthy oleic acid, a monounsaturated omega-9 fatty
acid. Additionally, around 12% of avocado oil is saturated and about 13% is polyunsaturated fat. The
oil is high in antioxidants and is a good source of both vitamin A & E.

Fairoils processing facility where it produces its Avocado oil is food grade certified to FSSC22000
and is also ISO9001 certified. Fairoils supplies all the relevant technical and quality documents on
request.

Fairoils has the capacity to produce 750mt of Avocado oil per year. We supply crude oil direct from
Kenya, and a refined quality from our Belgium facility.

## Macadamia nut

Macadamia integrifolia

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Macadamia nut

[Raw of Macadamia integrifolia or Macadamia nut hanging on plant.]
[Weleda Kenya Trip Sept11 165]
[DSC02322]
[DSC02124_1024]
[DSC02692]

The Macadamia nut tree is an ancient tree tracing its origin back 50 million years ago to the
rainforests of the east coast of Australia. Macadamia nuts have been wild collected by Indigenous
Australians and eaten as a nutrient-dense bush food for over 50,000 years. Though endemic to
Australia, where European settlers first began commercially cultivating it in the 1800s, Macadamias
were farmed on a much larger scale in Hawaii and now grow extensively in other locations, including
Kenya.

Macadamia oil is the result of the cold-pressing of the inner kernel of the Macadamia nut, which has
to be cracked first. This outer shell is so hard Fairoils uses special machinery to do this job
without ruining the inner kernel.

Fairoils Macadamia project is in Kenyan Highlands and we source nuts often from the same farmers who
supply us with Avocado fruits. Fairoils also has its very own organic out growers’ group within the
Thika growing region where we exclusively buy all grades of “in-shell” nuts. This project is also
Fair Trade certified.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

#### Production and extraction

The Macadamia tree is an evergreen tree that belongs to the plant family Proteaceae, which is
indigenous to Australia and can grow to 12 metres in height.

Macadamia nut trees have been a major small-holder crop in Kenya for the last 30 years. The tropical
climate found around the equator in Kenya, along with the fertile soils found in the Kenyan
highlands, makes for ideal Macadamia growing conditions.

Fairoils conducts all macadamia processing at our Athi River facility, south of Nairobi, Kenya. The
very hard exterior shell of the Macadamia nut is cracked (and retained) to extract the oil-rich
kernel. Fairoils then cold presses on purpose-built oil presses to produce a pure & natural
macadamia nut oil. The oil is double-filtered before being stored in large stainless-steel tanks
capped with nitrogen, to preclude oxidation.

Kenya is a major food-grade kernel exporter into the US & Europe. The very selective nature of the
export industry means a large portion of nuts are rejected. Fairoils provides these farmers a
valuable second income stream by offering them a market for their rejected nuts. The main harvest
season in Kenya is from March to August, but often kernel exporters hold large volumes of nuts
allowing for rejected kernels to be available until October/ November.

The macadamia kernel has a very high oil content yielding 58% to 60% of oil by weight. Macadamia nut
oil contains one of the highest levels of monounsaturated fats amongst all food-grade oils including
Olive Oil. The oil is rich in essential fatty acids and also contains Omega 3, Omega 6 and Omega 7.

Fairoils processing facility where it produces its Macadamia nut oil is food-grade certified to
FSSC22000 and is also ISO9001 certified. Fairoils supplies all the relevant technical and quality
documents on request.

Fairoils produces around 200mt of Macadamia nut oil per year. We supply crude macadamia oil direct
from Kenya and a refined quality from our Belgium facility.

## Sesame

Sesamum indicum

[Home][2] / [Products][3] / Sesame

[DSC_0148]
[DSC_0180]
[DSC_0195]
[DSC_0114]
[DSC00798]

Sesame seed oil is one of the oldest oil-seed crops ever cultivated by humans, with use dating back
thousands of years. The crop has been recorded amongst texts and artwork of ancient civilisations
and has been used to make everything from wine and oil, to religious offerings and beauty products.

The flowering sesame plant is native to Sub-Saharan Africa but is naturalised in many countries
around the world – where it is typically grown for food, cosmetic and medicinal use.

While there are many varieties of sesame, Sesame indicum is the most commonly cultivated and is
extremely drought-resistant. This drought-resistance combined with its labour-intensive harvesting
methods, means sesame is a perfect crop for small-scale farmers in developing countries like Uganda,
where Fairoils sources its seeds.

Fairoils’ sesame seed oil project is a real success story – working with low-income subsistence
farmers in the Ochero County of Northern Uganda. Fairoils works with a trusted partner in Uganda who
provides field officers and extension staff as well, while co-ordinating the collection of the crop.
Additionally, it has involved the instalment of community wells throughout this project area to
ensure a more reliable clean drinking water supply, as well as the purchase of oxen to make the
ploughing of individual member’s fields easier.

Fairoils is also in the process of establishing another sesame project within its Lunga Lunga
project on the Kenyan coast.

[Request a Sample & Technical Specifications][4]

Sesame belongs to the Pedaliaceae family and is an annual plant growing from 50-100cms in height,
with sharp oval leaves. The flowers vary in colour from yellow to white to blue. The seeds are
contained in pods 2 to 8cm in length which naturally split open (‘shatter’) when it reaches maturity
– thus the famous saying “open sesame”!

Once the sesame seed has been collected from the farmers in Ochero, it is road-transported east
across the Kenyan border to Fairoils’ processing facility in Athi River. Fairoils secures seed at
the farm gate and pre-finances the purchase of seed to give farmers a secure market and fair price.
Each farmer has, on average, five acres of land on which they farm a variety of crops including
millet, sorghum and maize, along with cash crops like cotton and sesame. The farmers, through the
field officers, learn new techniques to manage this crop, ensuring they get the best possible yield
by managing soil conditions, and using more efficient harvesting techniques.

The sesame is harvested twice a year by hand before being transported to and pressed at, our
state-of-the-art equipment at Fairoil’s Athi River facility. The seed is screw-pressed at controlled
temperatures to reduce damage to the oil’s natural components.

Sesame seed oil is high in Omega 6 (Linoleic) fatty acids and has high antioxidant activity. Sesame
seed oil has a reputation as a stable oil, resistant to oxidation. This stability is attributed to
its tocopherol content. The total tocopherol content of sesame oil ranges from 330-mg/kg to
1010-mg/kg oil according to the Codex Standard. In addition, sesame seed oil’s stability is further
enhanced by the presence of major lignin compounds – sesamolin and sesamol, antioxidants which also
promote cell integrity.

# Our purpose

## Our purpose

Cananga odorata

### At Fairoils, we responsibly produce pure, natural oils.

Fairoils partners with thousands of small-scale farmers in Africa, ensuring they receive a fair,
reliable and transparent price for their crops.

Our business model benefits everyone involved—from local growers and their families to the clients
who share our values.

Together, we’re strengthening the livelihood of entire communities.

##### We’ve built an integrated supply chain, managing a production process that begins at the farm.
##### And we embed quality and ethical standards every step of the way.

### We grow alongside our farmers.

Fairoils was founded in 2013 by founded by Campbell Walter & Wayne Barratt, after working with
communities to produce natural oils for more than two decades. In the beginning, our crops were
grown solely on small-scale farms in Kenya and Madagascar. In 2017, we bought our first Fairoils
farm, as part of our long-term commitment to the region. Today, we offer an extensive selection of
100% pure essential and vegetable oils, derived from optimum growing and processing conditions.

### We’re driven to make a positive change.

Fairoils employs a passionate team, working in different countries throughout the world. Our people
are experts in their fields, from agronomy to industrial chemistry and quality assurance.

Fairoils’ diverse team speaks many different languages—Swahili, French, Flemish, German, Italian,
English and Japanese—but we all share a commitment to improving lives and communities.

Our team members have varied industry experiences, which helps us better meet the needs of the
communities we work with.

[ Meet our team ][2]

### We lead with our values.

We are proud to be suppliers of both certified organic and Fairtrade oils.

We build strong trade connections to help people out of poverty.

Our work culture prioritises people over profit.

We uphold the highest industry standards for quality and traceability.

Our oils are high quality, natural and 100% pure.

Conducting business ethically is embedded in everything we do.

### Meet the Fairoils group.

The Fairoils group brings together four companies, operating in different countries.

Fairoils EPZ and Fairoils SPL lead our production and distribution. Kutoka Ardhini and Fairoils
Madagascar are focused on farming, processing and working directly with small-scale farmers.
