**Who We Are**

Established in 2005, Shanghai Beyond Machinery is developing into a solid engineering and high-tech
enterprise, who is mainly specialized in supplying turn-key projects for fruit&vegetable,
milk&dairy, plant-based milk, fruit jam and sauce, beverage and juice processing lines to clients in
domestic and overseas. The company combines scientific research and development, process design
service, engineering contracting, equipment manufacturing, installation, commissioning and trainee
as an integrated.

Thanks to so many excellent staff in technical and marketing hardworking, through 15 years of
development, we have grown bigger with 400 registered employees and 75,000 square meters workshop
now. With strong hardware and software, we have the faith to keep providing excellent service to
clients beyond their expectations.

We adhere to food hygiene regulations, strictly control equipment quality, distribute in a more
flexible and invigorated working surrounding development, and help our customers be more successful
in the corresponding areas by offering better products and services.

We would like to cooperate with the same occupations to develop Chinese light industry machinery and
welcome warmly our old and new customers visiting and viewing.

**Beyond History and Milestone:**

—In the Year of 2005, Our President Mr. Hu and 6 other venture Partners Set up Beyond.

—In the Year of 2007, We have our own workshop in Fengxian District. Set Up 300TPD milk processing
line for Client; Business turnover reached $3.15 million.

— In The Year of 2009, We marched into the fruit Processing line. Built-up the largest date
processing line in domestic. Turnover is $11.4 million.

— In the Year of 2010, 35TPH Orange juice Processing Line Exported to Ghana and 5TPH tomato sauce
processing line exported to Australia. Turnover reached $14.28 million.

— In the Year of 2013, Setting up China’s largest herbal tea processing line for WangLaoJi, Turnover
reach $17.14 million.

— In the Year of 2015, we exported the 5TPH pineapple Processing line to Kenya. And we moved to our
new factory in Jinshan District. Business turnover is $25.7 million.

— In the Year of 2017, 5TPH Peach, Carrot and Blueberry Combined Processing line Exported to
Georgia. Turnover is $38.28 million.

— In The Year of 2019, We Opened a new branch in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province, The new workshop covered
about 50,000 square meters to meet the increasing equipment capacity requirements. Business turnover
is $44.28 million.

**Who We Are**

Established in 2005, Shanghai Beyond Machinery is developing into a solid engineering and high-tech
enterprise, who is mainly specialized in supplying turn-key projects for fruit&vegetable,
milk&dairy, plant-based milk, fruit jam and sauce, beverage and juice processing lines to clients in
domestic and overseas. The company combines scientific research and development, process design
service, engineering contracting, equipment manufacturing, installation, commissioning and trainee
as an integrated.

Thanks to so many excellent staff in technical and marketing hardworking, through 15 years of
development, we have grown bigger with 400 registered employees and 75,000 square meters workshop
now. With strong hardware and software, we have the faith to keep providing excellent service to
clients beyond their expectations.

We adhere to food hygiene regulations, strictly control equipment quality, distribute in a more
flexible and invigorated working surrounding development, and help our customers be more successful
in the corresponding areas by offering better products and services.

We would like to cooperate with the same occupations to develop Chinese light industry machinery and
welcome warmly our old and new customers visiting and viewing.

**Beyond History and Milestone:**

—In the Year of 2005, Our President Mr. Hu and 6 other venture Partners Set up Beyond.

—In the Year of 2007, We have our own workshop in Fengxian District. Set Up 300TPD milk processing
line for Client; Business turnover reached $3.15 million.

— In The Year of 2009, We marched into the fruit Processing line. Built-up the largest date
processing line in domestic. Turnover is $11.4 million.

— In the Year of 2010, 35TPH Orange juice Processing Line Exported to Ghana and 5TPH tomato sauce
processing line exported to Australia. Turnover reached $14.28 million.

— In the Year of 2013, Setting up China’s largest herbal tea processing line for WangLaoJi, Turnover
reach $17.14 million.

— In the Year of 2015, we exported the 5TPH pineapple Processing line to Kenya. And we moved to our
new factory in Jinshan District. Business turnover is $25.7 million.

— In the Year of 2017, 5TPH Peach, Carrot and Blueberry Combined Processing line Exported to
Georgia. Turnover is $38.28 million.

— In The Year of 2019, We Opened a new branch in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province, The new workshop covered
about 50,000 square meters to meet the increasing equipment capacity requirements. Business turnover
is $44.28 million.

Why Us[admin][158]2026-05-09T07:55:07+00:00

The process of creating valuable industrial liquid food and beverage processing projects requires
highly specialized equipment, skilled production workers, and knowledge of market requirements. As
the global leader in the design and development of equipment for liquid food and beverage, we offer
a complete range of machines with a high degree of flexibility and efficiency. Whether you are
looking for high-capacity plants or small specialized units, we can supply you with the optimal
solution.

As a customer at Beyond Machinery, you are ensured to be given the latest liquid food and beverage
processing technology and know-how no matter whether you are looking for turnkey solutions or
optimizing your existing processes. Our concept includes **consulting, installation, on-site
training, food technology know-how, and maintenance**. Whether you are considering to begin
processing or need to evaluate your current setup and performance, we would highly recommend you to
contact our engineer specialist.

When you choose us, you will get:

## **Premium Quality Machines**

**—Fully skilled workers**

We have all kinds of machining workers with above 10 years of experience in welding, lathe, bench
work, riveting, planer, milling and boring processes, which ensures machine parts are the same level
premium quality.

[welding worker]

**—High precision machining equipment**

All kinds of fully automatic or semi-automatic machining equipment such as laser cutting machine,
flange welding system, gantry milling, plate cutting machine, CNC lathe machine, arc welding
machine, machine surface grinder, most of the machines are imported from Japan and Taiwan, which
guarantee the high processing performance and produce high-quality machine parts.

[Universal cylindrical grinding machine][Universal cylindrical grinding machine]
[Bending machine][Bending machine]

[Taiwan Vcenter][Taiwan Vcenter]

**—3D Design ability**

Every unit machine is designed with 3D software, 3D layout, 3D piping, which ensure each project
installation and assemble would be easier and machine parts with higher precision.

[3D production line drawing][3D production line drawing]

**—International Famous brand parts**

The electrical components are the brains of the equipment and guarantee the high efficient running
of the whole production line. All the machine parts like PLC, touchscreen, motor, frequency
converter, photoelectric sensor, pneumatic parts, flowmeter, aseptic valves, temperature sensors are
adopted to first-class international brands and imported from Germany, Japan, France, United States,
etc.

## **Project Machines Orderly Production**

**—Project manager responsibility system**

For each project, we will assign a project manager who will uniformly arrange the project production
schedule and various project details as well as coordinate with other departments to ensure that
each project is delivered on time with quality and quantity.

[Project processing flowchart][Project processing flowchart]

**—Complete functional departments**

We have all the functional departments needed by engineering companies, every department cooperates
with each other to ensure the project moves forward smoothly.
* Project engineer department (15 staff)
* Electronic engineer department (33 staff)
* Mechanical engineers department (35 staff)
* Engineering installation and after service department (126 staff)
* Quality control department (14 staff)
* Production department (112 staff)
* Process R&D department (5 staff)
* Source Department (6 staff)

## **Excellent Service**

**—Presales service**

Our professional sales engineers will offer you free consultation:
* products processing flowchart

* workshop size and area suggestion
* PID drawing
* Product sample testing and checking
* All kinds of optimization design

**—On sale Service**

After the contract is signed, we will offer you:
* 3D drawing of the machine and production line
* Machine layout drawing and detailed PID drawing flowchart
* Real-time updating of production progress
* Temporary customized requirements by end-users

* Dealing with some other emergencies

**—After Service**

After the project is running in the clients’ factory, we offer:
* 12 months warranty. During warranty time, if the machine is in downtime, our engineers will come
to your site for fixing in 3 working days if need to on-site fixing. We can also fix the problems
through online guidance if the problems can be handled by end-users.
* Lifetime paid service after the expiration of the warranty period.
* Regular free professional maintenance service.

**—Value-added service**
* Carry out engineering and automation design according to process requirement and equipment
performance
* Diameter, flow and direction diagram of material pipelines and CIP and SIP pipelines in the

## **Hygienic Design & Food Safety**

In modern food manufacturing, hygiene is not optional — it is fundamental.

Our systems are designed with hygienic engineering principles to minimize contamination risks and
improve cleanability, including:
* Sanitary pipeline design
* Optimized CIP coverage
* Dead-leg reduction
* Full drainability
* Food-grade materials
* Stable aseptic processing systems

We understand that for dairy and beverage manufacturers, production stability and food safety
directly affect brand reputation and commercial success.

## **Automation & Smart Processing**

Modern food factories require more than manual operation.

Our systems can integrate:
* PLC automation
* SCADA systems
* Recipe management
* Data monitoring
* Production traceability
* Remote technical support

This allows customers to improve operational efficiency, reduce labor dependency, and maintain
consistent product quality.

* Efficient evaporation systems

**Who We Are**

Established in 2005, Shanghai Beyond Machinery is developing into a solid engineering and high-tech
enterprise, who is mainly specialized in supplying turn-key projects for fruit&vegetable,
milk&dairy, plant-based milk, fruit jam and sauce, beverage and juice processing lines to clients in
domestic and overseas. The company combines scientific research and development, process design
service, engineering contracting, equipment manufacturing, installation, commissioning and trainee
as an integrated.

Thanks to so many excellent staff in technical and marketing hardworking, through 15 years of
development, we have grown bigger with 400 registered employees and 75,000 square meters workshop
now. With strong hardware and software, we have the faith to keep providing excellent service to
clients beyond their expectations.

We adhere to food hygiene regulations, strictly control equipment quality, distribute in a more
flexible and invigorated working surrounding development, and help our customers be more successful
in the corresponding areas by offering better products and services.

We would like to cooperate with the same occupations to develop Chinese light industry machinery and
welcome warmly our old and new customers visiting and viewing.

**Beyond History and Milestone:**

—In the Year of 2005, Our President Mr. Hu and 6 other venture Partners Set up Beyond.

—In the Year of 2007, We have our own workshop in Fengxian District. Set Up 300TPD milk processing
line for Client; Business turnover reached $3.15 million.

— In The Year of 2009, We marched into the fruit Processing line. Built-up the largest date
processing line in domestic. Turnover is $11.4 million.

— In the Year of 2010, 35TPH Orange juice Processing Line Exported to Ghana and 5TPH tomato sauce
processing line exported to Australia. Turnover reached $14.28 million.

— In the Year of 2013, Setting up China’s largest herbal tea processing line for WangLaoJi, Turnover
reach $17.14 million.

— In the Year of 2015, we exported the 5TPH pineapple Processing line to Kenya. And we moved to our
new factory in Jinshan District. Business turnover is $25.7 million.

— In the Year of 2017, 5TPH Peach, Carrot and Blueberry Combined Processing line Exported to
Georgia. Turnover is $38.28 million.

— In The Year of 2019, We Opened a new branch in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province, The new workshop covered
about 50,000 square meters to meet the increasing equipment capacity requirements. Business turnover
is $44.28 million.

### specialized areas of expertise.

[Lets Grow Together][21]

### Freeze Dried Fruit

• 100% Natural Fruit
• Under 100 Calories per Serving
• Ready-To-Eat Freeze-dried Snack
• No added Sugar or Additives
• Grown and Prepared in Mexico
• No Refrigeration Needed
• 2 year shelf life
• Individually bagged for convenience

Available in Pineapple with Chili, Pineapple , and mango.

[Read More][22]

### Extra Virgin Avocado Oil

Our 100% Extra Virgin Avocado Oil is Non-GMO, collected from the first cold pressed extraction of
quality ripe fruit pulp, to give you a neutral fresh unique flavor. This makes it ideal for most
high-heat cooking processes including baking, stir-frying, deep-frying, searing, barbecuing,
roasting, and Sautéing.The end result is a smooth, rich avocado oil that’s ideal for cooking,
baking, finishing, and even skincare.

[Read More][23]

We appreciate your business and look forward to enhancing your business buying and supply chain
requirements.

# Wir sind der Schlüssel zur Lösung – seit 100 Jahren

Unsere jahrelange Expertise in Produktion und weltweitem Vertrieb macht uns zu einem verlässlichen
Partner für Ihren Erfolg. Unser Ziel ist es, uns als führende Experten in verschiedenen
Produktkategorien aus aller Welt zu etablieren und die komplexen Herausforderungen globaler
Lieferketten erfolgreich zu meistern. Dadurch möchten wir Ihnen langfristige und nachhaltige
Vorteile bieten.

Unsere Mission

## What we do Since 1925

### [ we create.
### ][17] [ we trade.
### ][18] [ we care.
### ][19]

neue Möglichkeiten hochwertige Produkte Lösungen für unsere Kunden Netzwerke ein immer
nachhaltigeres System
**mit** Passion Expertise Integrität Agilität Stolz
**um** unsere Zukunft unsere Mitarbeitenden die Natur unsere Kunden Märkte und Lieferketten
Unsere Werte

## So handeln wir
* ### Wir denken heute und morgen.

Wir stellen den Erfolg des Unternehmens in den Fokus unseres Handelns - jetzt und für zukünftige
Generationen.
* ### Wir sind bereit.

Wir sehen Chancen in Veränderungen und suchen aktiv nach externen Impulsen, um uns immer weiter zu
verbessern.
* ### Wir gestalten.

Wir machen es einfach. Wir gehen Aufgaben proaktiv an, übernehmen Verantwortung und setzen
schlanke Lösungen um.
* ### Wir sind klar und ehrlich.

Wir bauen Vertrauen auf, indem wir authentisch sind und das Richtige tun. Bei uns zählt der
Handschlag – wir halten unser Wort.
* ### Wir leben Augenhöhe.

Wir setzen im Team gegenseitig auf unsere einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und positiven Absichten.
Unterschiede bereichern uns.

## Unsere Geschichte beginnt

1925 gründete der Bremer Kaufmann Henry Lamotte das Unternehmen HENRY LAMOTTE IMPORT/EXPORT. Es
spezialisiert sich auf pharmazeutischen Lebertran aus Dorsch und Heilbutt mit hohem natürlichen
Vitamingehalt sowie auf "Livskraft"- Hautschutzsalbe.

1932

## Wir sind pharmazeutischer Hersteller

Kurze Zeit später qualifizierte sich HENRY LAMOTTE IMPORT/EXPORT als pharmazeutischer Hersteller.

1950er

## Die Ära von Hans Henry Lamotte

Hans Henry Lamotte prägte die Phase des Wiederaufbaus nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg maßgeblich. 1950
übernahm er das Unternehmen von seinem Vater und führte es aus den Trümmern in die Ära des damaligen
Wirtschaftswunders.

1959

## Wir vergrößern uns

1959 bezogen wir ein neues Firmengelände im Bremer Hohentorshafen mit Kontorbereich,
Lagermöglichkeiten und modernen Abfüllkapazitäten.

50er-60er

## Qualität und Vielfalt in Pflanzenölen

Wir stehen für Kompetenz und Qualität in pflanzlichen Ölen, Fetten und Wachsen. Neben
nordeuropäischen Lieferanten werden jetzt auch vermehrt mediterrane Quellen eingebunden. Wir
besuchen Produzenten und Anbaugebiete persönlich. Das Reisen in die Ursprünge ist nach wie vor ein
wesentlicher Bestandteil unserer Arbeit.

70er-80er

## Breite Produktpalette für viele Branchen

Die Bezugsquellen weiten sich auf den asiatischen Kontinent und darüber hinaus. Erfolgreich
verstetigt Henry Lamotte seine Präsenz in den verschiedenen Branchen: Pharma, Kosmetik,
Lebensmittel, Tiernahrung und chemisch-technische Industrie. Ein kontinuierlich weiterentwickeltes
Sortiment, starkes Wachstum und hohe Kundenzufriedenheit führen zu dynamischer Entwicklung in allen
Segmenten.

1990er

## Wechsel in die nächste Generation

1983 kam Otto Lamotte zur dritten Generation des Unternehmens, gefolgt von Henry Lamotte 1992.
Gemeinsam übernahmen sie die Verantwortung: Otto für 'Oils' und Henry für 'Food'. 1996 wurde das
Unternehmen offiziell von Hans Henry Lamotte an seine Söhne als neue Gesellschafter übergeben. Mit
einer vierköpfigen Geschäftsführung wurden die Geschäftsbereiche vorangetrieben. 1999 bezog das
Unternehmen eine neue Betriebsstätte im Bremer Güterverkehrszentrum (GVZ).

2000er

## Wir werden innovativer

2002 begann die Errichtung der Ölmühle Lipos an unserem früheren Standort am Hohentorshafen, wo wir
hochwertige Spezialitätenöle produzieren. Dieser Standort ist heute der Hauptsitz der Henry Lamotte
Food GmbH. Im GVZ erweiterten wir 2005 den Komplex um eine dritte Halle.

2006

## Wir fokussieren uns

Henry Lamotte Oils, Food und Services agieren als eigenständige Unternehmen mit dem gemeinsamen
Ziel, spezifische Kundenwünsche noch fokussierter umzusetzen.

2012

## Vierte Generation und nachhaltige Investitionen

Hermann Bosse, Neffe von Otto und Henry Lamotte, tritt 2012 als erster der vierten Generation in das
Unternehmen ein. 2018 beginnt Albert Lamotte, Sohn von Otto Lamotte, bei Henry Lamotte Oils. Es
folgen weitere Investitionen für nachhaltiges Wachstum, wie der Ausbau von Qualität, Technologie und
Infrastruktur.

2021

## Neue Impulse mit neuer Führung

2021 tritt Sebastian Drewes als neuer Geschäftsführer bei Henry Lamotte Food ein. Damit löst er
Henry Lamotte ab und sorgt für neue Impulse. In neuer strategischer Aufstellung agieren die drei
Geschäftsführer ab 2024 gemeinsam für die verschiedenen Gesellschaften von Henry Lamotte.

2025

## Wir feiern 100 Jahre Henry Lamotte

Seit 1925 produzieren und liefern wir mehr als nur Produkte – wir schaffen Verbindungen. 100 Jahre
voller Innovation, Leidenschaft und Partnerschaften, die wachsen. Danke, dass Sie Teil unserer Reise
sind und gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft gestalten!

## Unsere Geschichte beginnt

1925 gründete der Bremer Kaufmann Henry Lamotte das Unternehmen HENRY LAMOTTE IMPORT/EXPORT. Es
spezialisiert sich auf pharmazeutischen Lebertran aus Dorsch und Heilbutt mit hohem natürlichen
Vitamingehalt sowie auf "Livskraft"- Hautschutzsalbe.

1932

## Wir sind pharmazeutischer Hersteller

Kurze Zeit später qualifizierte sich HENRY LAMOTTE IMPORT/EXPORT als pharmazeutischer Hersteller.

1950er

## Die Ära von Hans Henry Lamotte

Hans Henry Lamotte prägte die Phase des Wiederaufbaus nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg maßgeblich. 1950
übernahm er das Unternehmen von seinem Vater und führte es aus den Trümmern in die Ära des damaligen
Wirtschaftswunders.

1959

## Wir vergrößern uns

1959 bezogen wir ein neues Firmengelände im Bremer Hohentorshafen mit Kontorbereich,
Lagermöglichkeiten und modernen Abfüllkapazitäten.

50er-60er

## Qualität und Vielfalt in Pflanzenölen

Wir stehen für Kompetenz und Qualität in pflanzlichen Ölen, Fetten und Wachsen. Neben
nordeuropäischen Lieferanten werden jetzt auch vermehrt mediterrane Quellen eingebunden. Wir
besuchen Produzenten und Anbaugebiete persönlich. Das Reisen in die Ursprünge ist nach wie vor ein
wesentlicher Bestandteil unserer Arbeit.

70er-80er

## Breite Produktpalette für viele Branchen

Die Bezugsquellen weiten sich auf den asiatischen Kontinent und darüber hinaus. Erfolgreich
verstetigt Henry Lamotte seine Präsenz in den verschiedenen Branchen: Pharma, Kosmetik,
Lebensmittel, Tiernahrung und chemisch-technische Industrie. Ein kontinuierlich weiterentwickeltes
Sortiment, starkes Wachstum und hohe Kundenzufriedenheit führen zu dynamischer Entwicklung in allen
Segmenten.

1990er

## Wechsel in die nächste Generation

1983 kam Otto Lamotte zur dritten Generation des Unternehmens, gefolgt von Henry Lamotte 1992.
Gemeinsam übernahmen sie die Verantwortung: Otto für 'Oils' und Henry für 'Food'. 1996 wurde das
Unternehmen offiziell von Hans Henry Lamotte an seine Söhne als neue Gesellschafter übergeben. Mit
einer vierköpfigen Geschäftsführung wurden die Geschäftsbereiche vorangetrieben. 1999 bezog das
Unternehmen eine neue Betriebsstätte im Bremer Güterverkehrszentrum (GVZ).

2000er

## Wir werden innovativer

2002 begann die Errichtung der Ölmühle Lipos an unserem früheren Standort am Hohentorshafen, wo wir
hochwertige Spezialitätenöle produzieren. Dieser Standort ist heute der Hauptsitz der Henry Lamotte
Food GmbH. Im GVZ erweiterten wir 2005 den Komplex um eine dritte Halle.

2006

## Wir fokussieren uns

Henry Lamotte Oils, Food und Services agieren als eigenständige Unternehmen mit dem gemeinsamen
Ziel, spezifische Kundenwünsche noch fokussierter umzusetzen.

### Our Products

#### Natural Spice Oils

[Natural Spice Oils]

Spice oil is a spice derivative that are extracted generally by steam distillation process.These
oils are the volatile components present in spices and provide the aroma and flavor of the spice
they are made from. India is one of the top most producers of spice oils and contributes to around
70% of the total spice oil production. Countries including USA, EU, Japan and other middle eastern
countries are major importers of spice oil. The exports of Indian spice oils has been rising
significantly in the last few years owing to a sharp rise of demand in the food sector. [Read
More][89]

#### Pure Essential Oils

An essential oil is a concentrated hydrophobic liquid containing volatile aroma compounds from
plants. Essential oils are also known as volatile oils, ethereal oils, aetherolea, or simply as the
oil of the plant from which they were extracted.An oil is "essential" in the sense that it contains
the "essence of" the plant's fragrance—the characteristic fragrance of the plant from which it is
derived.They are used in perfumes, cosmetics, soaps and other products, for flavoring food and
drink, and for adding scents to incense and household cleaning products.[Read More][90]

#### Natural Isolates

Natural Isolates are important in the development process of custom scents. Isolates can be valuable
when a specific scent is necessary for the creation of a specific scent profile, and when a certain
amount of delicacy is needed to create a fragrance. Ingredients such as these are important for
companies that are in search of pure, quality ingredients for lines emphasizing the natural healing,
restorative powers of Essential Oils and Isolates as well as for those companies which are seeking a
simple solution to their fragrance needs. [Read More][91]

#### Upcoming Products

Our upcoming products range includes calamus root oil, kapoor kachri oil, parsley seed oil, sugandh
mantri oil etc. These oils are extracted through very refined process with all quality check ups .
Calamus Root Oil is used for Rejuvenating the senses in times of occasional stress. Kapoor Kachri
Oil is useful in local inflammations, nausea, asthma, bronchitis, hiccups. Parsley Seed Oil is an
Antiseptic, Astringent . While Sugandh mantri essential oil is known for high purity and have a
mesmerizing aroma that makes them widely used in aromatherapy. [Read More][92]

We produce a cold-pressed avocado oil substitute with a focus on sustainable production and full compliance with International Standards

Production is carried out on an industrial scale using two production lines that operate year-round.
We manage the entire chain: from purchasing avocados to processing, packaging and export logistics.
We are located close to the raw material base, which allows us to significantly reduce logistics costs, minimize the environmental footprint and ensure uninterrupted supplies.
We supply high-quality oil that meets food safety and traceability standards.

Sustainable development and quality proven by our customers and time

Sustainable production
We strive for sustainable development, minimizing our ecological footprint. Our company actively implements the principles of environmentally friendly production at every stage.

Logistics optimization
The location of our production close to the raw material base allows us to significantly reduce logistics costs, which makes our deliveries more efficient and accessible.

High quality standards
We ensure that our avocado oil meets strict food safety and traceability standards, ensuring high quality and reliability for our customers.

We work with export traders working with organic oils, private label producers, distributors of edible oils and importers of natural products, retail chains working in the natural products segment and wholesale buyers.

Readiness for European requirements and standards

We work only with certified suppliers, which guarantees quality and compliance with standards. Products are accompanied by the necessary documentation to confirm organic production.
We know the specifics of document flow and logistics in the USA, UAE, Israel and the EU. This helps to effectively organize deliveries and avoid delays
We offer various packaging formats to meet customer needs. Whether it is small packages for retail or large volumes for wholesale, we can offer optimal solutions.
We value flexibility and individual approach to clients. We are ready to adapt offers to your needs to create long-term partnerships.

Interested in cooperation? Leave a request, we will contact you quickly and discuss the details.

Better in tin.

Perfecting the art of oil-making since 1867, we know the best oils deserve the best packaging. Our tin blocks 100% of light, keeping your oil fresher longer.

Shop Now

Find Us In Store

Family-Owned Since 1867

We are passionate about crafting the highest quality oils, made from carefully sourced, non-GMO virgin oils rich in flavor and nutrients. With a deep respect for tradition, we embrace small-batch, artisan production to ensure authenticity and excellence in every bottle.
For us, good food isn’t just about taste—it’s about nourishing people, supporting communities, and protecting the planet. Through regenerative farming, sustainable practices, and recyclable packaging, we’re here to empower home cooks to create with care.

Discover The Story

Why is Our Oil Better?

California Walnut Oil

Our Roasted Walnut Oil is slowly roasted, expeller-pressed from California walnuts for a tempting nutty flavor that elevates salad dressings, baked goods and any dish it’s drizzled over.

Shop Now

Why is Our Oil Better?

Toasted Sesame Oil

Our Toasted Sesame Oil has a delightfully bold and complex flavor that doesn’t overpower. Golden-brown and delicious, it adds rich nutty flavors to your vinaigrette, stir fry or marinade.

Shop Now

Why is Our Oil Better?

Smooth & Fruity

Versatile, fresh, and sourced from the best, this olive oil is bursting with antioxidants and beautifully balanced flavors. It’s always cold pressed from early harvested, organic Spanish Olives.

Shop Now

Why is Our Oil Better?

Bright & Peppery

This cold-pressed, organic Spanish olive oil boasts high antioxidants and a peppery finish. Each batch is made from early harvested olives, lab-tested and packaged in our signature light-blocking tins.

Shop Now

Why is Our Oil Better?

Full & Vibrant

We partner with small farms in southern Greece to create are generative certified oil, made exclusively from olives grown using sustainable practices for full flavor you can feel good about.

Shop Now

Why is Our Oil Better?

Rich & Robust

Sourced from the sun-kissed groves of California, this Extra Virgin Olive Oil brings a taste of golden warmth to your kitchen. With a medium-high smoke point, it’s as versatile as it is delightful.

Shop Now

Why is Our Oil Better?

Salads & Sauté

Pressed from the pulp of premium Avocados, this emerald-green oil combines Extra Virgin and refined Avocado Oils. It’s balanced flavor and high-quality make it perfect for medium heat applications.

curating only the finest sauces to bear the family name. Our authentic Mantova Pomodoro Sauce is
produced in Abruzzo, Italy, a region known for sweet, flavorful pasta sauces.

tomato sauce. Made with all-natural, high-quality ingredients: 100% Italian tomatoes. No additives,
preservatives, processed foods, or artificial flavors. Simply add spices (onion, garlic, pepper),

Through the generations, the Mantova family has become recognized as premier testers and tasters,
curating only the finest oils to bear the family name. Mantova proudly offers a pure, healthy oils
in a convenient spray bottle that are sure to give your food exquisite flavor and taste with a
little extra kick of flavor, whether it's chili, black truffle, lemon, or garlic that you prefer.

✅ Our 100% pure oils are a rich in flavor with lots of health benefits. It’s perfect for
worry-free, everyday use in the kitchen, whether cooking, seasoning, grilling, or baking. The oil
preserves its full flavor because of the spray bottle, specifically designed to preserve taste,
aroma, and healthy attributes of the oil. Our “bag in bottle” system protects the natural oil, so
you can spray lightly and evenly, without propellants, aerosol, or additives. The bag also protects
the oil from exposure to air and light, keeping it fresher longer.

✅ Mantova Oil Sprays are non-GMO, gluten free, cholesterol free, and rich with healthy fats and
antioxidants; perfect for adding to every meal. No need to feel timid about spraying onto finished
foods for a beautiful appearance as well as great taste. Mantova spray bottles bring all of the
healthy benefits of pure oils to your dishes — in just the right amounts for the recipes you love.

✅ This variety set includes four spray oil bottles (5 oz. each): Garlic, Lemon, Truffle, and Chili

Through the generations, the Mantova family has become recognized as premier testers and tasters,
curating only the finest sauces to bear the family name. Our authentic Mantova Pomodoro Sauce is
produced in Abruzzo, Italy, a region known for sweet, flavorful pasta sauces.

“Pomodoro” means “tomato” in Italian. And that’s exactly what this is, a simple, yet delicious
tomato sauce. Made with all-natural, high-quality ingredients: 100% Italian tomatoes. No additives,
preservatives, processed foods, or artificial flavors. Simply add spices (onion, garlic, pepper),
fresh herbs (oregano, basil, parsley), and extra virgin olive oil to the pomodoro sauce and gently
coat cooked pasta for a quick and delicious meal that the whole family will love.

ABOUT US

Our Mission

We are a Mexican company dedicated to the production, transformation, commercialization and export of avocado and derivatives at a global level, through the sustainability of our processes and through an organizational ethic based on collaborative work with its stakeholders.

Our Vision

Being one of the best Mexican companies in the avocado and derivatives industry, recognized for the quality of our products, for our commitment to the environment, for the development of our collaborators and our operational excellence.

Our Commitment

We are committed to socially responsible management as part of our business strategy, having a positive impact on the quality of life of our employees, the community that surrounds us and the environment.

The Future

At MEVI Avocados we approach the future with passion and confidence, with an enduring belief in the promise of avocado, a superfood that promotes the health and well-being of our consumers.

MEVI's foundation lies in 5 CORE VALUES:

TRUST We make sure that everyone involved with our company works with the same high purpose and ethics, driving significant positive outcomes for our company and industry.

RESPONSABILITY We are committed to supplying exclusively healthy products, like the avocado and its derivatives.

HONESTY We combine professionalism with integrity in all aspects of our business, including team members and suppliers.

RESPECT We recognize the capabilities and achievements of clients, team members and suppliers.

CUSTOMER SERVICE We offer excellent personalized attention and responsiveness from the moment of purchase until the delivery of our products, with the aim of fulfilling and exceeding the expectations of our customers.

ADVANTAGES OF OUR SERVICE

Experience: Overall knowledge of production and management of avocados since 1974. Market experience as a packer since 1994, and as an exporter―through APEAM―since 2003. Balanced Value Chain Method: MEVI pledges to provide the best service through this process, ensuring full control from planting the avocado, to its storage and distribution.

TIMELINE

Cold Storage: MEVI owns Crosspoint, Inc.a South Texas cold storage facility with a 60 container

capacity that serves as a primary distribution point.

Social Responsibility

International Presence

presence in 13 countries around the world.

Avocado oil contains a multitude of benefits for everyone, its high content of vitamins A, B1, B2, E, oleic acid and fatty acids such as Omegas 3, 6, 9 and Lutein combine a super oil that nourishes you while you enjoy food More rich. Take care of your heart! the amount of monounsaturated fatty acids in our oils help to reduce the levels of cholesterol and triglycerides, supporting you to prevent cardiovascular diseases.

Add a little extra virgin avocado oil makes your meals more nutritious! This is because there are substances that require fats to be properly absorbed by our body, as are the carotenoids (great antioxidants that are in our fruits and vegetables) is scientifically proven to add a little avocado oil in a normal salad It allows to absorb up to 17 times more nutrients ingested.

Watch out! Lutein is a substance that keeps our eyes healthy, however, our body does not produce it and must obtain it from the food we consume. Luckily avocado oil has large amounts of this substance, helping to prevent eye diseases.

Mevi Oil® targets consumers who seek to improve:

Lower high cholesterol levels

Healthy heart

Good source of vitamin E, Alpha Sitosterol, Beta Sitosterol, Lycopene and Lutein

Skin care

Minimize bad fats

Good source of Omega 3,6 y 9

ABOUT US

Our Mission

We are a Mexican company dedicated to the production, transformation, commercialization and export of avocado and derivatives at a global level, through the sustainability of our processes and through an organizational ethic based on collaborative work with its stakeholders.

Our Vision

Being one of the best Mexican companies in the avocado and derivatives industry, recognized for the quality of our products, for our commitment to the environment, for the development of our collaborators and our operational excellence.

Our Commitment

We are committed to socially responsible management as part of our business strategy, having a positive impact on the quality of life of our employees, the community that surrounds us and the environment.

The Future

At MEVI Avocados we approach the future with passion and confidence, with an enduring belief in the promise of avocado, a superfood that promotes the health and well-being of our consumers.

MEVI's foundation lies in 5 CORE VALUES:

TRUST We make sure that everyone involved with our company works with the same high purpose and ethics, driving significant positive outcomes for our company and industry.

RESPONSABILITY We are committed to supplying exclusively healthy products, like the avocado and its derivatives.

HONESTY We combine professionalism with integrity in all aspects of our business, including team members and suppliers.

RESPECT We recognize the capabilities and achievements of clients, team members and suppliers.

CUSTOMER SERVICE We offer excellent personalized attention and responsiveness from the moment of purchase until the delivery of our products, with the aim of fulfilling and exceeding the expectations of our customers.

ADVANTAGES OF OUR SERVICE

Experience: Overall knowledge of production and management of avocados since 1974. Market experience as a packer since 1994, and as an exporter―through APEAM―since 2003. Balanced Value Chain Method: MEVI pledges to provide the best service through this process, ensuring full control from planting the avocado, to its storage and distribution.

TIMELINE

Cold Storage: MEVI owns Crosspoint, Inc.a South Texas cold storage facility with a 60 container

capacity that serves as a primary distribution point.

Social Responsibility

Add a little extra virgin avocado oil makes your meals more nutritious! ## MURICADO FRUIT SUPPLIES FROM TANZANIA

Muricado is a large-scale producer grower and supplier of **Fresh **and** quality **avocados**.** We
grow avocados and proudly guarantee that our products are 100% free from chemicals and unnatural
products.

With adequate experience in **growing, packing** and **shipping** avocados, Muricado has a deep
understanding of the avocado industry. At Muricado we know it is a privilege to deliver avocados
from our grower’s trees to our customer’s shelves. Through our vertically-integrated supply chain we
grow, source, pack and market quality avocados across the year and across the globe.

Muricado Fruit Supplies proudly operates a state-of-the-art avocado oil facility dedicated to
producing high-quality, pure crude avocado oil. Our facility is equipped with advanced technology to
ensure efficient oil extraction while maintaining and preserving the natural nutrients, vitamins
antioxidants and the natural integrity of the avocados.

### Description

Preservative Eco offers broad spectrum protection in a diverse range of products and is widely
accepted in natural skin and hair care formulations.
* Certified cruelty free and vegan friendly
* Effective and easy to use
* Protects against the growth of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, yeast and mould
* Compatible for a wide range of natural self-care products
* Suitable for water in oil emulsions, oil in water emulsions and anhydrous products
* Can be used in anhydrous products that may come into contact with water such as body scrubs
* Water soluble

### Usage

Top Tip

Recommended use - 1%

Recommended pH - 3 – 8

Add during the cool down phase in emulsions below 40°C. Can be added directly in anhydrous products.

We recommended you use a weighing scales that weighs to 0.1g as measuring using drops to measure can
be inaccurate.

May crystallize upon exposure to cold temperature. Warm gently and mix before use.

Not recommended for formulations for children under 3 years old.

### Description

Expertly formulated to soften and nourish hair, our Organic Beard Oil is the perfect companion for a
strong and healthy beard. Crafted from a conditioning base of Castor, Argan and Jojoba Oil, this
strengthening beard oil coats hair strands and protects hair follicles, for a fuller, stronger beard
that grows.
* Castor Oil encourages beard hair growth
* Argan Oil prevents dryness and nourishes skin
* Jojoba Oil supports a healthy hair growth cycle and reduces breakage
* Natural, organic and sustainable ingredients
* Enriching antioxidants

### Usage

Beauty

Dispense a few drops of our beard growth oil in the palms and massage through beard and facial hair,
working through to the skin underneath. Use the sustainable wood comb to detangle and groom hair,
for a clean, polished look. For best results, use every day to strengthen and protect the beard.

Suitable for thick beards. For finer hair you can try using the beard oil as a night time leave-in
conditioner, and wash off in the morning to leave your hair soft and silky, ready for the day ahead.

### Description

Our Aloe Vera Gel is a unique formulation made from the fresh inner gel of the Aloe Vera leaf, and
not from concentrate. Soothing, cooling and moisturising for your skin, can be used on the body,
face and hair.
* Cruelty free and vegan friendly
* Refreshing
* Packed full of skin loving nutrients
* Suitable for all skin types, including mature skin
* Amazing for hair and skin
* Easily absorbed by the skin
* Perfect to quench sun parched skin
* Uses natural Aloe Vera grown using organic methods

### Usage

Beauty

Apply a small amount of gel post shave to soothe and cool the skin and to keep skin hydrated.

Aloe Vera Gel can be used in your own beauty formulations such as body scrubs, make up remover, and
many more. Why not try replacing your usual shaving cream with Aloe Vera Gel? It will soothe and
cool whilst helping the razor glide over your skin.

Skincare

Use as an all over body moisturiser, particularly useful after a day in the sun.

Hair

Aloe Vera is beneficial to your hair too. It will add moisture and help tame the frizz. You can add
it to your shampoo for a nutritious boost for strong, shiny hair.

### Key Facts

Key Facts

Latin Name: Aloe Barbadensis
Origin: Spain
Ingredients: Aqua (demineralized water), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Glycerin, Carbomer,
Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Disodium EDTA, Sodium Hydroxide

Extraction Method: Pulp is filtered and blended
Colour: Clear gel
Odour: Characteristic

Vegan: Yes
Organic: No

We describe and promote our products in good faith. The information given with regard to the

## About Us
* [ Home ][28]
* About Us

**Natura Vitalis Industries Pvt. Ltd.** is a well-established group engaged in manufacturing &
exports of **Nicotine EP/USP, Other Nicotine Products, Caffeine Extract, Natural Essential Oils,
Herbal Extracts & Oleoresins **on a large scale.

The company has 3 manufacturing units, unit 1 is situated at **Industrial Growth Centre, Chaygaon –
Patgaon – Jambari, Assam – 781141** for distillation of Fragrance and Essential Oils like Cypriol,
Lemongrass, Eucalyptus, Lavender, Oregano, Rosemary Oil etc. Unit 2 is in **SIDCO Industrial Estate,
Kappalur, Madurai, Dharmathupatti, Tamil Nadu – 625706** for manufacturing of Natural Caffeine &
Caffeine Anhydrous, along with Herbal Extracts. Unit 3 is located in **Hyderabad, Telangana** for
manufacturing of Oleoresins like Paprika Oleoresin, Capsicum Oleoresin, Turmeric Oleoresin etc.

Our products are exported across the globe and we have firm presence in **Europe, Asia, North
America, Canada, Australia, Middle East** etc. and continuing to expand throughout the world by
serving products of International standards.

[nvitalis corporate]

With many years of industrial experience, Natura Vitalis is a leader in sourcing and providing the
finest quality of products all over the world.

ur catalog features a range of stellar products for skin care, aromatherapy, health and wellness to
keep you and your body beautiful from inside out. We are a locally owned business, looking to take
on a natural and holistic approach to your health and everyday lifestyle. By helping you incorporate
the best-quality of essential oils in your day-to-day life, we wish to bring out the best of you,
inside and out.

Natura Vitalis Industries Pvt Ltd is an **ISO 9001: 2015 certified and GMP accreted company**. We
have ultra-modern in-house labs with latest high-tech GC-MS, HPLC, REFRACTOMETER, POLARIMETER etc.
and all our products comes with proper lab reports like **Certificate of Analysis, MSDS, Gas
Chromatography** etc.

[100% Natural]

#### **100% Pure and Natural—Nothing Added, Nothing Removed**

Our team is consistently growing and we are making a point by providing the absolute highest quality
100% pure and natural products, never compromising on the quality. Sourced for purity, quality and
ethics, our products are enjoyed in homes, aromatherapy, herbal cosmetics, drinks/beverages,
nicotine products and used by massage therapists, naturalists etc.

At Natura Vitalis, delivering the highest quality is our first priority. With professional expertise
behind developing the most effective solutions to meet the market demand of natural products, we lay
high emphasis on factors like quality of products, hygiene of workers, and packaging of the
products.

#### **The ISO 9001 Quality System**

**Natura Vitalis **has been awarded the ISO 9001 certificate for quality, what this means is that we
have established and apply a quality management system in our factories to design, develop,
manufacture and supply Natural Products conforming to ISO 9001 standards. Our quality management
system is audited every 6 months by an external auditor.

[ISO Certified]
[nvitalis team]

#### **Team Efforts Keep Us Growing**

To be the best in the industry, we believe in combined efforts of each and every member of our
corporate family, starting right from the owners to the customer service team. We strive to
positively impact the quality of lives of all the people around us or in any remote corner of the
world by building long-lasting relationships based on mutual trust and respect.

You may contact us for any kind of questions related to our products or simply to learn more about
our products. Experts at our team are committed to help you search and buy the best product that
work best for you. Pleasure to say that whether you’re a newbie to the world of essential oils or
using them for years, our experienced staff are fully committed to make your essential oils journey
the absolute best!

We care about you, and we care about your experience with us!

#### Shipping Options

Our shipping partners are DHL, FedEx, UPS, TNT and EMS. We also ship the goods by air as well as by
sea as per buyer’s requirement.

Natura Vitalis is a leading manufacturer, exporter, wholesaler and supplier of 100% Pure and Natural
BERGAMOT ESSENTIAL OIL worldwide. Our catalogue features a range of stellar products for skin care,
hair care & aromatherapy.

Bergamot oil is extracted from the rinds of citrus fruit (Citrus bergamia) that grow on bergamot
orange trees. If you’re a fan of Earl Grey tea, you’re already enjoying the distinctive taste of
bergamot, which is used to flavor it.

The earliest roots of the bergamot tree can be traced to Southeast Asia. It’s currently grown in
many parts of the world, but achieved its prominence and name in the town of Bergamo in southern
Italy.

It’s prized for its soothing scent, spicy taste, and wide range of uses.

Bergamot is the most delicate of the citrus plants, requiring special climate and soil in order to
thrive. Italians have used Bergamot oil for years to reduce feelings of stress and to soothe and
rejuvenate skin. In Greece, the unripe fruits are used as meats, eaten by the spoonful as a dessert
or with coffee.

Bergamot essential oil is unique among citrus oils due to its ability to be both uplifting and
calming, making it ideal to help with anxious and sad feelings. It is also purifying and cleansing
for the skin while having a calming effect.

Natura Vitalis is a leading manufacturer, exporter, wholesaler and supplier of 100% Pure and Natural
CELERY SEED ESSENTIAL OIL worldwide. Our catalogue features a range of stellar products for skin
care, hair care & aromatherapy.

Sourced from the celery plant, Celery Seed essential oil improves digestion when taken internally.
It is soothing to the skin and adds to a comforting after-work out massage.

Celery was used as early as the 5th century by the Chinese, and is widely used in Indian Ayurvedic
practices today. Conventionally grown grocery store celery looks nothing like the celery seen at
local farmers’ markets. The celery plant grows up to three feet tall, is bright green, and radiating
with life. Celery has a complex, strong, , and spicy aroma. The plant takes two years to fully
mature and produce its small fruit, which are tan to brown in color. The seeds are the primary
repository for essential oil. Limonene, the dominant constituent, puts Celery Seed oil in the same
league as the refreshing citrus peel and fir needle oils. Soothing digestive issues is one of the
many benefits of Celery Seed essential oil. Experimental research suggests that it may soothe
muscles and help joint discomfort when taken internally. Celery Seed oil creates a calming,
relaxing, and positive environment while providing cooling and soothing effects.

**Chemical Composition:**

Celery seed oil comprises various chemical components such as sedanolide, sedanonic anhydride,
d-limonene, selinene and sesquiterpene alcohols. Besides, it can also contain fatty acids like
linoleic, myristic, palmitic, palmitoleic, stearic, petroselinic, oleic and myristoleic.

**Essential Oil Information:**

Celery plant is a biennial plant that grows about 30 to 50 cm height. It has grooved, fleshy, erect
stalk and skinny pinnant leaves. This plant has smooth stem, soft leaves and has white flowers.

**Oil Properties:**

Celery seed oil is known for its antioxidative, anti-rheumatic, antiseptic (urinary), antispasmodic
and aperitif properties. Besides, it is also carminative, cholagogue, depurative, digestive
diuretic, hepatic, nervine, stomachic, tonic (digestive), sedative (nervous) and stimulant (uterine)
in nature.

CYPRIOL ESSENTIAL OIL worldwide. Our catalogue features a range of stellar products for skin care,
hair care & aromatherapy.

Cypriol essential oil is obtained from the roots of Cyperus Scariosus plant by the method of steam
distillation. The essential oil is used in aromatherapy. It is an effective decongestant and is good
for the digestive tract. It helps in getting relief from an upset stomach and diarrhea. The oil is
helpful in improving blood circulation as well. Cypriol essential oil is also well known for making
a person feel calm and relaxed along with providing peaceful sleep. The smell of the essential oil
is woody with hints of frankincense, cedar and cinnamon. It has a golden yellow to dark brown color.
The consistency of cypriol essential oil is on the thicker side. It blends well with a lot of other
essential oils.

**Oil of Cypriol (Nagarmotha**) is extracted by steam distillation of roots of plant that is
utilized in the manufacturing of perfumery compounds, soaps, cosmetics and incense sticks
{agarbatti}. Cypriol Oil is also used as fixative and in aromatherapy. Smell of nagarmotha oil is
woody, earthy and quite lingering. In aromatherapy it allows decongestive properties; it is used to
treat diarrhea or problematic digestion. In addition to this, Cyperus Oil is being widely used in
pan masala and tobacco products.

Natura Vitalis is a leading manufacturer, exporter, wholesaler and supplier of 100% Pure and Natural
GALBANUM ESSENTIAL OIL worldwide. Our catalogue features a range of stellar products for skin care,
hair care & aromatherapy.

Galbanum is a large perennial herb with a smooth stem shiny leaflets and small flowers. This oil is
used in soap making ingredients, lotions, massage oils, diffusers, potpourri, scent, air fresheners,
body fragrance, perfume oils, aromatherapy products, bath oils, towel scenting, spa’s, incense,
light rings, laundry, facial steams, hair treatments.

Galbanum Essential Oil is steam distilled from the resin of a flowering plant (Ferula galbaniflua)
that is indigenous to Iran (Persia). Galbanum resin has been widely used as incense and in perfumery
since ancient times.

Therapeutically, Galbanum Essential Oil is probably most widely known for its anti-inflammatory,
anti-microbial and nervine properties.

People take galbanum for diarrhea, gas (flatulence), poor appetite, cough, and seizure disorder
(epilepsy).

Galbanum is sometimes applied directly to the skin to help wounds heal.

In food and beverages, galbanum oil and resin are used as flavoring.

In manufacturing, galbanum oil and resin are used as fragrance in cosmetics.

Acerola Herbal Extract worldwide. Our catalog features a range of stellar products for skin care,
hair care & aromatherapy.

Acerola cherry is a plant that is native to tropical regions of the Western Hemisphere. It’s also
commonly called the West Indies cherry, Barbados cherry, or just simply “acerola.” It’s believed
that the shrub-like plant originated in southern Mexico and the Caribbean.

Acerola produces cherry-like berries, but it’s not a true cherry. These berries are pleasant-tasting
and have been used in modern and folk medicine. Traditional uses include treatment for liver
ailments, diarrhea, dysentery, coughs, and colds.

Acerola is most well-known for being extremely rich in vitamin C. Because of this, it’s often used
to help with or prevent colds or flu. It’s also used as an antioxidant nutrient. Together with
vitamin C, acerola may be taken to boost immunity.

Similar to witch hazel, acerola cherry is an astringent. This could make it helpful for treating
skin blemishes, promoting skin elasticity, and aiding digestive issues. It may even have use as an
antimicrobial mouth wash.

NATURA VITALIS is a leading manufacturer, exporter, wholesaler and supplier of 100% Pure and Natural
Andrographis Herbal Extract worldwide. Our catalog features a range of stellar products for skin
care, hair care & aromatherapy.

Andrographis is a plant that is native to South Asian countries such as India and Sri Lanka. The
leaf and underground stem are used to make medicine.

Andrographis Paniculata is also known as ‘The King of Bitters,’ traditionally used in Ayurveda and
Chinese Medicine.

Andrographis is frequently used for preventing and treating the common cold and flu (influenza).

It is widely cultivated in Southern and Southeastern Asia, where it is been used as treatment for
bacterial infections and some diseases. Mostly the leaves and roots were used for such purposes. The
whole plant is also used in some cases. In Thailand, it is touted as a treatment for Covid-19

Andrographis is also used for a wide assortment of other conditions. It is used for digestive
complaints including diarrhea, constipation, intestinal gas, colic, and stomach pain; for liver
conditions including an enlarged liver, jaundice, and liver damage due to medications; for
infections including leprosy, pneumonia, tuberculosis, gonorrhea, syphilis, malaria, cholera,
leptospirosis, rabies, sinusitis, and HIV/AIDS; and for skin conditions including wounds, ulcers and
itchiness.

It’s also been used for sore throat, coughs, swollen tonsils, bronchitis, and allergies. It is also
used for “hardening of the arteries” (atherosclerosis), and prevention of heart disease and
diabetes.

Other uses include treatment of snake and insect bites, loss of appetite, kidney problems
(pyelonephritis), hemorrhoids, and an inherited condition called familial Mediterranean fever.

Andrographis is also used as an astringent, bacteria killing agent, painkiller, fever reducer, and
treatment for worms.

NATURA VITALIS is a leading manufacturer, exporter, wholesaler and supplier of 100% Pure and Natural
Bacopa Herbal Extract worldwide. Our catalog features a range of stellar products for skin care,
hair care & aromatherapy.

Bacopa, also known as Brahmi, is a plant that has been used in traditional Indian medicine
(Ayurveda).

Bacopa is commonly used for Alzheimer disease, memory and thinking skills (cognitive function),
anxiety, and attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), but there is limited scientific
research to support these uses.

Bacopa might increase certain brain chemicals that are involved in thinking, learning, and memory.
Some research suggests that it might also protect brain cells from chemicals involved in Alzheimer
disease.

**Possibly Effective For:**

Improving memory. Some research shows that taking specific Bacopa extracts (KeenMind; BacoMind)
improves some measure of memory in otherwise healthy older adults. Also, taking Bacopa extract seems
to improve some measures of memory and hand-eye coordination in children aged 6-8 years.

**Possibly Ineffective For:**

Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). Bacopa appears to be no more effective than a sugar pill in keeping
IBS symptoms from returning after remission.

evaporators and caffeine grinders. The purification process leading to commercial production ,
evolves over a series of lab trials and is an in-house feat of our research team.

* Treats Migraine.

Caralluma is a succulent plant (cactus) from India.

People use caralluma to decrease appetite or hunger, especially during times of food shortages, for
obesity, and for a rare, inherited disorder that causes obesity, short stature, and learning
disability (Prader-Willi syndrome or PWS).

In India it grows wild and is often used as a border in gardens and as a roadside shrub. It is also
found in the wild in Africa, Saudi Arabia, Canary Islands, Afghanistan, and Southern Europe.

Traditionally, Indian tribes chewed chunks of caralluma to keep from being hungry during a long
hunt. The chemicals taken from the plant extract is used to decrease appetite for weight loss. It is
also used to quench thirst and to increase endurance.

The person who is using Caralluma fimbriata feels more energetic and has gained lean muscle mass
while losing fat. The reason is that it not only inhibits fat synthesis but also increases the
burning of fat. This makes more energy available to the body and makes the person more active and
livelier.

Caralluma fimbriata contains pregnane glycosides which block the activity of citrate lyase enzyme
thus blocking the formation of fat by the body. Further Caralluma fimbriata blocks another enzyme
called Malonyl Coenzyme A. By blocking this enzyme fat formation is further blocked and the body is
forced to burn its fat reserves. This accelerates the rate of fat loss by the body.

**Uses & Effectiveness**
* A type of persistent anxiety marked by exaggerated worry and tension (generalized anxiety disorder
or GAD).
* **Obesity:** Some early research shows that taking an extract of caralluma may decrease food
intake, feelings of hunger, and waist size.
* A rare, inherited disorder that causes obesity, short stature, and learning disability
(Prader-Willi syndrome or PWS).
* Quenching thirst.
* Increasing endurance.
* Pain.
* Other conditions.

# Centella Asiatica

NATURA VITALIS is a leading manufacturer, exporter, wholesaler and supplier of 100% Pure and Natural
Centella Asiatica Herbal Extract worldwide. Our catalog features a range of stellar products for
skin care, hair care & aromatherapy.

Centella asiatica aka Gotu Kola is a medicinal plant. The active compounds include pentacyclic
triterpenes, mainly asiaticoside, madecassoside, asiatic and madecassic acids. Centella asiatica is
effective in improving treatment of small wounds, hypertrophic wounds as well as burns, psoriasis
and scleroderma. The mechanism of action involves promoting fibroblast proliferation and increasing
the synthesis of collagen and intracellular fibronectin content and also improvement of the tensile
strength of newly formed skin as well as inhibiting the inflammatory phase of hypertrophic scars and
keloids.

Centella asiatica extract containing 70% triterpenic acids (asiatic acid, madecassic acid,
asiatoside) is impressive in treating cellulite, venous insufficiency of lower limbs, and varicose
veins. It exerts normalizing action on metabolism of connective tissue. It enhances tissue integrity
by stimulating glycosaminoglycan (GAG) synthesis without promoting excessive collagen synthesis or
cell growth. GAGs are major components of amorphous intercellular matrix (ground substance) in which
collagen fibers are embedded. Net effect is normal tissue. Effect in venous insufficiency and
varicose veins is to enhance connective tissue structure, reducing sclerosis and improving blood
flow through affected limbs.

Some traditional uses of gotu kola include:
* healing wounds
* relieving diarrhea
* boosting energy levels
* reducing anxiety
* enhancing sexual potency
* treating venereal diseases
* treating skin diseases
* treating menstrual disorders
* slowing leprosy progression
* prolonging life

NATURA VITALIS is a leading manufacturer, exporter, wholesaler and supplier of 100% Pure and Natural
Aniseed Essential Oil, worldwide. Our catalogue features a range of stellar products for skin care,
hair care & aromatherapy.

Aniseed Essential Oil possesses the distinctive aroma of black licorice. Although you may not be a
fan of black licorice, a single drop or two of Aniseed Essential Oil can dramatically enhance an
otherwise dull blend. It can be useful in diffuser and inhaler blends intended to help ease
bronchitis, colds and the flu. It is said to help promote the production of breast milk and
stimulate menstruation, but it should be used with caution and avoided in estrogen-dependent
cancers.

Aniseed essential oil can be obtained from the fruits by either steam distillation or extraction
using supercritical carbon dioxide. The yield of essential oil is influenced by the growing
conditions and extraction process, with supercritical extraction being more efficient. Regardless of
the method of isolation the main component of the oil is anethole (80–90%), with minor components
including 4-anisaldehyde, estragole and pseudoisoeugenyl-2-methylbutyrates, amongst others. Anethole
is responsible for anise’s characteristic odor and flavor.

Emotionally, Aniseed Essential Oil can be calming when used in very small dilutions.

NATURA VITALIS is a leading manufacturer, exporter, wholesaler and supplier of 100% Pure and Natural
Avocado Oil worldwide. Our catalog features a range of stellar products for skin care, hair care &
aromatherapy.

Avocado oil is extracted from fleshy pulp surrounding of avocado pit. It is classified as a
monosaturated oil. The ultra-rich oil contains Vitamins A, B1, B2, D, E, and Beta carotene. Avocado
oil is known to have healing and regenerating properties. This carrier oil has a relatively high
viscosity and is high-oleic content.

100% PURE & NATURAL NATURA VITALIS AVOCADO OIL: The Unfiltered, undiluted without any additives or
fillers. Rich in vitamins and fatty acids it is truly wonderful carrier oil. From skin care, hair
care to aromatherapy and way beyond this amazing oil has endless uses. We care for you!

NATURAL NUTRIENT RICH SKIN MOISTURIZER: The Natura Vitalis Avocado essential oil is a cold pressed
Avocado oil acts as a natural moisturizer which has a many hydrating benefits for hair, skin, face
and nails. It is also used in making of effective massage oil. This pure refined avocado oil has the
unique ability to deeply penetrate the outer layers of skin.

AVOCADO OIL FACIAL MOISTURIZER: Excellent to use organic avocado oil as a facial moisturizer.
Massage with the avocado cold pressed oil on face and leave it on for about 15 minutes, then rinse
the face with warm water. When left on for short periods of time and rinsed off with warm water,
avocado oil can keep skin hydrated without leaving an oily residue.

AVOCADO OIL FOR HEALTHY HAIR: Loved by many people around the world for their hair care. When
applied to the hair shafts, it helps to detangle hair. It promotes hair growth because of the
nutrients in it, especially Vitamin E. It helps to achieve gorgeous shiny hair without any
greasiness and it also softens the hair, so that they are more manageable and easily combed.

delaying old age.

**policy and an action plan**, accompanied by **ambitious and quantifiable goals** with the horizon

## Fresh, Sustainable, and Trusted Worldwide

## Who We Are

Onocado Farm Enterprises Company Limited is a proudly Tanzanian agribusiness specializing in the
cultivation and export of premium Hass avocados, vibrant habanero chilies, and pure avocado oil. Our
farms are located in the lush Njombe Highlands, where the combination of fertile volcanic soils,
high altitude, and favorable climate creates the perfect environment for growing world-class
produce.

As a company, we are driven by a passion for agriculture, sustainability, and excellence. We combine
traditional farming knowledge with modern agricultural practices to ensure that our products meet
the highest global standards. Over the years, we have positioned ourselves as a trusted partner for
international buyers seeking quality, consistency, and reliability.

What we do

At Onocado, we manage every stage of production with great care—from planting and nurturing our
crops to harvesting, sorting, and packaging. Our Hass avocados are celebrated for their creamy
texture and long shelf life, our habanero chilies are hand-harvested for maximum flavor and heat,
and our avocado oil is cold-pressed to preserve its rich nutrients, making it ideal for both
culinary and cosmetic use.

We work closely with logistics partners to ensure timely and efficient deliveries through both air
and sea freight, depending on client needs. Our produce is carefully pre-cooled, graded, and packed
in ventilated cartons to maintain freshness from farm to market. Beyond supply, we are committed to
sustainable farming practices that protect the environment, support local communities, and promote
food safety.

## Our Main Goal

Our main goal is to provide premium quality products that consistently meet international standards,
while at the same time promoting sustainable farming practices that protect the environment for
future generations. We are committed to empowering local farmers by creating employment
opportunities, sharing knowledge, and strengthening communities in the Njombe Highlands. Beyond
supplying world-class Hass avocados, habanero chilies, and avocado oil, we focus on building
long-term partnerships with our buyers, founded on trust, reliability, and transparency. By
balancing quality, sustainability, and community impact, we aim to position Onocado Farm Enterprises
as a dependable and socially responsible supplier in the global agro-market.

## About Us

At our farm in Tanzania’s Njombe Highlands, we are passionate about cultivating the finest produce.
Dedicated to quality, sustainability, and responsible farming, we grow avocados and produce paper
products that meet international standards while supporting our local communities

## About Us

CSI has been manufacturing and packaging quality nutritional and gourmet food products for over 30
years. We are proud to announce that we have expanded our product line by purchasing Pacifica
Culinaria, a premier gourmet food manufacturer specializing in avocado oils for cooking. We
currently offer twelve varieties of our flavor infused avocado oils including award-winning Blood
Orange as well as Key Lime, Coastal Lemon and savory infusions such as Toasted Onion and Roasted
Garlic. We also offer thick and rich balsamic vinegars from Modena, Italy, along with our new line
of Olive Oils. Lastly, we offer a unique collection of premium culinary tools specifically for the
avocado lover.

Healthier than the commonly used olive oil, this luxurious oil is made from avocados which are
naturally cholesterol free, contain heart-healthy mono-unsaturated fats (the "good" fats) and is a
rich source of Vitamin E. Avocado oil has one of the highest smoke points at over 500 degrees, which
makes it great for sautéing, searing or stir-frying. The infused oils are created by an oil to oil
infusion resulting in a healthier flavorful oil choice.

Our main office and warehouses are located in Vista, California. From there we manufacture, market
and ship our high-quality collection of specialty gourmet food items to wholesalers, distributors,
and retailers nationwide. Our products are sold to specialty food markets via sales representatives
covering the entire United States. We also sell direct to customers from our on-line store at
[www.PacificaCulinaria.com][26] and over the phone at(800) 622-8880 or (760) 727-9883.

We pride ourselves on excellent customer service and satisfaction. We operate with a
customer-oriented style carried out by skilled professionals working hard to ensure delivery of top
quality, gourmet specialty food items and unique culinary tool products.

## Wholesale Products

Olive Oils

Our Extra Virgin Olive Oils are California grown and certified, and come infused with a variety of
delicious flavors. Available in Arbequina Extra Virgin, Lemon, Garlic, Blood Orange, Basil, and
Garlic/Herb/Sun Dried Tomato flavors. Available in 8.5 oz bottles sold in 12 per case or 1/2 gallon
containers for Food Service / Wholesale.

Avocado Oils

Pacifica Culinaria offers a line of all-natural infused avocado oils. Blending avocado oil with
unique flavors creates many culinary possibilities and maximizes the health benefits of oil that is
high in monounsaturated fats ("good fats") which help lower cholesterol and promote heart health.
The avocado is known to reduce the risk of cancer and diabetes and enhances the bioavailability of
carotenoid-rich fruits and vegetables. Avocado oil's multi-functionality makes it a must-have in the
kitchen. With its high smoke point (500 degrees) it is ideal for searing, frying, grilling and
sautéing. Its light, silky texture and refined taste is the perfect ingredient for salad dressings.
Available in Blood Orange (winner for Outstanding Oil at the NASFT Fancy Food show), All Natural,
Key Lime, Coastal Lemon, Roasted Garlic, Roasted Chili, Toasted Onion, Lemon Pepper, Tuscan Herb,
Provencal Herb. Available in 8.5 oz bottles sold in 12 per case or 1/2 gallon containers for Food
Service / Wholesale.

Infused Vinegars

Our Modena gourmet balsamic vinegars are deliciously rich and thick balsamic vinegars that begin
with grape must -- whole pressed grapes complete with juice, skin, seeds and stems. It's then
carefully processed and aged for years before it can bear the name of "balsamic". We have developed
unique blends such as Mission Fig, Pomegranate, Blackberry, Peach, Pear, Strawberry, Dark Chocolate,
Bianco White, and our Traditional Aged. Available in 8.5 oz bottles sold in 12 per case or 1/2
gallon containers for Food Service / Wholesale.

Technical Specifications & Quality Parameters

To protect the complex chemical compounds of our crude oil over long-distance ocean transit, Primeavo implements strict international bulk liquid logistics protocols . Every consignment is shipped exclusively inside high-capacity, food-grade multi-layered flexi-tanks secured within pristine 20-foot sea-freight containers .
Our technical rigging features an advanced 5-bar steel bulkhead retention system, a robust unibody 3-inch snaplock ball valve configuration, and complete interior insulation using heavy-duty corrugated card linings . We provide a reliable, contamination-free arrival at any destination port worldwide .

Bulletproof Traceability

Because we own the farms and the factory, we provide complete transparency and absolute batch traceability for every single flexi-tank we export.

Industrial Logistics Standards

Every consignment is rigged into low-age, strictly inspected 20ft ocean containers using premium 24-tonne food-grade flexi-tanks and heavy-duty steel bulkheads.

## About Primeavo Limited

## Who We Are

**PRIMEAVO LIMITED** is a premier, vertically integrated agro-processing enterprise operating at the
intersection of sustainable agriculture and industrial manufacturing. Strategically headquartered in
Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, we specialize in the commercial cultivation of world-class avocados and the
advanced extraction of premium crude avocado oil for global industrial, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical
markets.

Unlike traditional processors that rely entirely on fragmented, unmonitored out-grower networks,
Primeavo commands complete control over its entire supply chain. By managing our own extensive
agricultural estates in the fertile highlands of Njombe alongside modern processing facilities, we
guarantee unmatched quality, absolute structural traceability, and a reliable year-round production
volume of 100% Tanzanian-grown Hass and Fuerte avocado oils.

### Our Vision

To establish definitive global leadership as East Africa's most trusted, fully integrated supplier
of premium avocado products, recognized worldwide for quality excellence, supply chain integrity,
and ecological stewardship.

### Our Mission

To engineer a world-class agricultural ecosystem that maximizes the value of Tanzania's natural
bounty, delivering superior-quality crude avocado oil to international markets through advanced
sustainable processing while empowering local farming communities.

## The Values That Drive Our Integration

Quality Excellence (Farm-to-Factory)

We enforce rigorous quality standards at every single touchpoint—from managing the soil chemistry in
our Njombe fields to supervising the pressure parameters during oil extraction.

Complete Supply Chain Integrity

By owning our commercial farms, we eliminate middle-tier supply variables, providing international
buyers with bulletproof batch traceability and total transparency.

Agricultural Sustainability

We employ forward-thinking farming methodologies that conserve water, build rich soil biology, and
minimize chemical dependency to preserve Tanzanian land for generations.

Community Integration

Our operations act as socio-economic anchors in the Njombe region, generating sustainable rural
employment, driving technical skills transfer, and upgrading regional agricultural infrastructure.

## Our Footprint: From Highlands to High Seas

Large-Scale Commercial Avocado Cultivation & Bulk Crude Oil Mechanical Processing

### The Agricultural Base: Njombe Region

Our agricultural foundation is rooted in Njombe, Tanzania, an area widely celebrated as one of the
most geographically perfect environments on earth for high-yield avocado cultivation. The high
altitudes, perfectly balanced rainfall patterns, and deep, well-drained volcanic soils allow our
Hass and Fuerte cultivars to achieve peak oil content and ideal fatty acid profiles. Because we own
the land, our crops are never vulnerable to the inconsistent sorting or arbitrary harvest dates
typical of unmonitored third-party smallholders.

### The Logistics & Executive Hub: Dar es Salaam

Operating from the 4th Floor of the NHC Building on Samora Avenue, our head office handles global
trade operations, international contract management, and rigorous quality assurance verification.
Our strategic proximity to the Port of Dar es Salaam ensures that once our oil is securely loaded
into our specialized 24-tonne intermodal flexi-tanks, it transitions seamlessly onto ocean freight
carriers without logistical delay.

## Establish a Secure Supply Partnership

Connect directly with our commercial team in Dar es Salaam to request custom pricing, logistics
coordination, or contract manufacturing variables.

Technical Specifications & Quality Parameters

To protect the complex chemical compounds of our crude oil over long-distance ocean transit, Primeavo implements strict international bulk liquid logistics protocols . Every consignment is shipped exclusively inside high-capacity, food-grade multi-layered flexi-tanks secured within pristine 20-foot sea-freight containers .
Our technical rigging features an advanced 5-bar steel bulkhead retention system, a robust unibody 3-inch snaplock ball valve configuration, and complete interior insulation using heavy-duty corrugated card linings . We provide a reliable, contamination-free arrival at any destination port worldwide .

Why Global Distributors Partner with Primeavo

Chemical-Free Processing

Our modern processing facility utilizes advanced mechanical extraction lines that completely omit harsh chemical solvents, preserving natural oil integrity.

Bulletproof Traceability

Because we own the farms and the factory, we provide complete transparency and absolute batch traceability for every single flexi-tank we export.

Industrial Logistics Standards

Every consignment is rigged into low-age, strictly inspected 20ft ocean containers using premium 24-tonne food-grade flexi-tanks and heavy-duty steel bulkheads.
