## About Primeavo Limited

## Who We Are

**PRIMEAVO LIMITED** is a premier, vertically integrated agro-processing enterprise operating at the
intersection of sustainable agriculture and industrial manufacturing. Strategically headquartered in
Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, we specialize in the commercial cultivation of world-class avocados and the
advanced extraction of premium crude avocado oil for global industrial, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical
markets.

Unlike traditional processors that rely entirely on fragmented, unmonitored out-grower networks,
Primeavo commands complete control over its entire supply chain. By managing our own extensive
agricultural estates in the fertile highlands of Njombe alongside modern processing facilities, we
guarantee unmatched quality, absolute structural traceability, and a reliable year-round production
volume of 100% Tanzanian-grown Hass and Fuerte avocado oils.

### Our Vision

To establish definitive global leadership as East Africa's most trusted, fully integrated supplier
of premium avocado products, recognized worldwide for quality excellence, supply chain integrity,
and ecological stewardship.

### Our Mission

To engineer a world-class agricultural ecosystem that maximizes the value of Tanzania's natural
bounty, delivering superior-quality crude avocado oil to international markets through advanced
sustainable processing while empowering local farming communities.

## The Values That Drive Our Integration

Quality Excellence (Farm-to-Factory)

We enforce rigorous quality standards at every single touchpoint—from managing the soil chemistry in
our Njombe fields to supervising the pressure parameters during oil extraction.

Complete Supply Chain Integrity

By owning our commercial farms, we eliminate middle-tier supply variables, providing international
buyers with bulletproof batch traceability and total transparency.

Agricultural Sustainability

We employ forward-thinking farming methodologies that conserve water, build rich soil biology, and
minimize chemical dependency to preserve Tanzanian land for generations.

Community Integration

Our operations act as socio-economic anchors in the Njombe region, generating sustainable rural
employment, driving technical skills transfer, and upgrading regional agricultural infrastructure.

## Our Footprint: From Highlands to High Seas

Large-Scale Commercial Avocado Cultivation & Bulk Crude Oil Mechanical Processing

### The Agricultural Base: Njombe Region

Our agricultural foundation is rooted in Njombe, Tanzania, an area widely celebrated as one of the
most geographically perfect environments on earth for high-yield avocado cultivation. The high
altitudes, perfectly balanced rainfall patterns, and deep, well-drained volcanic soils allow our
Hass and Fuerte cultivars to achieve peak oil content and ideal fatty acid profiles. Because we own
the land, our crops are never vulnerable to the inconsistent sorting or arbitrary harvest dates
typical of unmonitored third-party smallholders.

### The Logistics & Executive Hub: Dar es Salaam

Operating from the 4th Floor of the NHC Building on Samora Avenue, our head office handles global
trade operations, international contract management, and rigorous quality assurance verification.
Our strategic proximity to the Port of Dar es Salaam ensures that once our oil is securely loaded
into our specialized 24-tonne intermodal flexi-tanks, it transitions seamlessly onto ocean freight
carriers without logistical delay.

## Establish a Secure Supply Partnership

Connect directly with our commercial team in Dar es Salaam to request custom pricing, logistics
coordination, or contract manufacturing variables.

## Quality Assurance

[Home]

##### At Purevado, quality assurance is not just a commitment; it is the foundation of our
##### operations, especially as we cater to the discerning global avocado market. Our relentless
##### focus on quality and safety ensures that every avocado we export meets the highest
##### international standards, reflecting our dedication to excellence from farm to fork.

#### **Continuous Improvement in Production and Management**

In the highly competitive global avocado market, maintaining exceptional quality is crucial. To
achieve this, we continually review and enhance our production and management processes. By
integrating the latest agricultural practices, cutting-edge technology, and rigorous quality control
measures, we ensure that our avocados consistently meet the premium standards demanded by our
international clients.

#### **Global Certifications and Standards**

Purevado proudly holds several prestigious certifications that validate our commitment to quality,
sustainability, and ethical business practices. These certifications are critical in ensuring that
our avocados are not only safe and delicious but also produced in a manner that respects both people
and the planet.

#### **Global GAP**

This certification underscores our adherence to Good Agricultural Practices, ensuring that our
farming methods are sustainable, safe, and environmentally responsible. Global GAP is a benchmark
for food safety, traceability, and sustainable production, giving our clients confidence in the
quality of our avocados.

#### **Sedex SMETA**

Our adherence to the Sedex Members Ethical Trade Audit (SMETA) principles highlights our commitment
to ethical business practices. This certification ensures that we maintain high standards in labor
rights, health and safety, environmental impact, and business ethics, which are increasingly
important to global consumers and retailers.

#### **Rainforest Alliance**

Our certification by the Rainforest Alliance reflects our dedication to sustainability and
environmental stewardship. By meeting these standards, we contribute to biodiversity conservation,
improve the livelihoods of our farmers, and promote sustainable land use and farming practices.

#### **BRCGS Certified Packhouse**

Our packhouse is certified by the British Retail Consortium Global Standards (BRCGS), ensuring that
our packing processes meet rigorous food safety and quality requirements. This certification is
recognized globally, assuring our customers that our avocados are handled with the utmost care and
attention to detail.

#### **Commitment to the Global Market**

The global avocado market demands excellence, and Purevado is dedicated to delivering it. Our
comprehensive approach to quality assurance, backed by internationally recognized certifications,
ensures that our avocados are of the highest quality, safe, and sustainably produced. By continually
improving our practices and adhering to the strictest standards, we position ourselves as a trusted
supplier in the global avocado market, committed to meeting the evolving needs of our clients and
consumers.

rejuvenated skin. The pomegranate oil in the cream offers numerous benefits, including a high
concentration of antioxidants that help brighten the skin and improve its elasticity. Moreover, the

Transform your skin with our rejuvenating cream designed to combat cellulite and stretch marks.
Infused with caffeine, guarana, and nourishing vitamins, it promotes circulation and tightens skin
for a smoother appearance. Experience the warming sensation as you apply, leaving your skin deeply
hydrated and revitalized. Perfect for thighs, abdomen, and arms—your journey to firmer skin starts
here!

### Directions

Massage the cream into the skin in circular motions. Use twice a day for best results. you will feel
the heat after a few minutes.

### Ingredients

WATER (AQUA), CETEARYL ALCOHOL, SWEET ALMOND (PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS) OIL, SHEA BUTTER

ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN, CAPSICUM OLEORESIN (CAPSICUM FRUTESCENS RESIN), TETRASODIUM EDTA, SILOXANETRIOL
ALGINATE, CITRIC ACID, SODIUM BENZOATE, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SODIUM HYDROXIDE, LIMONENE, LINALOOL.

### Warnings

product for you.

## Description

Experience the soothing benefits of our therapeutic **FOOT CREAM**, expertly crafted to deliver
noticeable results from the very first use. This premium formula is tailored for those who want to
provide exceptional care and hydration for their feet. Developed using high-quality, purposeful
ingredients, our product is designed to bring comfort, nourishment, and long-lasting moisture to
your daily routine. With every application, you’ll discover renewed softness and healthy-looking
skin as the visible effects of dryness begin to fade away.

## Why Choose Our FOOT CREAM?

Our **FOOT CREAM** stands out for its unique blend of ingredients that are chosen to target areas of
discomfort and dehydration. The inclusion of [hemp oil][25], combined with Vitamin C, creates a
formula that soothes, hydrates, and reinvigorates. Whether your skin has been exposed to rough
surfaces, long days, or the effects of environmental stressors, this advanced blend helps replenish
and protect. Enjoy smooth, flexible skin after each application and reveal natural vitality with
consistent, daily use.

### Key Benefits and Features of This Product
* **Intensive Moisturization**: The core formulation with hemp oil penetrates deeply to restore lost
moisture and soften rough areas.
* **Support for Healthy Skin**: Vitamin C supports the skin’s natural repair processes and defends
against external aggressors.
* **Guards Against Dryness**: This formulation helps maintain hydration and comfort, so you’re
protected from everyday exposure that leads to irritation.
* **Promotes Skin Flexibility and Comfort**: Each use leaves skin feeling relaxed, supple, and
refreshed.
* **Non-Greasy and Fast-Absorbing Texture**: Enjoy a lightweight feel that allows you to move about
freely after each application.

## How to Best Use This FOOT CREAM

For optimal results, apply a generous layer of our nourishing formula to the areas that require the
most attention. Gently massage until the product is fully absorbed, concentrating on regions that
feel rough or require extra hydration. This process enhances absorption and locks in moisture,
helping your skin to remain conditioned and healthy. Repeat daily to experience lasting benefits and
improved skin texture with continued use.

### Powerful Ingredients for Enhanced Care

What sets our **FOOT CREAM** apart is the synergistic effect of its core ingredients. The hemp oil
delivers Omega fatty acids, which nourish and protect your skin’s barrier. Vitamin C works as an
antioxidant and encourages the skin’s natural renewal cycle. Together, they create a protective
shield that helps maintain moisture balance and leaves your skin looking vibrant day after day. This
careful combination targets common discomforts and provides visible relief, making every use a step
towards comfort and wellness.

## Tips for Best Results

For enhanced effectiveness, use our product after bathing or soaking your skin, as damp skin allows
for even deeper hydration. Focus on regions that may need more care, and apply extra product to
these sections as needed. Consistent, daily use will gradually help restore comfort, smooth texture,
and confidence in the appearance of your skin. Incorporating this routine into your self-care
regimen ensures long-term improvements and sustainable comfort.

## Nourish Your Skin Every Day

Our **FOOT CREAM** is designed for those who value both immediate results and long-term
improvements. The fast-absorbing, lightweight texture means you can easily apply it before bed or
prior to putting on socks and shoes in the morning. The deeply hydrating formula relieves common
discomforts and is especially suited for people who want preventative care that fits into a busy
lifestyle. Enjoy total comfort every day and feel your confidence grow as your skin becomes
progressively softer.

### Experience the Power of Nature

We believe in using nature-derived ingredients, such as premium hemp oil and Vitamin C, to deliver
both care and protection for your skin. These natural elements work in harmony to repair, protect,
and revitalize. Our eco-conscious formula is perfect for regular use and supports an overall sense
of well-being by helping you feel your best each day.

If you seek effective relief and everyday care, this is your gateway to healthier, more comfortable
skin. Trust in our **FOOT CREAM** and create a daily routine that transforms your daily experience.
Begin your journey to ultimate softness and embrace the difference that dedicated self-care can
make.

Wash your feet and dry them well. Apply the cream, massage it in well until fully absorbed.

##### Saficado is a specialized crude avocado oil producer established in 2023, focusing exclusively
##### on the export of crude avocado oil

Located in Gatundu – Juja Town, the company has distinguished itself through its commitment to
quality, sustainable practices, and farmer empowerment across the African region. The company
leverages Kenya’s prime avocado-growing conditions to produce high-quality crude avocado oil for the
global market

# Our Mission

To deliver superior value to customers while maintaining steadfast support for farmers and
employees, building a world-class enterprise in avocado oil.

To establish global leadership in avocado oil processing, while creating substantial value for
customers and society at large

#### Excellence

We pursue uncompromising quality in everything we do, from hand-selecting perfectly ripe avocados to
maintaining rigorous production standards. Excellence isn’t just about the end product – it’s about
elevating every step of our process to create truly exceptional results

#### Sustainability

We recognize our responsibility as stewards of both environmental and community resources. Our
commitment to sustainability encompasses zero-waste production methods, chemical-free processing,
and farming practices that preserve our land for future generations.

#### Integrity

We conduct our business with unwavering honesty and transparency, ensuring that every decision and
action aligns with our ethical principles. From fair pricing for farmers to truthful product claims,
integrity guides every aspect of our operations.

We continuously seek better ways to serve our stakeholders
by embracing new ideas and technologies while honoring
traditional wisdom. Our innovative spirit drives us to improve
our processes, products, and services while maintaining our
commitment to natural, pure products.

#### Empowerment

We understand that our success is intertwined with the prosperity of our community. By fostering
strong relationships with farmers, employees, and customers, we create a supportive ecosystem that
benefits everyone involved in our journey.

## High-grade Crude Avocado Oil

#### 100% Locally Sourced

Our production methodology is distinguished by its commitment to natural processing. Unlike
conventional extraction techniques that rely on chemical solvents, we employ a sophisticated
mechanical extraction process that carefully separates oil from the avocado flesh. This approach
ensures we capture the oil’s fundamental characteristics while maintaining its inherent purity.

The extraction occurs in a carefully controlled environment, with temperature-regulated conditions
that protect the oil’s natural properties. Our industrial-grade process is designed to maximize oil
yield while minimizing mechanical intervention, resulting in a crude oil that serves as an
exceptional base for various industrial applications.

To deliver superior value to customers while maintaining steadfast support for farmers and
employees, building a world-class enterprise in avocado oil.

# Our Vision

To establish global leadership in avocado oil processing, while creating substantial value for
customers and society at large

###### SAFICADO LIMITED

## Core Values

#### Excellence

We pursue uncompromising quality in everything we do, from hand-selecting perfectly ripe avocados to
maintaining rigorous production standards. Excellence isn’t just about the end product – it’s about
elevating every step of our process to create truly exceptional results

#### Sustainability

We recognize our responsibility as stewards of both environmental and community resources. Our
commitment to sustainability encompasses zero-waste production methods, chemical-free processing,
and farming practices that preserve our land for future generations.

#### Integrity

We conduct our business with unwavering honesty and transparency, ensuring that every decision and
action aligns with our ethical principles. From fair pricing for farmers to truthful product claims,
integrity guides every aspect of our operations.

#### Community

We continuously seek better ways to serve our stakeholders
by embracing new ideas and technologies while honoring
traditional wisdom. Our innovative spirit drives us to improve
our processes, products, and services while maintaining our
commitment to natural, pure products.

#### Empowerment

We understand that our success is intertwined with the prosperity of our community. By fostering
strong relationships with farmers, employees, and customers, we create a supportive ecosystem that
benefits everyone involved in our journey.

# Kenya’s equatorial climate provides us with a unique agricultural ecosystem. Our Hass and Fuerte

conventional extraction techniques that rely on chemical solvents, we employ a sophisticated
mechanical extraction process that carefully separates oil from the avocado flesh. This approach
ensures we capture the oil’s fundamental characteristics while maintaining its inherent purity.

The extraction occurs in a carefully controlled environment, with temperature-regulated conditions
that protect the oil’s natural properties. Our industrial-grade process is designed to maximize oil
yield while minimizing mechanical intervention, resulting in a crude oil that serves as an

## GET TO KNOW US

Shiv Sales Corporation is an authentic and certified natural oils manufacturer and exporter in
India. Founded in Delhi in 2017, our company has been dedicatedly working towards our mission to
deliver ethically produced and high quality natural oils to our clients. Our commitment to ensuring
100% customer satisfaction and providing value for money products motivates us to manufacture pure
Essential oils, Carrier oils, Herbal Extracts, Attars, Spices Oils, Aromatherapy oils, Absolute
Natural Fragrances, etc. With continued development through advanced research, we maintain a high
standard of natural products highly suitable for food, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, ayurvedic
pharmaceuticals, flavor & fragrance and many more industries. Each of our products reflects our
promise of uncompromising quality and fair practices. Feel free to Contact Us today for more
information!

## Unwavering Commitment to Quality

Since we have been one of the leading natural fragrance oil companies in India for 25 years, we
never fail to offer world-class quality products. Our focus is always on improving the health and
overall well-being of the community. This goal allows us to run various QAP and testing procedures
using GC/GCMS technologies and techniques. Additionally, we have complete control of the conception,
formulation, manufacturing and packaging processes of all our product lines. It ensures that all our
products are not only chemical free but are made using fresh, pure and carefully selected
ingredients. Overall, we are the foremost natural oils manufacturer and supplier in India that
prioritizes health while beating high priced products.

Our highly skilled manufacturing team of professionals, procurement agents, packaging experts and
quality checking agents are the backbone of exceptional natural oil formulations. Their expertise
allows them to source the finest raw materials, execute and meticulously inspect all intricate

delightful unboxing experience for our customers. Additionally, our team ensures that all our
products meet our rigorous standards so that we only deliver the purest and most effective essential
oils. It means that from raw material sourcing to final product manufacturing, our team is the one

oil stabilizes your hormones, which further leads to less stress and healthier skin. Reach out to
Shiv Sales, a leading Geranium Oil manufacturer & supplier, and enjoy the benefits of partnering
with a premier natural oil manufacturer & supplier.

The Linseed Oil is obtained through the cold pressing of the linseed-flax plant, which remains
native to India. This oil bears an earthy aroma. While being a safe and edible oil, it also features
coating properties that it bestows upon materials like wood, stone and metal. As a leading Linseed
Oil manufacturer & supplier, we strive to produce and deliver the highest quality of Linseed Oil to
our clients.

# Davana Oil

The Davana Oil is produced by steam distillation of the flowers and leaves of the Artemisia pallens
plant, which is found in India. It has a fruity and somewhat complex aroma that holds high value in
its utility. This oil possesses many health benefits like enhancing skincare, instilling calmness
and alleviating stress. It is also used to treat people with arachnophobia. Get in touch with Shiv
Sales, a leading Davana Oil manufacturer & supplier, and experience the benefits of working with a
top-notch natural oils supplier in India

capabilities. It also covers benefits like moisturized, glowing skin and stronger bones. Get in
touch with Shiv Sales, the best Garlic Oil manufacturer and supplier, and experience the advantages

About Us

Siz Agro Plc is a leading coffee producer and exporter dedicated to delivering highquality green coffee to customers worldwide. With a deep passion for coffee and a commitment to sustainability, we have established ourselves as a reputed player in the coffee industry. In addition to coffee, we have a newly established avocado oil manufacturing company, dedicated to producing premium quality avocado oil for various culinary and cosmetic applications. With a focus on excellence and innovation, we aim to become a trusted provider of avocado oil in the market.

Permanent Employees

2500+

20,000+

Farmers Collaboration

More About Us

Production

Our company takes pride in our carefully cultivated coffee beans sourced from Sidama, South Ethiopia, and Oromia regions, known for their exceptional coffee growing conditions. We employ traditional techniques to ensure superior quality from seed to cup. Our skilled team of coffee experts oversees every step of the production process.
Our company utilizes state of the art technology and carefully selected avocados to extract oil of the highest standard. Our manufacturing facility adheres to strict hygiene and safety regulations to ensure the production of
safe and top-quality avocado oil.

Why Choose Siz Agro Plc

Quality Assurance

We maintain stringent quality control measures throughout the production process. Our beans as well as Each batch of avocado oil undergoes rigorous testing to ensure it meets our exacting standards.

Export Services

As a reliable exporter, we specialize in facilitating seamless international trade. We have established strong partnerships with green coffee and avocado oil buyers worldwide, enabling us to reach in various markets.

Unique Selling Proposition

Siz Agro Plc is a distinguished exporter from Ethiopia, uniquely managing the entire coffee production process from farm to export. With a commitment to quality and sustainability, we oversee every step, ensuring that our coffee meets the highest standards from cultivation to your warehouse. Additionally, we are proud producers and exporters of premium avocado oil, delivering excellence to your business.

Growth

Growth is part of our DNA. Our potential to grow is immeasurable. We focus on business opportunities with a view to create volume with quality and cost efficiencies in our operations. Our business has grown significantly in the last 7 years, and we continue to invest to build a scalable business.

## Products

### Production

Our company takes pride in our carefully cultivated coffee beans sourced from Sidama, South
Ethiopia, and Oromia regions, known for their exceptional coffee growing conditions. We employ
traditional
techniques to ensure superior quality from seed to cup. Our skilled team of coffee experts oversees
every step of the production process.
Our company utilizes state of the art technology and carefully selected avocados to extract oil of
the highest standard. Our manufacturing facility adheres to strict hygiene and safety regulations to
ensure the production of
safe and top-quality avocado oil.

### Why Choose Siz Agro Plc

#### Quality Assurance

We maintain stringent quality control measures throughout the production process. Our beans as well
as Each batch of avocado oil undergoes rigorous testing to ensure it meets our exacting standards.

#### Export Services

As a reliable exporter, we specialize in facilitating seamless international trade. We have
established strong partnerships with green coffee and avocado oil buyers worldwide, enabling us to
reach in various markets.

#### Unique Selling Proposition

Siz Agro Plc is a distinguished exporter from Ethiopia, uniquely managing the entire coffee
production process from farm to export. With a commitment to quality and sustainability, we oversee
every step, ensuring that our coffee meets the highest standards from cultivation to your warehouse.
Additionally, we are proud producers and exporters of premium avocado oil, delivering excellence to
your business.

#### Growth

Growth is part of our DNA. Our potential to grow is immeasurable. We focus on business opportunities
with a view to create volume with quality and cost efficiencies in our operations. Our business has
grown significantly in the last 7 years, and we continue to invest to build a scalable business.

# About

**OUR STORY**

In 1986, Spectrum Naturals® brand was founded in Petaluma, CA to bring nutrition and quality into
the vegetable oil market. Soon after Spectrum Naturals® brand was founded, Spectrum Essentials®
brand was created to produce and market dietary supplements. Both brands were committed to offering
premium, wholesome alternatives to conventional products. This commitment stemmed from the brand’s
use of organic, non-GMO ingredients and its chemical-free extraction of oils.

Spectrum Naturals® brand soon became a leading innovator in the development of expeller-pressed and
certified organic vegetable oils, as well as a leading proponent of testing and verifying the
absence of genetically modified organisms in its culinary oils. In 2005, Hain Celestial Group
acquired Spectrum® Organic Products, and today, Spectrum® brand is the #1 Natural and Organic
Culinary Oil brand!¹

**OUR COMMITMENT**

Spectrum® brand was founded for one simple reason: to provide a reliable source of high quality,
wholesome products. Our brand offers 30+ varieties of Non-GMO Project Verified culinary oils,
sourced from worldwide geographies including Spain and Italy. This collection of oils feature
premium expeller-pressed and cold-pressed products. As your culinary partner, we are here to
educate, guide, and inspire you with tips and resources that will take your dishes to new heights.
Explore our products and our website to learn how to give your healthful lifestyle a boost.

**HAIN CELESTIAL GROUP** Spectrum Culinary™ and Spectrum Essentials® are owned by Spectrum Organic
Products, LLC, a subsidiary of the Hain Celestial Group (Nasdaq: HAIN) and is headquartered in
Boulder, CO. Hain Celestial is a leading natural and organic food and personal care products
company in North America and Europe. Hain Celestial participates in almost all natural food
categories. Spectrum Culinary™ brand’s purpose is to provide and deliver a premium line of culinary
oils, vinegars, mayonnaise, spread and shortening that adhere to high quality standards. We are
vigilant about the sourcing, production, and packaging of our products – with the goal of leaving as
small a footprint as possible, and sustaining resources for the future..

# About

**OUR STORY**

In 1986, Spectrum Naturals® brand was founded in Petaluma, CA to bring nutrition and quality into
the vegetable oil market. Soon after Spectrum Naturals® brand was founded, Spectrum Essentials®
brand was created to produce and market dietary supplements. Both brands were committed to offering
premium, wholesome alternatives to conventional products. This commitment stemmed from the brand’s
use of organic, non-GMO ingredients and its chemical-free extraction of oils.

Spectrum Naturals® brand soon became a leading innovator in the development of expeller-pressed and
certified organic vegetable oils, as well as a leading proponent of testing and verifying the
absence of genetically modified organisms in its culinary oils. In 2005, Hain Celestial Group
acquired Spectrum® Organic Products, and today, Spectrum® brand is the #1 Natural and Organic
Culinary Oil brand!¹

**OUR COMMITMENT**

Spectrum® brand was founded for one simple reason: to provide a reliable source of high quality,
wholesome products. Our brand offers 30+ varieties of Non-GMO Project Verified culinary oils,
sourced from worldwide geographies including Spain and Italy. This collection of oils feature
premium expeller-pressed and cold-pressed products. As your culinary partner, we are here to
educate, guide, and inspire you with tips and resources that will take your dishes to new heights.
Explore our products and our website to learn how to give your healthful lifestyle a boost.

**HAIN CELESTIAL GROUP** Spectrum Culinary™ and Spectrum Essentials® are owned by Spectrum Organic
Products, LLC, a subsidiary of the Hain Celestial Group (Nasdaq: HAIN) and is headquartered in
Boulder, CO. Hain Celestial is a leading natural and organic food and personal care products
company in North America and Europe. Hain Celestial participates in almost all natural food
categories. Spectrum Culinary™ brand’s purpose is to provide and deliver a premium line of culinary
oils, vinegars, mayonnaise, spread and shortening that adhere to high quality standards. We are
vigilant about the sourcing, production, and packaging of our products – with the goal of leaving as
small a footprint as possible, and sustaining resources for the future..

products.name: Almond Oil, Refined

We are a leading global avocado company.
For over 75 years we have been the trusted supplier of fresh fruits and plant based products.

Westfalia Fruit is recognised as the ‘AvoExpert’. In addition to our wide range of avocado products,
we supply other fresh produce including citrus, cherries, blueberries, & many others, to
international markets.

Why are we the AvoExperts? Let us tell you why.
We research & develop
[chevron]

Investing in research & development (R&D) has opened up a world of possibilities for Westfalia
Fruit. It has enabled us to enhance our farming practices and sustainability efforts, develop new
fruit varieties, improve crop resilience, and reduce our use of natural resources like water.

We grow
[chevron]

We have a diverse global network of farms, partner growers and nurseries across different
continents. This ensures our ability to deliver a wide variety of high-quality fruits. Westfalia
Fruit uses sustainable farming techniques like mulching, integrated pest management and water
conservation.

We ripen
[chevron]

Specialised ripening technologies ensure our fruit reaches optimal ripeness and flavour before being
shipped to retail and foodservice customers. We provide a superior eating experience by delivering
ready-to-eat avocados year-round while extending shelf life and reducing food waste.

We ship
[chevron]

Our precious fruit is transported in a timely manner by shipping efficiently. The freshness is
maintained by optimising the logistics and controlling the climate during transport. By choosing
low-carbon shipping methods, we help to reduce carbon emissions.

We process
[chevron]

At our modern processing facilities we carefully sort, clean, process and package our fruit to the
highest standards of quality and food safety. We implement energy- and water-saving measures in
these processes. Our whole fruit approach minimises waste and promotes circularity.

We pack
[chevron]

Our fruits are protected during transportation and in storage. We use sustainable packaging
materials and minimise waste to reduce our environmental impact. Biodegradable, compostable or
recyclable packaging materials are prioritised.

We sell
[chevron]

Our experienced commercial teams manage the entire sales process, from sourcing fruit to ensuring
safe transport to its final destination. We advise our customers to make informed decisions that
support them and a more sustainable planet.

We distribute
[chevron]

Our well-established distribution network ensures our fruit reaches markets in a timely manner,
providing consumers with delicious, fresh and sustainably grown products. Thanks to our global
presence and integrated approach, we are able to distribute efficiently to our local partners.

Our dedication to innovation and development is showcased through a wide range of innovations.

Serviced by our technical departments, we continually focus on new cultivar developments, product
innovation, ecologically conscious packaging, and other sustainability initiatives.

[Learn more about our innovations][6]
Our purpose is to do good with every avocado.
Vision
[chevron]

To be the world’s avocado leader, making the difference for our customers, partners, people and the
planet.

Mission
[chevron]

We work with our customers and growers to ignite a passion for avocados in every consumer by
delivering exceptional avocado experiences that help people to live healthy lives.

The people in Westfalia Fruit live our purpose every day.

Our team at Westfalia Fruit has the talent, commitment, and passion to do good. They truly live that
purpose and make us a leading and innovative avocado company.

As we have grown and evolved over 75 years, our dedication to our founders legacy remains
unwavering.

Our founder is Dr. Hans Merensky. His purpose was to do good. During his lifetime, he experimented
with many environmentally sustainable agricultural systems. The success of these initiatives helped
shape the environmental ethos of the company. It is maintained ever since.

[Learn more about our history][8]
Westfalia Fruit strives to minimise its environmental impact

We do so by reducing waste, carbon emissions, and the use of hazardous materials while using
resources efficiently.

[Our sustainability initiatives][9]
Our commitment to quality and sustainability is reflected in the extensive array of accreditations
and certifications we hold.

These accreditations and certifications play a pivotal role in guaranteeing that Westfalia Fruit's
products consistently surpass industry and customer expectations.

[Learn more about our accreditations][10]
Global presence
We grow our avocados across the world.

You can find Westfalia Fruit farms in major origins, including southern Africa, Chile, Colombia,
Peru, Portugal, the USA, and India. Our global presence allows us to serve both retail and wholesale
customers. Get in contact to learn what we can do for you.

# **AvoHealth** – **Avocado Oil Specialists**

**We provide Advisory Services to ensure you have an excellent business case to start manufacturing
***or*** marketing Avocado Oil.**

**AvoHealth** **also market/distribute **(often bulk)** Avocado Oil products all over the world.**
For our client production companies, w*e can handle 100% of your avocado oil marketing &
distribution.*

In 2025 we can supply:
1. **Bulk Unrefined CRUDE (raw) Avocado Oil **– *Shipped in 24,000 liter Flexitanks. Use as a food,*
   *nutraceutical or cosmetic ingredient.* We are confident our Crude Oil is such high quality,
   there is no chance the ‘toxins’ known as 3-MCPD ,or Glycidyl Esters will form in the refining
   process.
2. **Extra Virgin Avocado Oil** – *usually shipped in 1,000 liter IBC’s/Totes*

In future we will supply:
3. **Refined Avocado Oil **– RBD & RBDW – not before 2026

4. **Retail Avocado Oil** – packed to your requirements in dark glass bottles or Hi-Tech plastic
bottles designed for on-line retail (e.g. Amazon).
* Your Private Label, *or*
* AvoHealth brand

Andrew Logan – Presenter at World Avocado Congress 2023. Avocado Africa Congress 2024 + 2025

## **Personal service, best prices and the highest quality Avocado Oil**

Avocado Oil is a Functional Food, made from the healthiest fruit on earth. This new generation
Super-Food provides additional health benefits and anti-oxidant activity in the fights against
obesity, heart disease, dementia, blindness, skincare and a range of cancers. Read more about the
amazing [health benefits of AvoHealth Avocado Oil][15].

**AvoHealth** [provides advice][16] on every aspect of the Avocado Oil business; from feasibility
studies to the Agri-Tech processing technology required, to advising on product packaging & branding
to meet your target markets.

We advise on the optimum production machinery and plant design, to maximize oil quality & yields.
* New production plants are in constant planning and development.
* Each new production facility improves our supply of ‘clean label’, minimally processed, finest
  quality Avocado Oil.

[ripe avocado]

**Avocado Health Limited**, (**AvoHealth**), is incorporated in New Zealand. **Avocado Processors
EPZ Limited,** is incorporated in Kenya and trades as **AvoHealth Kenya.**  We receive regular
inquiry for assistance on new Avocado Oil Production Projects from Mexico & South America.
Currently, we are working on NEW projects in Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Uganda & Rwanda.  
* **November 2022:** – Held a seminar on the Avocado Oil industry for 43 participants in Nairobi,
  Kenya. Extensive meetings with many clients.

**April 2023: World Avocado Congress – Auckland, New Zealand**

Invited to make 2 presentations about the Avocado Oil industry.

**Presentation #1:** Is there a good business case to press Avocado Oil?

**Presentation #2:** Avocado Oil Processing – a model for self-regulation.


**May 2024 + May 2025 – Avocado Africa Congress** in Nairobi – a lead presenter always focussed on:
**‘The Business Case to enter the Avocado Oil industry**‘ *and*
‘**How to manufacture the Highest Quality Avocado Oil**‘

# About Us

Drop by, relax and enjoy some classic western charm and friendly customer service while tasting our
premium olive oils and balsamic vinegars.

There will be no beer and whiskey allowed at our bar, but plenty of shots of the freshest olive oils
from around the world. And corked, just for you.

It’s a tasting experience! So come on by and we’ll show you the ropes to a healthy and fun way to
enjoy the flavors of one of nature’s finest culinary delights! With over 50 products on tap (bottled
on the spot) we are sure we can help you add a little flair to your next meal.

## Proud Proprietors

Rich and Martha Bates are the proud owners of CAVE CREEK OLIVE OIL COMPANY. Their resume and
achievements are extensive so let’s condense their history to three points:
* Both Rich and Martha have each been in the restaurant business for 30 years. Most of those years
were in our great Grand Canyon State.
* Building and maintaining quality service were both of their industry trademarks and now they are
bringing that legacy (along with their passion for fresh food and products) to their store at the
Cave Creek location.
* Encouraging happy and healthy lifestyles for everyone to taste and enjoy!

Whether you are a culinary expert or just someone who loves healthy (and tasty) cuisine…you will feel right at home at Cave Creek Olive Oil Company!

“Grove to Table” is our motto and we are dedicated to delivering the HIGHEST quality oils and balsamics from all over the world…all year round.

# About Us

Drop by, relax and enjoy some classic western charm and friendly customer service while tasting our
premium olive oils and balsamic vinegars.

There will be no beer and whiskey allowed at our bar, but plenty of shots of the freshest olive oils
from around the world. And corked, just for you.

It’s a tasting experience! So come on by and we’ll show you the ropes to a healthy and fun way to
enjoy the flavors of one of nature’s finest culinary delights! With over 50 products on tap (bottled
on the spot) we are sure we can help you add a little flair to your next meal.

## Proud Proprietors

Rich and Martha Bates are the proud owners of CAVE CREEK OLIVE OIL COMPANY. Their resume and
achievements are extensive so let’s condense their history to three points:
* Both Rich and Martha have each been in the restaurant business for 30 years. Most of those years
were in our great Grand Canyon State.
* Building and maintaining quality service were both of their industry trademarks and now they are
bringing that legacy (along with their passion for fresh food and products) to their store at the
Cave Creek location.
* Encouraging happy and healthy lifestyles for everyone to taste and enjoy!

More About Jedwards…

Whom We Serve

Since our founding, our mission has been to be the go-to bulk wholesale supplier of natural, organic, and specialty raw materials for companies servicing multiple industries. Personal Care, Soapmaking, Cosmetic, Specialty Food, Candle Making, and Aromatherapy —each with their own challenges and requirements—are just a few of the industries Jedwards supports.

Contact Us

Why Choose Jedwards?

Jedwards International, Inc. is a family-owned business approaching a 100-year tradition of supplying wholesale specialty ingredients. Our origins were in the import and distribution of Omega-3 Fish Oils and Cod Liver Oil to Dietary Supplement producers. We have since evolved to specialize in supplying difficult-to-source Bulk Specialty Ingredients to small and mid-sized companies and contract manufacturers across North America.

As an established distributor, we proudly focus on Specialty Marine and Plant-based Oils and have developed long-standing partnerships across the globe. With inventory maintained in our own custom-built, geothermal facility south of Boston, Jedwards is well-positioned to adapt to supply chain challenges and disruptions as they arise for our bulk naturals and essentials portfolio.

# About Us

*Cod Liver Oil Processing in South Boston, Massachusetts (1940)*

**Jedwards International, Inc.** is a wholesale bulk supplier of natural Ingredients. Our
incorporation in 1994 represents the continuation of a** **100-year family tradition in the
**specialty oils and ingredient market,** which started with the processing and refining of cod
liver oil in South Boston.

Jedwards International has worked aggressively to expand its product line to include many
**difficult-to-source, custom-manufactured materials,** such as our certified Organic Fair Trade
Virgin Shea Butter. We own and operate a **state-of-the-art geothermal temperature-regulated
warehouse** in Massachusetts, from which we can quickly supply a variety of carrier oils, essential
oils, waxes, salts, sweeteners, extracts and concentrates. As a result, Jedwards has become a
**leading supplier to many small and mid-sized manufacturers** of many hot personal care
ingredients, including Moroccan Argan Oil, Olive Oil Squalane, Shea Butter, Jojoba Oil, and Virgin
Coconut Oil.

Jedwards has developed an extensive global network of manufacturing and supply partners,
consolidating each of their unique strengths under one roof. **Our mission** is to supply innovative
specialty oils and other bulk ingredients to the food, dietary supplement, cosmetic, soap and candle
making industries and to help our customers grow. A strategic partner to vendor and customer alike,
**Jedwards International brings value and innovation** to the marketplace. We encourage you to
explore the wealth of information and products available.

][401]

Our Herbal Chai Tea is a robust and aromatic mixture of seven traditional spices for a classic chai
experience. This fragrant blend is crafted with warming spices, including Cinnamon chips, Ginger,
and Cloves. The combination is expertly balanced, featuring whole and crushed pieces of high-quality
botanicals to ensure maximum flavour release when brewed.

This blend is rich in complex, layered aromas, perfect for making a traditional, invigorating chai
beverage. The formula includes Coriander, Star Anise, Cardamom Pods, and Allspice, creating a spicy
depth that is both comforting and vibrant. The addition of **black pepper** provides a welcome
warmth and bite. This **caffeine-free spice mix** is traditionally simmered with milk (dairy or
non-dairy) and sweetened for a rich, creamy drink. This seven-spice, caffeine-free chai blend brings
authentic warmth and aroma to your kitchen.
* Aromatic spice mix for a classic chai preparation
* Contains seven spices for robust flavour
* Features warming spices like Cinnamon, Ginger, and Cloves
* Includes whole Cardamom Pods and Star Anise
* Caffeine-free base that is traditionally simmered with milk
* Provides authentic warmth and spicy aroma

**Ingredients:** Coriander*, Cinnamon Chips*, Star Anise*, Cardamom Pods*, Allspice*, Cloves*,
Ginger*, Black Pepper*

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** Various parts of the world, processed in Canada

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

][401]

Italian Seasoning is a classic, fragrant blend of five essential herbs, simplifying the creation of
authentic Italian-inspired cuisine. This well-balanced mix combines basil, marjoram, oregano, and
sage with the savory depth of garlic. Having this convenient blend on hand makes it easy to bring
Mediterranean flavour to any dish.

This versatile herb blend is a must-have for all your kitchen needs, far beyond just pasta. Italian
Seasoning is **excellent for quickly flavouring marinades**, adding complexity to sauces, and
sprinkling over salads. It also works beautifully as a **dry rub for meats or poultry**, providing
rich, herbaceous notes. This five-ingredient, convenient blend ensures consistent, high-quality
flavour for your favorite meals.
* Fragrant blend of five herbs
* Contains basil, oregano, and marjoram
* Savory depth from garlic and sage
* Essential blend for authentic Italian-inspired cuisine
* Excellent for use in sauces, pasta, and salads
* Conveniently used as a dry rub or marinade seasoning

**Ingredients:** Basil*, Garlic*, Marjoram*, Oregano*, Sage*.

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** United States

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

Add a creamy crunch to your snacking with our whole Cashews. Cashews are the kidney-shaped seeds

**always sold shelled** only after a careful process of steaming and drying, which removes a
naturally occurring caustic resin.

**outstanding topping for oatmeal, yogurt, and desserts**, and they are the classic choice for
snacking straight out of the bag. You can use these versatile whole nuts to create smooth, homemade
cashew butter or creamy non-dairy sauces and salad dressings. Keep these flavorful cashews on hand
to elevate both sweet and savory recipes with their rich texture and substance.

Bring texture and flavour to your recipes with our Desiccated Large Coconut Flakes. These flakes are
made from fresh coconut meat that has been grated and dried, resulting in a substantial cut size.
Unlike the finer shreds, these **large flakes provide a hearty, satisfying chew** and a burst of
natural coconut flavor.

The larger size of these flakes makes them an excellent ingredient for both cooking and decoration.
Use them to make **delicious raw chocolate or energy bars**, where their size holds up well, or use
them as a crispy topping for granola, yogurt, and curries. They are also a flavorful substitute for
breadcrumbs in savory recipes. These versatile flakes are perfect for straight snacking or for
blending with water to create homemade coconut milk for any recipe.
* Desiccated Coconut Flakes (Dried)
* Large flake cut from fresh coconut meat
* Provides a hearty, satisfying chew and flavor
* Ideal for raw chocolate and energy bars

* Can be used to make homemade coconut milk

][404]

Our pure-white, creamy Virgin Unrefined Coconut Oil is made from the first pressing of fresh, raw
coconut meat without chemicals, resulting in an unbleached and undeodorized product. It features a
**mild, pleasant coconut flavor and scent** that enhances both food and body care applications.

Coconut oil is renowned for its incredible versatility in the home. Since it can be heated to high
temperatures, it is ideally suited for **frying, sautéing, and baking**, where it adds a subtle,
exotic note to dishes. Beyond the kitchen, its raw form makes it an excellent ingredient for skin
and hair moisturizing, or for oil pulling. Keep this single-ingredient, raw virgin coconut oil
stocked for a multi-purpose fat that works beautifully in both your cooking and personal care
routines.
* Virgin Unrefined Coconut Oil (Raw)
* Made from first pressing of fresh, raw coconut meat
* Features a mild coconut flavor and pleasant scent
* Ideal for frying, sautéing, and baking due to high heat suitability
* Excellent for use in skin and hair moisturizing routines
* Unbleached, unhydrogenated, and undeodorized pure product

**Ingredient:** Coconut Oil*

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** Philippines / Sri Lanka

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

stocked for wholesome snacking, or to effortlessly add a luxurious, sweet component to any meal or
platter.

Whole Elderberries are the small, bluish-black fruits of a flowering plant native to Europe,
Northern Africa, and Western Asia. The Elder plant produces large clusters of small, white flowers
in the spring, followed by these unique berries. Elderberries have a long history of use in
traditional European preparations and contain naturally occurring vitamins A, B, and C.

These whole dried berries are incredibly versatile for both culinary and herbal applications. It is
important to know that **Elderberries are always best consumed cooked**, as this process neutralizes
the astringency naturally present in the seeds and stems. They can be used to make **teas,
tinctures, and traditional syrups**, or incorporated into recipes for cordials, wines, and even
ketchups. Dried berries can also be added to pancake or muffin batter for a flavour similar to, but
less sweet than, blueberries. This historically valued, nutrient-containing whole berry is a staple
ingredient for year-round use.
* Whole Elderberries (bluish-black fruit)
* Native plant from Europe, Africa, and Western Asia
* Contains naturally occurring vitamins A, B, and C
* Best consumed cooked to neutralize astringency
* Ideal for making syrups, teas, and tinctures
* Can be used in wines, cordials, and baked goods

**Ingredient:** Elderberry*.

Add a rich, earthy flavor to your cooking with our Brown Flax Seeds. Flax seeds have been used for
centuries, with origins tracing back to Babylon over 3,000 years ago. This traditional brown variety
is prized for its distinctive, slightly deeper, and nuttier taste compared to golden flax. When used
whole, they provide a **satisfying, subtle pop of crunch**.

These highly versatile seeds are easy to use in both sweet and savory recipes. Sprinkle them whole
over **salads, stir-fries, or blend them into your morning smoothie**. They are an essential
ingredient for adding texture and character to breads, crackers, and dense baked goods. For maximum
utility, you can easily grind them into powder to incorporate into granola, cereal, or batters. Keep
these nutty, traditional brown flax seeds stocked for a simple, earthy ingredient that complements a
wide range of dishes.
* Brown Flax Seeds
* Offers a distinctive, slightly deeper, and nuttier flavor
* Provides a satisfying, subtle crunch when used whole
* Versatile for sprinkling on salads and blending into smoothies
* Essential for adding texture to breads and baked goods
* Can be ground into powder for granola or cereal

**Ingredient:** Flax Seeds*

Indulge in the zesty kick of our Ginger Cubes. These chunks of crystallized ginger are made from
ginger and lightly dusted with raw cane sugar. Cut into small 10-12mm squares, they provide a
**balanced blend of spicy warmth and enjoyable sweetness**.

These ginger cubes are an invaluable item for snacking and adding zing to recipes. They are perfect
for **tossing into trail mixes, adding to baked goods, or simply snacking on their own** when you
need a little burst of flavor. You can also chop them finely to incorporate them into salads, or
steep them in hot water for a warm, comforting beverage. Keep these easy-to-use, spicy-sweet ginger
cubes stocked in your pantry for instant flavor and warmth in countless sweet and savory
applications.

use. Keep these easy-to-use, distinctive dried berries stocked for a flavorful addition to your
everyday routine.

* Can be soaked in water to soften before use

][401]

Thick rolled Oats are a highly versatile grain, processed for both speed and flavour. Raw oat groats
are separated from their hulls, lightly steamed, rolled, and then kiln-dried to preserve their rich,
nutty flavour. This method also extends their shelf life, making them a pantry essential. They
retain their classic texture and are ready for both sweet and savoury recipes.

These thick rolled oats are naturally rich in important dietary components. Oats contain complex
carbohydrates, plant-based protein, and plenty of dietary fiber. They also supply **essential
minerals such as magnesium, phosphorus, and zinc**, along with B vitamins. They are **perfect for
classic morning oatmeal, hearty granola, or muesli**. For a quick and effortless meal, try soaking
them overnight in milk for creamy “overnight oats.” These hearty, quick-cooking oats are the
dependable choice for a wholesome, foundational grain.
* Thick rolled oats for classic texture
* Kiln-dried to preserve flavour and extend shelf life
* Naturally rich in complex carbohydrates and dietary fiber
* Good source of protein and minerals (magnesium, zinc, phosphorus)
* Ideal use in oatmeal, granola, and muesli
* Great base for easy overnight oats

**Ingredient:** Oats* (Avena sativa)

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** Canada

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

][401]

Simplify your weeknight cooking with our White Quinoa. Highly cherished by ancient civilizations,
this versatile pseudocereal is a modern-day staple. The whole seed is carefully **cleaned and ready
to cook**, providing a quick and flavorful base for countless meals.

White quinoa has a mild, delicate flavor that makes it incredibly easy to use. It cooks up quickly
with a light, **fluffy texture and pleasant chewiness** that complements both hot and cold dishes.
You can easily substitute it for most grains in both sweet and savory recipes, using it in salads,
soups, stews, or even breakfast porridge with fruit. Keep this gluten-free whole seed ready for
satisfying meals that come together in minutes.
* White Quinoa (Whole Seed)
* Highly versatile and quick-cooking
* Features a mild, delicate flavor and chewy texture
* Cooks up fluffy and light
* Excellent gluten-free substitute for most grains
* Ideal for salads, soups, and porridge

**Ingredient:** Quinoa* (Chenopodium quinoa)

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** Bolivia

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

Whole Rosemary leaves comes from an evergreen perennial herb in the mint family, recognizable by its
fragrant, needle-like green leaves. The leaves are separated after cultivation for use, providing a
strong, intact form of the herb. Rosemary is a notable and essential ingredient in Italian and other
Mediterranean cuisines, prized for its deep flavour profile.

The whole leaves offer a slightly astringent, sweet, and pronounced piney flavour that is highly
versatile in the kitchen. Rosemary is a source of **fiber, calcium, and iron**, making it a
flavourful addition to your diet. The crushed leaves can be easily added to a wide variety of
recipes, including **potatoes, baked breads, soups, and savory sauces**. A whole twig can also be
stored in vinegar to create a fragrant, flavoured infusion. This essential, whole Mediterranean herb
is a staple for adding warmth and complexity to savory dishes.
* Whole Rosemary Leaf (needle-like form)
* Perennial herb from the mint family
* Key ingredient in Italian and Mediterranean cuisine
* Offers a sweet, piney, and slightly astringent flavour
* Source of fiber, calcium, and iron
* Excellent addition to potatoes, breads, soups, and sauces

A highly diverse mix of seven wild sea vegetables is found in the Seven Sea-Veggies Blend. All
ingredients, including dulse, nori, wakame, kombu, and sea lettuce, are sustainably wildcrafted and
hand-harvested from the icy, clean waters of the Bay of Fundy, Canada. The harvest is then sun-dried
to preserve the integrity of the sea vegetables. This blend offers a convenient, single product
featuring multiple sea vegetable varieties.

Each sea vegetable contributes a wealth of minerals, vitamins, and trace elements from the sea. The
blend naturally contains sodium, along with protein and fiber from the dulse and sea lettuce
components. OM Foods offers this blend as a versatile and nourishing seasoning. It can be **easily
sprinkled on meals** as a flavourful addition, or used to enhance **rice dishes and soup stocks**.
Its natural qualities and ease of use make it an essential culinary staple for adding unique depth
to any recipe.
* Blend of seven sustainably wildcrafted sea vegetables
* Hand-harvested from the Bay of Fundy, Canada

* Sun-dried to preserve natural integrity
* Easily sprinkled on meals as a nutritious seasoning
* Ideal for flavouring rice, soups, and stocks

][401]

The rich, complex aroma is the primary feature of OM Foods’ Vanilla Beans, whole. Whole vanilla
beans offer a deep, natural sweetness and a highly fragrant flavour far superior to artificial
extracts. These pods are the dried, cured fruit of the vanilla orchid, providing the true, classic
vanilla taste that defines gourmet baking and pastry. They are prized by chefs and home cooks alike
for their intense aromatic oil.

Vanilla beans are a staple for anyone serious about creating decadent desserts, custards, and ice
creams. Scrape out the tiny, concentrated seeds to infuse batters and creams with unmistakable
flavour, then simmer the entire pod in milk for an extra layer of richness. These whole beans are
also **essential for making homemade vanilla extract**. OM Foods delivers **premium, whole vanilla
beans** that provide a highly fragrant and economical way to elevate your recipes and craft your own
flavourings.
* Whole, dried, cured fruit of the vanilla orchid
* Offers deep, natural sweetness and intense aroma
* Provides the true, classic vanilla taste for gourmet baking
* Essential ingredient for custards, ice creams, and desserts
* Perfect for making homemade vanilla extract
* Highly fragrant and economical way to flavour recipes

**Ingredient:** Vanilla Beans* (Vanilla planifolia).

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** Madagascar

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

Green Yerba Mate is a celebrated cultural staple harvested from the subtropical regions of South
America. Our Mate is grown wild in Brazil among local flora and fauna, and it is harvested every two
years in alternating patches. This sustainable harvesting practice ensures a well-developed plant
with an excellent nutritional profile while preserving the area's natural ecosystem.

This traditional beverage is known for its refreshing, slightly bitter flavour and stimulating
properties. Yerba Mate has been consumed for centuries, first by the indigenous Guaraní and Quechua
people. Today, it remains a widely consumed staple across South America. Mate is a **well-balanced
stimulant** with caffeine levels falling between those of green tea and coffee. It is commonly
prepared as a tea, either hot or cold (tereré), and can be enjoyed with **milk, honey, lemon, or
mint**. This culturally significant, invigorating leaf offers a traditional South American
experience.
* Whole leaves from the Yerba Mate shrub
* Sustainably harvested in Brazil from wild-grown plants
* Harvested every two years in alternating patches
* Historically consumed by Guaraní and Quechua people
* Refreshing, bitter flavour with a well-balanced stimulant effect
* Versatile preparation as hot tea or cold tereré

**Ingredient:** Yerba Mate* (Ilex paraguariensis)

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** Brazil

][401]

Our Red Rose Petals are beautifully fragrant botanicals and come from the Rosa centifolia blooms.
These delicate petals are hand-harvested in the early morning hours, a traditional practice that
ensures their natural oils are at their peak. They are then gently dried to perfectly preserve their
vibrant colour and naturally sweet, delicate aroma.

These naturally colourful and aromatic petals are incredibly versatile for both culinary and home
crafting. They can be **added to loose-leaf tea blends** for a subtle floral note or used as a
decorative addition to cakes and desserts. Beyond the kitchen, they are wonderful for
**incorporation into homemade bath salts, candles, potpourri, and natural skincare recipes**. This
fragrant, vibrant botanical is perfect for enhancing your tea, crafting projects, and bathing
rituals with elegance.
* Fragrant petals from Rosa centifolia blooms
* Hand-harvested in the early morning to preserve natural oils
* Gently dried to maintain vibrant colour and delicate aroma
* Ideal addition to loose-leaf tea blends for floral notes
* Perfect for decorative use on cakes and desserts
* Excellent inclusion in bath salts and DIY cosmetic recipes

**Ingredient:** Rose Petals* (Rosa centifolia) may contain some rose buds as pictured.

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** India

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

][401]

Our Mountain Trail Mix is a satisfying blend of sweet, tart, and crunchy ingredients designed for
sustained energy. This trail mix features a delicious combination of pecans and Brazil nuts
alongside sweet, soft diced apricots and tart cranberries. Every handful delivers a complex mix of
textures and flavours, making it the ideal snack for active days or afternoon cravings.

The mix is elevated with rich chocolate chips and a touch of warming spice. Included are semi-sweet
chocolate chips, providing a decadent balance to the fruit and nuts. A hint of **Cassia cinnamon
powder** and **Himalayan sea salt** ensures a perfectly seasoned, balanced flavour profile. This
blend provides a wholesome, ready-to-eat source of energy that perfectly balances indulgence and
nutrition.
* Nut and fruit blend for sustained energy
* Features pecans and Brazil nuts
* Contains apricots and tart cranberries
* Includes semi-sweet chocolate chips
* Perfectly seasoned with cinnamon and Himalayan sea salt
* An ideal, ready-to-eat snack for hiking or daily fuel

naturally sweetened, versatile dried fruit is an excellent pantry staple for year-round flavour and
colour.

[Description][398] [Ingredients & Origin][399] [Other][400] [ Reviews
][401]

The unique taste of Botija olives is complemented by aromatic herbs in the Pitted Herbed Botija
Olives. These are a red and black mix of olives grown on the desert coastal plains of southern Peru.
After being cured, the olives are dried at low temperatures, ensuring they remain juicy and
flavourful with their natural oils intact. The distinctive olive flavour is enhanced by a mild
seasoning blend.

Each olive is fully pitted for ultimate convenience, ready to be enjoyed straight from the package.
The seasoning features a savoury Mediterranean blend of tarragon, thyme, and oregano, along with sea
salt. OM Foods curates this **flavourful, shelf-stable snack** as a perfect shortcut to adding
complexity to your meals. They are wonderful in salads or can be featured as a **simple, seasoned
snack**. Their distinctive herbal flavour makes them an essential ready-to-eat item for quick
culinary use.
* Distinctive Botija olive variety (red & black mix)
* Seasoned with tarragon, thyme, and oregano
* Cured and dried at low temperatures to retain natural oils
* Fully pitted for quick and easy use
* Wonderful in salads and as a simple snack
* A flavourful, ready-to-eat Mediterranean ingredient

**Ingredients:** Botija Olives* (Olea europaea), Pitted, Cured, Dehydrated, Red & Black Mix, Sea
Salt, Tarragon*, Thyme*, Oregano*.

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** Peru

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

][401]

Grow your own fresh greens with our Sprouting Mix (Sandwich Mix). This blend features a satisfying
combination of alfalfa, red clover, Daikon, and China rose radish seeds, along with mung beans and
broccoli seeds. The mix is specifically designed to produce **tasty, nutrient-dense sprouts with
varied textures and flavors** right on your kitchen counter.

Enjoy the fresh taste and vibrant crunch of homegrown sprouts in just a few days. Simply **soak the
seeds for 4–6 hours, then rinse them twice daily** to encourage sprouting. Once ready, these sprouts
make a fantastic addition to sandwiches, wraps, and salads, instantly boosting the freshness of your
meal. Rotating the container daily helps ensure good airflow for even growth. Keep this easy-to-use,
versatile mix stocked for a continuous supply of fresh, crunchy, homemade sprouts.
* Sprouting Mix (Sandwich Mix)
* Blend of alfalfa, clover, radish, mung bean, and broccoli seeds
* Designed for growing fresh sprouts at home
* Easy to use process: soak then rinse twice daily
* Adds a fresh, vibrant crunch to sandwiches and salads
* Yields tasty, varied sprouts with different textures and flavors

**Ingredients:** Alfalfa Seeds*, Red Clover Seeds*, Daikon Radish Seeds*, China Rose Radish Seeds,
Mung Beans, Broccoli Seeds.

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** Various parts of the world, processed in Canada

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

A warmly spiced, golden infusion of roots and spices forms OM’s Turmeric Tea Blend. This unique,

complemented by true cinnamon and cassia cinnamon, and lightly sweetened with stevia. The blend is
carefully formulated to be a soothing, flavourful beverage base that can be enjoyed daily.

Black peppercorn is included in the blend to aid in the bioavailability of the curcumin found in the
turmeric root. OM Foods suggests using one teaspoon per cup of boiling water for preparation. The
final product can be enjoyed alone, or with the addition of milks or milk alternatives to create a
delicious **“golden milk”** beverage. This **versatile spice mix** is also delicious added to
oatmeal, pancakes, dressings, and desserts, making it an essential culinary staple for flavour and
warmth.

* Naturally sweetened with stevia leaf

* An essential staple for flavouring both drinks and food

Satisfy your savoury cravings with OM Foods Almonds, tamari roasted. We start with whole almonds,
season them lightly with authentic tamari (water, soybeans, salt, alcohol), and then roast them to
crispy perfection. This process creates a deliciously salty and umami-rich snack that's ready to
enjoy right out of the bag.

Almonds are a renowned nutritional powerhouse, naturally rich in **monounsaturated and
polyunsaturated fats** and dietary fibre. They are an excellent source of Vitamins E and B2, biotin,
and antioxidants, as well as several essential minerals like magnesium, calcium, and iron. These
flavourful nuts are commonly enjoyed as a healthy snack on their own, or you can add them to salads
and stir-fries for a salty crunch. They are a convenient and wholesome way to boost your daily
nutrient intake.
* Whole almonds seasoned with tamari and roasted
* Features a deliciously salty and umami-rich flavour
* Rich in monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats and dietary fibre
* Excellent source of Vitamins E and B2, and magnesium
* Ideal for healthy snacking or sprinkling over salads

Get reliable lift in all your baked goods with our Double Acting Baking Powder. This essential

consistent leavening in all your homemade sweet and savory creations, resulting in light, fluffy
results every time.

Create light, fluffy baked goods with our food grade Baking Soda. This pure, natural sodium
bicarbonate (NaHCO3) is produced from underground deposits in **Colorado, USA**. The raw material is
extracted with hot water, recrystallized, dried, and screened to create a fine powder. This product
is **OMRI certified and aluminum free**.

Baking soda’s primary use in the kitchen is as a powerful leavening agent. When exposed to heat or
acidic components in batters, it releases carbon dioxide gas, which causes dough and batter to
expand and results in a lighter texture. Sodium bicarbonate can be substituted for baking powder,
provided sufficient acid is added to the recipe. This versatile pantry staple has a slightly salty,
alkaline taste and is not tested on animals.
* Food Grade Baking Soda (Sodium Bicarbonate)
* Pure and natural NaHCO3
* Sourced from underground deposits in Colorado, USA
* OMRI certified and aluminum free

Grow your own fresh, zesty sprouts at home with our Broccoli Sprouting Seeds. These seeds are
specifically intended for sprouting, yielding young broccoli sprouts that have a **pleasantly
radishy taste** and a look similar to alfalfa sprouts. Starting your own sprouts is an engaging and
rewarding process that brings fresh greens right to your kitchen.

Sprouting these seeds is easy and takes less than a week. Seeds should be soaked for 4-6 hours to
begin the germination process. You’ll need to **thoroughly rinse them with cool water every 8-12
hours** until they are ready to harvest in 5-7 days. Enjoy your fresh sprouts by using them to top
sandwiches, salads, or adding them to wraps and stir-fries. Keep these seeds on hand to ensure a
continuous supply of fresh, homegrown flavor.
* Broccoli Sprouting Seeds
* Produces fresh sprouts with a radishy taste
* Soaking time is 4-6 hours
* Requires rinsing every 8-12 hours
* Sprouts are ready to harvest in 5-7 days
* Great for topping sandwiches, salads, and wraps

**Ingredient:** Broccoli Seeds* (Brassica oleracea)

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

The powerful, savoury essence of the South is blended into OM Foods’ Cajun Seasoning. This blend is
a flavorful mix of black pepper, cayenne, sea salt, garlic, onion, and paprika. Together, these
spices create the intense, classic flavour profile that defines traditional Cajun and Creole
cuisine. It’s the easiest way to bring this bold regional taste directly to your kitchen.

This spice blend is incredibly flexible and can be used far beyond classic dishes like gumbo and
jambalaya. Use it to season meats and fish before grilling or baking, or mix it into rice and
vegetable dishes for a spicy kick. It also works well when added to soups, stews, and sauces where
you need a deep, complex flavour. OM Foods delivers a **versatile, ready-to-use blend** that is
perfect for everyday seasoning and is a **must-have pantry staple** for adding a punch of flavour.
* Savory blend of six spices and sea salt
* Key ingredients include black pepper, cayenne, and paprika
* Creates the intense, classic flavour of Cajun cuisine
* Incredibly flexible for use in many recipes
* Ideal for gumbo, jambalaya, fish, and sauces
* A must-have staple for adding bold flavour instantly

**Ingredients:** Black Pepper*, Cayenne*, Sea Salt, Garlic*, Onion*, Paprika*.

**Origin:** United States

][401]

Add a clean, bright sourness and preserving power to your kitchen creations with our Citric Acid.
This Anhydrous Citric Acid is produced to USP grade standards through a submerged **fermentation
process** using glucose sources obtained from sugar cane. It is a highly versatile crystalline or
powder ingredient with a signature mouth-puckering sour flavor.

Citric acid is invaluable in food applications for flavor and preservation. It works as an effective
preservative to regulate pH levels in canned goods and prevents fresh fruit from oxidizing, keeping
it bright. When used for flavor, it provides the classic sourness for candy coatings and can even be
used as a sodium-free salt replacement to enhance dishes. It also functions as an **emulsifier to
eliminate fat globules in homemade ice cream**, ensuring a smoother texture. This multi-purpose
culinary ingredient is a staple for bakers, canners, and those seeking vibrant, sour flavors.
* Citric Acid (Anhydrous, USP Grade)
* Produced via fermentation of sugar cane glucose
* Functions as an effective pH-regulating preservative
* Used for strong, mouth-puckering sour flavor
* Excellent sodium-free salt replacement
* Acts as an emulsifier in homemade ice cream

**Ingredient: ** Citric Acid (Anhydrous is produced by submerged fermentation of glucose sources
obtained from sugar cane). USP grade.

**Origin:** Colombia

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

][401]

Ensure light, stable meringues and baked goods with our GMO-Free Cream of Tartar. This fine, white
powder is pure Potassium Bitartrate, sourced from **Spain**, and features a pleasant, slightly
acidic taste. Interestingly, this kitchen staple is actually a by-product of the winemaking process,
purified from the sediment left in barrels after wine fermentation.

Cream of tartar is a crucial ingredient for whipping egg whites. It helps **speed up the creation of
foam and maintains the fluffiness** required for towering meringues and delicate desserts. It can
also be used as a convenient leavening agent substitute for baking powder when blended with baking
soda (using the ratio: 1/4 tsp baking soda plus 1/2 tsp cream of tartar). Beyond baking, this
versatile pantry ingredient can be added to boiling water to help vegetables retain their bright
color.
* GMO-Free Cream of Tartar
* Single ingredient Potassium Bitartrate
* Sourced from Spain
* By-product of the winemaking process
* Essential for stabilizing whipped egg whites
* Substitute for baking powder when combined with baking soda

**Ingredient: ** Potassium Bitartrate

**Origin:** Spain

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

Our salt-free OM Curry Powder blend is a blend of ten spices, ensuring a full, rich flavour in every
dish. This expertly balanced mix combines the deep, earthy tones of cumin and mustard with the
bright "zing" of ginger and the complex undertones of turmeric, coriander, and fenugreek. The
flavour profile is enhanced by cayenne, cardamom, cinnamon, and black pepper.

Containing ten distinct ingredients, this blend is essential for crafting authentic curries, soups,
and stews. Because this blend is **completely salt-free**, you have complete control over the final
seasoning of your meal. Curry powder is wonderfully versatile, easily added to **eggs, meat dishes,
vegetables, or blended with mayonnaise or yogurt** to create a flavourful dipping sauce. This
ten-spice, salt-free blend is a necessary foundation for exploring rich, complex international
flavours in your kitchen.
* OM blend of ten spices
* Completely salt-free for customized seasoning control
* Features turmeric, coriander, cumin, and ginger
* Balanced flavour combining earthy, zesty, and sweet notes
* Essential base for Indian curries, soups, and stews
* Excellent addition to eggs, meat, vegetables, and dipping sauces

**Ingredients:** Turmeric*, Coriander*, Cumin*, Ginger*, Cinnamon*, Black Pepper*, Fenugreek*,
Cayenne*, Mustard*, Cardamom*.

*Certified Organic by Pro-Cert

**Origin:** Canada

**Storage:** Store in a cool, dry place, away from heat and moisture. Protect from direct sunlight.

# **get to know us.**

## **Meet Hasan Al-Kailani, the ****brain behind AvoVenture Consulting****.**

With over 32 years of experience in business management, Hasan Al-Kailani is the brain behind
AvoVenture Consulting. Prior to starting his consultancy firm, Hasan co-founded and managed Avolio
Industries Ltd., a million-dollar avocado oil manufacturer in Uganda. Through his hands-on
experience establishing Avolio, Hasan became a seasoned expert in all aspects of avocado oil
production — from initial planning and marketing to machine installation and production
optimization, and beyond.

Hasan is committed to sharing his knowledge and expertise with others in the industry as a mentor
and advisor. Through AvoVenture Consulting, he helps individuals and businesses navigate the
complexities of avocado oil production — because he’s been there.
* #### why work with him?

Throughout his career, Hasan has demonstrated a deep understanding of the intricacies of business
operations and market dynamics. His diverse skill set includes strategic planning, operational
management, and industry analysis, making him a trusted advisor to those looking to establish an
avocado oil factory and those seeking ways to improve operations at an existing facility.
