# the aspiring entrepreneur.
* ## supply chain management

A robust supply chain is the backbone of any successful avocado oil business. At AvoVenture
Consulting, we specialize in optimizing supply chain processes to enhance efficiency, reduce
costs, and mitigate risks. From sourcing high-quality avocados to managing transportation and
storage logistics, we'll help you build a resilient supply chain that meets the demands of your
production schedule and ensures consistent product quality. With our strategic guidance, you can
streamline operations, minimize waste, and maintain a competitive edge in the market.
* ## factory setup

Setting up an avocado oil factory requires meticulous planning and precise execution. With
AvoVenture Consulting by your side, you can rest assured that every aspect of your factory setup
will be handled with expertise and efficiency. From selecting the right equipment to designing
ergonomic layouts, we'll ensure that your facility is optimized for seamless production and
maximum output. Our goal is to help you create a state-of-the-art manufacturing environment that
fosters innovation, productivity, and profitability.
* ## planning & consultation

At AvoVenture Consulting, we understand that every avocado oil venture is unique. That's why we
offer tailored consultation and planning services to guide you from conception to execution. We’ll
work closely with you to develop a customized roadmap that aligns with your vision, budget, and
timeline. Whether you're starting from scratch or looking to optimize your current operations,
we're here to provide the strategic insights and actionable recommendations you need to succeed.

**what we can offer**

# the established manufacturer.
* ## product diversification

In today's rapidly evolving market, innovation is essential for staying relevant and driving
growth. Our product diversification services are geared towards helping you expand your product
offerings and capitalize on emerging trends. Whether you're interested in developing new avocado
oil products or entering niche markets, we'll collaborate with you to conceptualize, prototype,
and launch innovative products that resonate with your target audience. With our expertise in
product development and consumer insights, you can unlock new revenue streams and differentiate
your brand in the marketplace.
* ## market expansion

Expanding into new markets is a strategic imperative for scaling your avocado oil business. At
AvoVenture Consulting, we offer comprehensive market expansion services to help you identify
lucrative opportunities, navigate regulatory requirements, and establish a strong foothold in new
territories. We'll help you develop a customized market entry strategy that aligns with your
business objectives and drives sustainable growth. With our global network of partners and
industry connections, you can confidently explore new horizons and unlock untapped potential for
your brand.
* ## process optimization

Continuous improvement is key to staying ahead in the avocado oil industry. Our process
optimization services are designed to identify inefficiencies, eliminate bottlenecks, and enhance
overall productivity. Using a tried-and-tested and cutting-edge methodologies, we'll conduct a
comprehensive assessment of your current operations and develop tailored solutions to optimize
every stage of the production process. Whether it's refining extraction techniques, fine-tuning
refining processes, or optimizing packaging workflows, we'll work tirelessly to maximize output
while minimizing costs.

the United States.

or contact us directly with an inquiry.

Retailers

From small boutique projects to large mass-market orders, no demand is too challenging for BMA’s state-of-the-art bottling and packaging systems. For our clients, high efficiency doesn’t translate to high cost.

Brands

Establishing a private label partnership with BMA allows our clients to bring a product to market without compromising their vision or facing hefty upfront capital costs. ## About Us

Established in Van Nuys, California in 2000, BMA started off as a family owned and operated hands-on
business. Two decades later BMA has established comprehensive line of oils, a variety of custom
packaging options, is able to custom blend to a customer’s exact specifications, and has the latest
equipment which can process and fill 80 units per minute making order fulfillment fast.

BMA is an Importer, Manufacturer, Packer and Distributor of premium imported and domestic edible
oils. BMA has relationships with suppliers in Italy, Spain, Tunisia, Greece, Turkey, Mexico, South
America and California

BMA services grocery retailers, manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, foodservice, cash and
carry, and specialty retailers.

BMA has a number of established brands with Massimo Gusto being our most popular. Massimo Gusto is
our premium label and is quickly becoming one of the best known and fastest growing oil brands in
the United States.

For information on private label partnerships, products, and more, browse our site at your leisure
or contact us directly with an inquiry.

FAQ’s

Hours of Operation

The store and the warehouse are open during following hours :

Tuesday through Thursday, 9am to 5pm

Friday, 9am to 4pm

We are closed Saturday, Sunday and Monday

How to Order

You can place orders online or through our shipping app (coming soon!).
You can email orders to [email protected] . These orders will not show up in your online account history.
You can call us at 503-653-1155 with your order.
You can come in to the store and shop!
Read More..

How does Store Pickup Work

Store Pickup means that you will come in to our Milwaukie, Oregon store and pick up your order. Once you place a Store Pickup order with us, we will email you when it is ready. Store Pickup orders are usually processed within about two hours, but it all depends on how many orders we have to process. All orders are made in the order they are received. You are welcome to come in anytime after you have received the email to pick up your order. Please be sure to check your spam folder for this email as it may contain a copy of your invoice and often gets sent to spam.
Read More..

Shipping

Orders under 450 pounds are generally shipped UPS ground. Shipping can be calculated right on the website. We know shipping is expensive! We don’t make any profit on shipping, it is just what UPS charges us.
Pallet sized orders will be shipped using Echo Logistics. Freight can be calculated directly on the website.
If you have a small order, please call us directly as we can often ship via USPS and save you.
Read More..

Hours of Operation

The store and the warehouse are open during following hours :
* Tuesday through Thursday, 9am to 5pm
* Friday, 9am to 4pm
* We are closed Saturday, Sunday and Monday

How to Order

You can place orders online or through our shipping app (coming soon!).

You can email orders to [**[email protected]**][299]. These orders will not show up in your online
account history.

You can call us at** [503-653-1155][300]** with your order.

You can come in to the store and shop!
[Read More..][301]

How does Store Pickup Work

Store Pickup means that you will come in to our Milwaukie, Oregon store and pick up your order.
Once you place a Store Pickup order with us, we will email you when it is ready. Store Pickup
orders are usually processed within about two hours, but it all depends on how many orders we have
to process. All orders are made in the order they are received. You are welcome to come in anytime
after you have received the email to pick up your order. Please be sure to check your spam folder
for this email as it may contain a copy of your invoice and often gets sent to spam.
[Read More..][302]

Shipping

Orders under 450 pounds are generally shipped UPS ground. Shipping can be calculated right on the
website. We know shipping is expensive! We don’t make any profit on shipping, it is just what UPS
charges us.

Pallet sized orders will be shipped using Echo Logistics. Freight can be calculated directly on
the website.
If you have a small order, please call us directly as we can often ship via USPS and save you.

Hours of Operation

The store and the warehouse are open during following hours :
* Tuesday through Thursday, 9am to 5pm
* Friday, 9am to 4pm
* We are closed Saturday, Sunday and Monday

How to Order

You can place orders online or through our shipping app (coming soon!).

You can email orders to [**[email protected]**][299]. These orders will not show up in your online
account history.

You can call us at** [503-653-1155][300]** with your order.

You can come in to the store and shop!
[Read More..][301]

How does Store Pickup Work

Store Pickup means that you will come in to our Milwaukie, Oregon store and pick up your order.
Once you place a Store Pickup order with us, we will email you when it is ready. Store Pickup
orders are usually processed within about two hours, but it all depends on how many orders we have
to process. All orders are made in the order they are received. You are welcome to come in anytime
after you have received the email to pick up your order. Please be sure to check your spam folder
for this email as it may contain a copy of your invoice and often gets sent to spam.
[Read More..][302]

Shipping

Orders under 450 pounds are generally shipped UPS ground. Shipping can be calculated right on the
website. We know shipping is expensive! We don’t make any profit on shipping, it is just what UPS
charges us.

Pallet sized orders will be shipped using Echo Logistics. Freight can be calculated directly on
the website.
If you have a small order, please call us directly as we can often ship via USPS and save you.

Hours of Operation

The store and the warehouse are open during following hours :
* Tuesday through Thursday, 9am to 5pm
* Friday, 9am to 4pm
* We are closed Saturday, Sunday and Monday

How to Order

You can place orders online or through our shipping app (coming soon!).

You can email orders to [**[email protected]**][299]. These orders will not show up in your online
account history.

You can call us at** [503-653-1155][300]** with your order.

You can come in to the store and shop!
[Read More..][301]

How does Store Pickup Work

Store Pickup means that you will come in to our Milwaukie, Oregon store and pick up your order.
Once you place a Store Pickup order with us, we will email you when it is ready. Store Pickup
orders are usually processed within about two hours, but it all depends on how many orders we have
to process. All orders are made in the order they are received. You are welcome to come in anytime
after you have received the email to pick up your order. Please be sure to check your spam folder
for this email as it may contain a copy of your invoice and often gets sent to spam.
[Read More..][302]

Shipping

Orders under 450 pounds are generally shipped UPS ground. Shipping can be calculated right on the
website. We know shipping is expensive! We don’t make any profit on shipping, it is just what UPS
charges us.

Pallet sized orders will be shipped using Echo Logistics. Freight can be calculated directly on
the website.
If you have a small order, please call us directly as we can often ship via USPS and save you.

Aceitera Peninsular Española

Aceitera Peninsular Española S.L (APE) is a family run company, working in the world of olive oil
for five generations; a successful trajectory owed to our products and excellent results.
We are located in Priego de Cordoba, right in the epicenter of the best production zone of extra
virgin olive oil in Spain.

## THE PROCESS

COLLECTION PERIOD

From the second fortnight to the last days of december or January, depending on the variety and the
maturation of the fruit

EXTRACTION

Only by physical means and mechanical procedures so to guarantee the quality of a truly unique
product; extra virgin olive oil and virgin olive oil. Separately, we offer olive oil and refined
olive oil.

STORAGE

The olive oil is safely stored in inox deposits, with a controlled temperature which guarantees the
optimum conservation of the olives fruit and its properties.

BOTTLED OIL

Our bottling factory with its great versatility, can adapt to the needs of each and every one of our
clients.

## TU ACEITE DE SIEMPRE

Our vast experience in the world of olive oil is perfectly reflected in this range of olive oils,
under the brand “TuAceitedeSiempre”. Discover en EVOO which will wake up all your senses.

[DISCOVER OUR RANGE OF OLIVE OILS][14]

#### Organic Extra Virgin Avocado Oil

#### Organic Refined Avocado Oil

#### Extra Virgin Avocado Oil

#### Refined Avocado Oil

[MORE INFORMATION][15]

## CERTIFIED WARANTY

In accordance with our philosophy of offering high quality products, we have the IFS FOOD
(International Feature Standard Food Standard) certification, which supports the high level of
requirement in compliance with production, quality and hygiene standards. As well as the
certification of organic production with the European seal of organic farming; and the Kosher
certification.

## OUR VALORS

#### OUR QUALITY

It is guaranteed by our own laboratory, with highly qualified professionals and knowledge of the
specific market in which each client operates.

#### OUR AGILITY

Thanks to the knowlegde and the history of the business men, we can make tailore-made operations,
right away, for each one of our clients.

#### OUR SERIOUSNESS

The guarantee ACEITERA PENINSULAR. Our financial stability gives us the ability to offer a highly
competitive service and absolute confidence to our clients.

## THE FACTORY

All our olive oils are produced in our own factory, which has the best structure and the appropriate
machinery. Alongside the experienced work force, all necessary procedures are carried out to produce
extra virgin and virgin olive oil , with maximum rigor and quality control.

[SEE THE FACTORY][16]

## Extracted from nature, approved by science.

Atomm Botanicals is one of the world’s leading manufacturer and supplier of pure natural plant
derivates for the use in the cosmetic and industries. We redefine the power of plant extracts
through innovative extraction method by offering extracts for both water as well as oil medium.

Based on more than 17 years of intensive research and development in plant cellular science and
botanical extraction, Atomm Botanicals is a distinctively creative brand. Plant Extracts’ journey
started in 2006 and has been developing ever since. Significant scientific developments and
botanical discoveries have accompanied the evolution of botanical extracts. Atomm Botanicals is a
leader in the development of natural active substances and works with partners and growers. Our R&D
team is dedicated to creating technology to unlock and maximise the benefits of botanical species
for the cosmetic and pharmaceutical industries, and they are leading research on some of the most
potent plant-based concentrates in the world.

Using a ground-breaking extraction technique, all extracts and oils are offered in the liquid
carrier matrix of the plant to harness the potent phytoactives without the use of chemicals.
Atomm Botanicals’ products maintain the integrity of native botany responsibly, ethically, and while
maintaining excellent levels of quality, service, and delivery. It bridges the gap between the
complicated needs of the consumer and the actual power of untouched nature.
Atomm botanicals procure the finest selection of top ingredients grown and brewed to deliver
powerful nutrients to your skin. We use the finest ingredients and techniques to create herbal
blends that will hydrate your skin without fail.

# Health Benefits

### IT’S GOOD FOR YOU

The amazing avocado has many distinctive health benefits and is classed as a superfood by many. On
top of the many health benefits here are a few: It may reduce cholesterol, improve heart health and
lower blood pressure. It’s high in rich Oleic Acid, a very healthy fat. The essential fats found
avocados are essential for digestion and nutrient absorption because they nourish the lining of the
gut. It’s an all-round super food!

### IT HAS A HIGH SMOKE POINT

Not every oil is created equal. The benefit of avocado oil is that it can be heated to very high
temperatures. Why is this good? When oil is heated past its smoke point, the fat starts to break
down, releasing free radicals and any health benefit that the oil had is lost.

### EXTRA VIRGIN COLD PRESSED

Extra Virgin is the highest grade of avocado oil, produced from the pressing of good quality
avocados. Produced at low temperatures, without chemicals the oil is 100% pure and natural. Cold
pressing from the first press of the avocado fruit means retains the same high level of nutrients,
natural flavour, aroma and colour found in fresh avocado.

### 16 AVOCADOS IN EVERY BOTTLE

Every one of our 250ml bottles contains 16 cold pressed avocados. Quality Avocado Oil should have a
taste and colour characteristics of the fresh avocado fruit and be a dark vibrant green. We house
our oil in dark glass bottles, which keeps out light and oxygen retaining the quality of the oil

## Bella Vado® Avocado Oil

At Bella Vado, we proudly craft America’s original cold-pressed avocado oil—right here on our family
farm in Southern California. Every drop of our golden-green oil begins with hand-selected,
California-grown avocados, harvested at peak ripeness and cold-pressed within hours to preserve
their full flavor, vibrant color, and powerful nutrients.

As the first U.S. producer of unrefined, unfiltered avocado oil, we’ve stayed true to what matters:
quality, integrity, and real food. Our oil is never chemically extracted, deodorized, or
altered—just 100% pure, extra virgin avocado oil made the traditional way.

Bella Vado avocado oil is:

USA-made, from California-grown avocados

Cold-pressed, unrefined, and unfiltered

Naturally Non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, and high in heart-healthy fats

A versatile culinary oil perfect for dressings, sautéing, roasting, and more

From our grove to your table, we invite you to taste the difference that freshness, family values,
and California sunshine make.

## The Heart of the Avocado

Looking back, it’s hard to believe how quickly it all flew by. Late-night bottling parties where we
called in all our kids and their friends—well bribed with pizza and music. Grueling 72-hour oil
pressing marathons with rotating sleep shifts—while half of us still worked full-time jobs. We were
all in. We hustled. We stayed heads down. We loved the craft of turning our avocados into oil.

We poured ourselves into perfecting our oil, always analyzing, adjusting, and improving our process
year after year.

To us, It was always more than a product available on store shelves, quietly traveling in your
shopping cart and then patiently sitting on your kitchen counter.

 **Bella Vado is the heart of the avocado!**

# Home

## Pure, natural oils. Ethically produced.

Fairoils leads the way in the responsible and ethical production of quality essential and vegetable
oils. Our partnerships support local growers and strengthen communities in Africa.

[ Get in touch ][2]
[ Learn about our impact ][3]
[ ][4]

### We believe that responsible business makes the world a better place.

At the heart of Fairoils is the determination to help farmers and communities in Africa.

From seed through to supply, we manage every step of the production process. This stewardship allows
us to embed ethics and quality at every stage.

The result is pure, natural oils, produced to the highest ethical standards.

##### Fairoils embraces the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals as a clear blueprint for
##### the prosperity of people and our planet. We’re advancing these goals across our operations.

[ Find out how ][5]
[cooperatives large]

### Local cooperatives with real reach.

We know what’s possible when people work together, bonded by a common goal. Fairoils unites the
efforts of small-scale growers, commercial farms and local processing facilities to make a
difference.

##### Small scale grower projects

Our growers work as a collective, gaining a secure, additional income. [Learn about our impact][6]

##### Commercial farms

Commercial farms help secure supply and demonstrate co-commitment.

[Learn about how we farm][7]

##### Processing facilities

Crops are processed in state-of-the-art processing facilities in Kenya & Madagascar.

[Learn about processing][8]

### Our projects in Africa

Each of our projects is shaped by the local community.
Through careful design, we create meaningful impact at every step.
[ Learn about our impact ][9]
[africa_map@2x]

### Skills and income for farmers.

Our grower projects establish a farming cooperative between small-scale farmers. We foster the
skills farmers need to successfully grow crops for essential and vegetable oils. We also make
resources more accessible—seed, organic fertiliser, equipment and education.

And we help local farmers find new ways to work together, so they can collectively reach new
markets. Fairoils ensures that farmers gain secure, reliable income. Our farmers are paid quickly,
receiving a fair and transparent price for their crop.

[ Our fair trade commitment ][10]
OUR PROJECTS

### Madagascar

Our grower projects establish a farming cooperative between small-scale farmers. We foster the
skills farmers need to successfully grow crops for essential and vegetable oils. We also make
resources more accessible—seed, organic fertiliser, equipment and education.

And we help local farmers find new ways to work together, so they can collectively reach new
markets. Fairoils ensures that farmers gain secure, reliable income. Our farmers are paid quickly,
receiving a fair and transparent price for their crop.

### Over 50 pure, natural oils.

We’re proud to supply essential and vegetable oils to world-leading brands that share our commitment
to ethical production. We produce oils of the highest quality and purity. Our innovative business
model allows us to supply large volumes of vegetable and essential oils, year round.

• No Refrigeration Needed

[Read More][22]

### Extra Virgin Avocado Oil

Our 100% Extra Virgin Avocado Oil is Non-GMO, collected from the first cold pressed extraction of
quality ripe fruit pulp, to give you a neutral fresh unique flavor. This makes it ideal for most
high-heat cooking processes including baking, stir-frying, deep-frying, searing, barbecuing,
roasting, and Sautéing.The end result is a smooth, rich avocado oil that’s ideal for cooking,
baking, finishing, and even skincare.

[Read More][23]

### Contact Us

Thank you for taking the time to look at our website.

We appreciate your business and look forward to enhancing your business buying and supply chain
requirements.

We look forward to Growing with You.

About Us
**About Us**

Essential oils are admired for therapeutic uses. These oils are preferred largely for adding aroma
to perfumes, flavours to food and for medicinal purpose. These oils have the potential of improving
health and mood of a person, especially when used in aromatherapy. Bringing forth a huge line of
Essential Oils is **K. K. Enterprise**. 

Founded in **2002**, our company as a **manufacturer **and **exporter**, is producing Organic
Essential Oils like **Chamomile Oil, Lemon Grass Oil, Cedarwood Oil **and various others. These oils
are highly concentrated and aromatic. Apart from essential oils, we also produce Spice Oils, Carrier
Oils, Pine and Terpine Products such as** Camphor Oil, Black Pepper Oil, Pomegranate Seed Oil**,
etc. Our huge collection is appreciated by customers for quality excellence. 

Our 100% pure and effective oils are demanded in Indian and International market for effective use
and reliable results. From food to cosmetics, pharmaceutical, aromatherapy centres and more, our
collection finds used in various industries.

**Men Behind Successful Business Operations**

**Mr. Vijay Kalsaria **is the Proprietor of the company, skilled in handling diverse business tasks.
His entrepreneurship skills and right approach to serving clients is the main reason of company
getting appreciation from local and foreign buyers. Along with Mr. Kalsaria, **Dr. Paresh Kahar **is
leading the company as a Technical Expert. 

**Our Clients**

Our company is maintaining relations with industry leading names like:

* KANCOR Ingredients Limited
* Plant Lipids
* Synthite and more.

### We produce a cold-pressed avocado oil substitute with a focus on sustainable production and full
### compliance with International Standards

Production is carried out on an industrial scale using two production lines that operate year-round.

We manage the entire chain: from purchasing avocados to processing, packaging and export logistics.

We are located close to the raw material base, which allows us to significantly reduce logistics
costs, minimize the environmental footprint and ensure uninterrupted supplies.

We supply high-quality oil that meets food safety and traceability standards.

### Sustainable development and quality proven by our customers and time

#### Sustainable production

We strive for sustainable development, minimizing our ecological footprint. Our company actively
implements the principles of environmentally friendly production at every stage.

#### Logistics optimization

The location of our production close to the raw material base allows us to significantly reduce
logistics costs, which makes our deliveries more efficient and accessible.

#### High quality standards

We ensure that our avocado oil meets strict food safety and traceability standards, ensuring high
quality and reliability for our customers.

## We work with export traders working with organic oils, private label producers, distributors of
## edible oils and importers of natural products, retail chains working in the natural products
## segment and wholesale buyers.

### Readiness for European requirements and standards

We work only with certified suppliers, which guarantees quality and compliance with standards.
Products are accompanied by the necessary documentation to confirm organic production.

We know the specifics of document flow and logistics in the USA, UAE, Israel and the EU. This helps
to effectively organize deliveries and avoid delays

We offer various packaging formats to meet customer needs. Whether it is small packages for retail
or large volumes for wholesale, we can offer optimal solutions.

We value flexibility and individual approach to clients. We are ready to adapt offers to your needs

# 

# ABOUT US


**Our Mission**
We are a Mexican company dedicated to the production, transformation, commercialization and export
of avocado and derivatives at a global level, through the sustainability of our processes and
through an organizational ethic based on collaborative work with its stakeholders.
**Our Vision**
Being one of the best Mexican companies in the avocado and derivatives industry, recognized for the
quality of our products, for our commitment to the environment, for the development of our
collaborators and our operational excellence.
**Our Commitment**
We are committed to socially responsible management as part of our business strategy, having a
positive impact on the quality of life of our employees, the community that surrounds us and the
environment.
**The Future**
At MEVI Avocados we approach the future with passion and confidence, with an enduring belief in the
promise of avocado, a superfood that promotes the health and well-being of our consumers.

MEVI's foundation lies in 5 CORE VALUES:
**TRUST** We make sure that everyone involved with our company works with the same high purpose and
ethics, driving significant positive outcomes for our company and industry.
**RESPONSABILITY** We are committed to supplying exclusively healthy products, like the avocado and
its derivatives.
**HONESTY** We combine professionalism with integrity in all aspects of our business, including team
members and suppliers.
**RESPECT** We recognize the capabilities and achievements of clients, team members and suppliers.
**CUSTOMER SERVICE** We offer excellent personalized attention and responsiveness from the moment of
purchase until the delivery of our products, with the aim of fulfilling and exceeding the
expectations of our customers.

**ADVANTAGES OF OUR SERVICE**
Experience: Overall knowledge of production and management of avocados since 1974. Market experience
as a packer since 1994, and as an exporter―through APEAM―since 2003. Balanced Value Chain Method:
MEVI pledges to provide the best service through this process, ensuring full control from planting
the avocado, to its storage and distribution.

**TIMELINE**


[Timeline]

**Cold Storage:** MEVI owns Crosspoint, Inc.a South Texas cold storage facility with a 60 container
capacity that serves as a primary distribution point.

[Crosspoint Storage]

## MURICADO FRUIT SUPPLIES FROM TANZANIA

Muricado is a large-scale producer grower and supplier of **Fresh **and** quality **avocados**.** We
grow avocados and proudly guarantee that our products are 100% free from chemicals and unnatural
products.

With adequate experience in **growing, packing** and **shipping** avocados, Muricado has a deep
understanding of the avocado industry. At Muricado we know it is a privilege to deliver avocados
from our grower’s trees to our customer’s shelves. Through our vertically-integrated supply chain we
grow, source, pack and market quality avocados across the year and across the globe.

Muricado Fruit Supplies proudly operates a state-of-the-art avocado oil facility dedicated to
producing high-quality, pure crude avocado oil. Our facility is equipped with advanced technology to
ensure efficient oil extraction while maintaining and preserving the natural nutrients, vitamins
antioxidants and the natural integrity of the avocados.

## MURICADO FRUIT SUPPLIES FROM TANZANIA

Muricado is a large-scale producer grower and supplier of **Fresh **and** quality **avocados**.** We
grow avocados and proudly guarantee that our products are 100% free from chemicals and unnatural
products.

With adequate experience in **growing, packing** and **shipping** avocados, Muricado has a deep
understanding of the avocado industry. At Muricado we know it is a privilege to deliver avocados
from our grower’s trees to our customer’s shelves. Through our vertically-integrated supply chain we
grow, source, pack and market quality avocados across the year and across the globe.

Muricado Fruit Supplies proudly operates a state-of-the-art avocado oil facility dedicated to
producing high-quality, pure crude avocado oil. Our facility is equipped with advanced technology to
ensure efficient oil extraction while maintaining and preserving the natural nutrients, vitamins
antioxidants and the natural integrity of the avocados.

# OLVEA Vegetable Oils

OLVEA offers a wide range of **pure and natural vegetable oils** ([**COSMOS Approved**][85],
**[organic][86]**, **[upcycled][87] **or **[fair trade][88]**) for **cosmetics and nutrition**.

## Shorten the distance from Nature to Brands

In order to maintain the highest standards regarding the quality, traceability and consistency of
its raw materials, [OLVEA][89] has set up [**sustainable supply chains**][90] in Africa:

**• **In **[Morocco][91]**, for the production of OLVE’True™ **[Argan oil][92]** and OLVE’True™
**[Hazelnut oil][93]**,

• In [**Burkina Faso**][94], for the production of OLVE’True™ [**Shea** **butter**][95],

• In [**Kenya**][96], for the production of OLVE’True™ [**Avocado** **oil**][97], OLVE’True™
[**Macadamia oil**][98] and OLVE’True™**[Sesame oil][99]**.

Harvest & Logistics

## **Our Harvest & Delivery Process**

Our Hass avocados are harvested from February to September, ensuring peak quality and freshness,
while our habanero chilies are harvested throughout the year, with multiple picking cycles depending
on maturity. We provide consistent weekly shipments of both products, with flexible delivery options
via air freight (3–4 days to Hong Kong) or sea freight (21–24 days). Products are packed in 4 kg or
10 kg ventilated cartons, with private label options available for bulk orders. To maintain optimal
quality, all produce is pre-cooled within hours of harvest and stored at 5–7°C, guaranteeing
freshness from our farms to your business.

## Who We Are

**PRIMEAVO LIMITED** is a premier, vertically integrated agro-processing enterprise operating at the
intersection of sustainable agriculture and industrial manufacturing. Strategically headquartered in
Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, we specialize in the commercial cultivation of world-class avocados and the
advanced extraction of premium crude avocado oil for global industrial, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical
markets.

We manage our own commercial farms in Njombe, protecting buyers from the inconsistent yields and

### Advanced Mechanical Processing

Our modern facilities utilize chemical-free, mechanical extraction lines, guaranteeing a clean,
highly stable crude oil that retains its natural nutrients.

### Flawless Supply Chain Control

By managing everything from harvesting in Njombe to shipping, Primeavo delivers total integration,

## Engineered for Secure International Freight

Technical Specifications & Quality Parameters

To protect the complex chemical compounds of our crude oil over long-distance ocean transit,
Primeavo implements strict international bulk liquid logistics protocols. Every consignment is
shipped exclusively inside high-capacity, food-grade multi-layered flexi-tanks secured within
pristine **20-foot sea-freight containers****.**

Our technical rigging features an advanced 5-bar steel bulkhead retention system, a robust unibody
3-inch snaplock ball valve configuration, and complete interior insulation using heavy-duty
corrugated card linings. We provide a reliable, contamination-free arrival at any destination port
worldwide.

## Why Global Distributors Partner with Primeavo

### 100% Vertically Integrated

We cultivate our own Hass and Fuerte estates in the Njombe region, shielding buyers from the
volatile pricing and inconsistent volumes of out-grower networks.

### Chemical-Free Processing

Our modern processing facility utilizes advanced mechanical extraction lines that completely omit
harsh chemical solvents, preserving natural oil integrity.

### Bulletproof Traceability

Because we own the farms and the factory, we provide complete transparency and absolute batch
traceability for every single flexi-tank we export.

### Industrial Logistics Standards

Every consignment is rigged into low-age, strictly inspected 20ft ocean containers using premium
24-tonne food-grade flexi-tanks and heavy-duty steel bulkheads.

## Establish a Secure Supply Partnership

Connect directly with our commercial team in Dar es Salaam to request custom pricing, logistics
coordination, or contract manufacturing variables.

#### avocado oil exports.

Strategically positioned along Thika Superhighway, our company bridges local agricultural resources
with global market requirements.

* Sourcing from Kenyan Hass and Fuerte avocado varieties
* Comprehensive farmer support program
* Careful selection of fruits at various ripeness stages

#### Industrial Extraction and Processing
* Mechanical separation of oil from avocado pulp
* Chemical-free processing approach
* Temperature-controlled extraction
* Minimized waste production

#### Quality Assurance and Bulk Packaging
* Precise flexi tank installation
* Comprehensive export documentation
* Comprehensive laboratory testing

##### Welcome To Siz Agro Plc

# Avocado Oil and Coffee Producer/Exporter

Founded in 2017 by two partners with extensive experience in coffee supply and import-export trade.

[ About Us ][14]
[ Contact Us ][15]

### About Us

Siz Agro Plc is a leading coffee producer and exporter dedicated to delivering highquality green
coffee to customers worldwide. With a deep passion for coffee and a commitment to sustainability, we
have established ourselves as a reputed player in the coffee industry. In addition to coffee, we
have a newly established avocado oil manufacturing company, dedicated to producing premium quality
avocado oil for various culinary and cosmetic applications. With a focus on excellence and
innovation, we aim to become a trusted provider of avocado oil in the market.

### 63

Permanent Employees

### 2500+

Temporary Employees

### 20,000+

Farmers Collaboration

[ More About Us ][16]

### Production

Our company takes pride in our carefully cultivated coffee beans sourced from Sidama, South
Ethiopia, and Oromia regions, known for their exceptional coffee growing conditions. We employ
traditional techniques to ensure superior quality from seed to cup. Our skilled team of coffee
experts oversees every step of the production process.
Our company utilizes state of the art technology and carefully selected avocados to extract oil of
the highest standard. Our manufacturing facility adheres to strict hygiene and safety regulations to
ensure the production of
safe and top-quality avocado oil.

### Why Choose Siz Agro Plc

#### Quality Assurance

We maintain stringent quality control measures throughout the production process. Our beans as well
as Each batch of avocado oil undergoes rigorous testing to ensure it meets our exacting standards.

#### Export Services

As a reliable exporter, we specialize in facilitating seamless international trade. We have
established strong partnerships with green coffee and avocado oil buyers worldwide, enabling us to
reach in various markets.

#### Unique Selling Proposition

Siz Agro Plc is a distinguished exporter from Ethiopia, uniquely managing the entire coffee
production process from farm to export. With a commitment to quality and sustainability, we oversee
every step, ensuring that our coffee meets the highest standards from cultivation to your warehouse.
Additionally, we are proud producers and exporters of premium avocado oil, delivering excellence to
your business.

#### Growth

Growth is part of our DNA. Our potential to grow is immeasurable. We focus on business opportunities
with a view to create volume with quality and cost efficiencies in our operations. Our business has
grown significantly in the last 7 years, and we continue to invest to build a scalable business.

# **AvoHealth** – **Avocado Oil Specialists**

**We provide Advisory Services to ensure you have an excellent business case to start manufacturing
***or*** marketing Avocado Oil.**

**AvoHealth** **also market/distribute **(often bulk)** Avocado Oil products all over the world.**
For our client production companies, w*e can handle 100% of your avocado oil marketing &
distribution.*

In 2025 we can supply:
1. **Bulk Unrefined CRUDE (raw) Avocado Oil **– *Shipped in 24,000 liter Flexitanks. Use as a food,*
   *nutraceutical or cosmetic ingredient.* We are confident our Crude Oil is such high quality,
   there is no chance the ‘toxins’ known as 3-MCPD ,or Glycidyl Esters will form in the refining
   process.
2. **Extra Virgin Avocado Oil** – *usually shipped in 1,000 liter IBC’s/Totes*

In future we will supply:
3. **Refined Avocado Oil **– RBD & RBDW – not before 2026

4. **Retail Avocado Oil** – packed to your requirements in dark glass bottles or Hi-Tech plastic
bottles designed for on-line retail (e.g. Amazon).
* Your Private Label, *or*
* AvoHealth brand

Andrew Logan – Presenter at World Avocado Congress 2023. Avocado Africa Congress 2024 + 2025

## **Personal service, best prices and the highest quality Avocado Oil**

Avocado Oil is a Functional Food, made from the healthiest fruit on earth. This new generation
Super-Food provides additional health benefits and anti-oxidant activity in the fights against
obesity, heart disease, dementia, blindness, skincare and a range of cancers. Read more about the
amazing [health benefits of AvoHealth Avocado Oil][15].

**AvoHealth** [provides advice][16] on every aspect of the Avocado Oil business; from feasibility
studies to the Agri-Tech processing technology required, to advising on product packaging & branding
to meet your target markets.

We advise on the optimum production machinery and plant design, to maximize oil quality & yields.
* New production plants are in constant planning and development.
* Each new production facility improves our supply of ‘clean label’, minimally processed, finest
  quality Avocado Oil.

[ripe avocado]

**Avocado Health Limited**, (**AvoHealth**), is incorporated in New Zealand. **Avocado Processors
EPZ Limited,** is incorporated in Kenya and trades as **AvoHealth Kenya.**  We receive regular
inquiry for assistance on new Avocado Oil Production Projects from Mexico & South America.
Currently, we are working on NEW projects in Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Uganda & Rwanda.  
* **November 2022:** – Held a seminar on the Avocado Oil industry for 43 participants in Nairobi,
  Kenya. Extensive meetings with many clients.

**April 2023: World Avocado Congress – Auckland, New Zealand**

Invited to make 2 presentations about the Avocado Oil industry.

**Presentation #1:** Is there a good business case to press Avocado Oil?

**Presentation #2:** Avocado Oil Processing – a model for self-regulation.


**May 2024 + May 2025 – Avocado Africa Congress** in Nairobi – a lead presenter always focussed on:
**‘The Business Case to enter the Avocado Oil industry**‘ *and*
‘**How to manufacture the Highest Quality Avocado Oil**‘

# **unlock the ****full potential**** of avocado oil production.**

AvoVenture Consulting specializes in guiding both aspiring entrepreneurs and established
manufacturers through every step of the avocado oil production process. Whether you’re looking to
set up an avocado oil factory or seeking to optimize your existing operations, we’re here to help
you achieve success.

[ about us ][19]

### **for ****aspiring entrepreneurs**

Looking to establish an avocado oil factory? We’ll provide expert guidance from conception to
implementation.
* #### consultation and planning
  
  We’ll guide you from conception to execution, and work closely with you to develop a customized
  roadmap that aligns with your vision, budget, and timeline.
* #### factory setup
  
  From selecting the right equipment to designing efficient layouts, we'll ensure your avocado oil
  factory is set up for maximum productivity and profitability.
* #### supply chain management
  
  We'll assist you in sourcing high-quality avocados, optimizing logistics, and establishing
  reliable partnerships to support your production needs.

[ Learn more ][20]

### **for ****established manufacturers**

Looking to optimize operations at your existing avocado oil factory? We’ll help you strategize ways
to drive your business forward.
* #### process optimization
  
  We’ll conduct a thorough assessment of your current operations to identify areas for improvement
  and implement strategies to enhance efficiency and quality.
* #### product diversification
  
  Looking to expand your product line? We'll help you explore new avenues for innovation and develop
  unique avocado oil products to meet evolving consumer preferences.
* #### market expansion
  
  With our strategic guidance, you can tap into new markets, both domestically and internationally,
  to grow your customer base and increase profitability.

[ Learn more ][21]

Whether you’re ready to begin working with us or you’d like to learn more about what we can do to
help you make your mark in the avocado oil industry, we’re happy to help.

[Contact us][22] today to start your AvoVenture experience.
